+-- INACTIVE. Append-only allocations replace neither old links nor historical rows.
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_order_residual(p_order uuid) RETURNS numeric
+LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE po public.partner_orders; s platform_private.b2b_order_condition_snapshots; allocated numeric; total numeric;
+BEGIN
+ SELECT * INTO po FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id=p_order;
+ SELECT * INTO s FROM platform_private.b2b_order_condition_snapshots WHERE order_id=p_order;
+ total:=coalesce(s.financed_total,po.final_amount_with_interest);
+ IF total IS NULL OR total<0 OR total::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_ORDER_AMOUNT_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links l WHERE l.partner_order_id=p_order) THEN
+  -- Legacy 1:1 can be netted only when the complete title is proven by the same projection.
+  IF s.order_id IS NOT NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_financial_links l WHERE l.partner_order_id=p_order)<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_LEGACY_ALLOCATION_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  PERFORM public.rpc_receivable_money_projection_v1(l.receivable_id,0,1000) FROM public.partner_order_financial_links l WHERE l.partner_order_id=p_order;
+  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links l JOIN public.accounts_receivable a ON a.id=l.receivable_id WHERE l.partner_order_id=p_order AND a.total_amount=total AND a.status<>'CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_LEGACY_ALLOCATION_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  RETURN 0;
+ END IF;
+ IF po.receivable_generated AND s.order_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_LEGACY_ALLOCATION_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ SELECT coalesce(sum(x.principal+x.financed_interest),0) INTO allocated FROM platform_private.b2b_document_allocations x WHERE x.order_id=p_order AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals r WHERE r.document_id=x.document_id);
+ IF allocated>total THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_OVERALLOCATED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ RETURN total-allocated;
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_credit_balances(p_partner uuid,p_exclude uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE org uuid:=platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(p_partner); po record; i record; row jsonb; open_amount numeric:=0; overdue numeric:=0; committed numeric:=0; pending numeric:=0; balance numeric; residual numeric; tolerance int;
+BEGIN
+ IF platform_private.b2b_credit_config_block(p_partner) IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_SETTINGS_INCOMPLETE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ SELECT overdue_tolerance_days INTO tolerance FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id=p_partner AND active IS TRUE;
+ IF tolerance IS NULL OR tolerance<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_SETTINGS_INCOMPLETE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ FOR i IN SELECT s.id,s.due_date FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments s JOIN public.accounts_receivable a ON a.id=s.receivable_id WHERE a.organization_id=org AND s.organization_id=org AND a.partner_id=p_partner AND a.status<>'CANCELED' AND s.status<>'CANCELED' LOOP
+  row:=platform_private.b2b_proven_money_row(i.id);
+  IF row IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_MONEY_ORIGIN_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  balance:=greatest((row->>'original_amount')::numeric+(row->>'interest_amount')::numeric-(row->>'financed_interest_amount')::numeric+(row->>'penalty_amount')::numeric-(row->>'discount_amount')::numeric-(row->>'received_amount')::numeric,0);
+  open_amount:=open_amount+balance;
+  IF i.due_date<CURRENT_DATE-tolerance THEN overdue:=overdue+balance; END IF;
+ END LOOP;
+ FOR po IN SELECT id,status::text AS status FROM public.partner_orders WHERE partner_id=p_partner AND id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude AND status::text IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue','pendente','solicitado','em_analise_comercial','aguardando_aprovacao_credito','aguardando_ajuste_comercial','aguardando_itens') LOOP
+  residual:=platform_private.b2b_order_residual(po.id);
+  IF po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue') THEN committed:=committed+residual; ELSE pending:=pending+residual; END IF;
+ END LOOP;
+ RETURN jsonb_build_object('saldo_em_aberto',open_amount,'saldo_vencido',overdue,'comprometido_nao_faturado',committed,'comprometido_pendente',pending);
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_allocate_document(p_document uuid) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE d platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents; s platform_private.b2b_order_condition_snapshots; x platform_private.b2b_document_allocations;
+ org uuid; u uuid:=auth.uid(); it jsonb; accepted jsonb:='[]'; base jsonb; qty numeric; previous numeric; totalqty numeric; pr numeric; intr numeric; principal numeric:=0; financing numeric:=0; active_pr numeric; active_intr numeric;
+ tid uuid:=gen_random_uuid(); rows jsonb; final numeric; cfg jsonb; cal platform_private.holiday_calendars; customer uuid; category uuid; method_id uuid; item_net numeric; item_financing numeric;
+BEGIN
+ SELECT * INTO d FROM platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents WHERE id=p_document;
+ org:=platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(d.partner_id,true);
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_dependencies();
+ IF d.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR d.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'AUTHORIZED' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_DOCUMENT_NOT_AUTHORIZED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ -- Order row precedes shared credit, same as approval. Document lock follows order.
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id=d.order_id FOR UPDATE;
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(d.partner_id,true);
+ PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('b2b_credit:'||d.partner_id::text,0));
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(d.partner_id,true);
+ SELECT * INTO d FROM platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents WHERE id=p_document FOR SHARE;
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(d.partner_id,true);
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_dependencies();
+ IF d.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR d.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'AUTHORIZED' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_DOCUMENT_NOT_AUTHORIZED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_cancellation_attestations c WHERE c.document_id=p_document) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_DOCUMENT_CANCELED' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+ SELECT * INTO s FROM platform_private.b2b_order_condition_snapshots WHERE order_id=d.order_id AND organization_id=org AND partner_id=d.partner_id;
+ IF NOT FOUND OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links l WHERE l.partner_order_id=d.order_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ORDER_SNAPSHOT_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ SELECT * INTO x FROM platform_private.b2b_document_allocations WHERE document_id=p_document;
+ IF FOUND THEN
+  IF x.source_digest IS DISTINCT FROM d.source_digest OR x.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.order_id OR x.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR x.items IS DISTINCT FROM d.items THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_REPLAY_DIVERGENCE' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals r WHERE r.document_id=p_document) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_DOCUMENT_CANCELED' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'document_id',p_document,'receivable_id',x.receivable_id,'replayed',true);
+ END IF;
+ IF jsonb_typeof(d.items) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(d.items)=0 OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT j->>'item_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.items) j)<>jsonb_array_length(d.items) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_ITEMS_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ -- Subtotals must ALREADY be the accepted net item bases (as written by the
+ -- canonical cart). Never invent a discount allocation from aggregate totals.
+ IF (SELECT sum(i.subtotal) FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=d.order_id) IS DISTINCT FROM s.principal
+ OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=d.order_id AND (i.subtotal IS NULL OR i.subtotal<0 OR i.quantidade IS NULL OR i.quantidade<=0))
+ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_NET_ITEM_BASE_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ FOR it IN SELECT j FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.items) j ORDER BY j->>'item_id' COLLATE "C" LOOP
+  IF jsonb_typeof(it->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_ITEMS_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  qty:=(it->>'quantity')::numeric;
+  SELECT to_jsonb(i) INTO base FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.id=(it->>'item_id')::uuid AND i.order_id=d.order_id;
+  IF base IS NULL OR qty<=0 OR qty::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_ITEMS_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  -- Item monetary base is the immutable order snapshot, never callback price.
+  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders po CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(po.internal_economic_snapshot->'items') b WHERE po.id=d.order_id AND b->>'id'=base->>'id' AND (b->>'quantidade')::numeric=(base->>'quantidade')::numeric AND (b->>'subtotal')::numeric=(base->>'subtotal')::numeric) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_ITEM_SNAPSHOT_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  totalqty:=(base->>'quantidade')::numeric;
+  SELECT coalesce(sum((j->>'quantity')::numeric),0) INTO previous FROM platform_private.b2b_document_allocations a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.items) j WHERE a.order_id=d.order_id AND j->>'item_id'=it->>'item_id' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals r WHERE r.document_id=a.document_id);
+  IF previous+qty>totalqty THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_QUANTITY_OVERALLOCATED' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  item_net:=(base->>'subtotal')::numeric;
+  -- Financing distribution is cumulative; final item absorbs cent residual deterministically.
+  SELECT round(s.financed_interest*sum(i.subtotal)/s.principal,2)-round(s.financed_interest*(sum(i.subtotal)-item_net)/s.principal,2) INTO item_financing FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=d.order_id AND i.id<=(base->>'id')::uuid;
+  -- Quantity alone cannot reconstruct cents after a middle reversal. Retain
+  -- each item's money append-only and reconcile the ACTIVE monetary ledger.
+  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_document_allocations a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.items) j
+   WHERE a.order_id=d.order_id AND j->>'item_id'=it->>'item_id'
+   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals r WHERE r.document_id=a.document_id)
+   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.item_money) m WHERE m->>'item_id'=it->>'item_id')<>1)
+  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_ITEM_MONEY_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  SELECT coalesce(sum((m->>'principal')::numeric),0),coalesce(sum((m->>'financed_interest')::numeric),0)
+   INTO active_pr,active_intr FROM platform_private.b2b_document_allocations a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.item_money) m
+   WHERE a.order_id=d.order_id AND m->>'item_id'=it->>'item_id' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals r WHERE r.document_id=a.document_id);
+  IF active_pr<0 OR active_pr>item_net OR active_intr<0 OR active_intr>item_financing THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_ITEM_MONEY_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  pr:=CASE WHEN previous+qty=totalqty THEN item_net-active_pr ELSE least(item_net-active_pr,round(item_net*(previous+qty)/totalqty,2)-round(item_net*previous/totalqty,2)) END;
+  intr:=CASE WHEN previous+qty=totalqty THEN item_financing-active_intr ELSE least(item_financing-active_intr,round(item_financing*(previous+qty)/totalqty,2)-round(item_financing*previous/totalqty,2)) END;
+  principal:=principal+pr; financing:=financing+intr; accepted:=accepted||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item_id',it->>'item_id','quantity',qty,'principal',pr,'financed_interest',intr));
+ END LOOP;
+ final:=principal+financing;
+ IF principal<=0 OR final>platform_private.b2b_order_residual(d.order_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_AMOUNT_OVERALLOCATED' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+ SELECT * INTO cal FROM platform_private.holiday_calendars WHERE version=s.condition->>'calendar_version';
+ rows:=platform_private.b2b_schedule(principal,(s.condition->>'monthly_rate')::numeric,(s.condition->>'installment_count')::int,d.issue_date,(s.choice->>'payment_deadline_days')::int,cal);
+ -- Keep accepted order financing, even on partial documents: allocate breakdown cumulatively,
+ -- not a new interest contract. Due dates use issue date of THIS authorized document.
+ WITH r AS (SELECT j, (j->>'installment_number')::int n FROM jsonb_array_elements(rows) j), weights AS (
+ SELECT r.n,r.j,sum((o->>'principal_amount')::numeric) OVER(ORDER BY r.n) cp,
+ sum((o->>'interest_amount')::numeric) OVER(ORDER BY r.n) cf,(o->>'principal_amount')::numeric p,(o->>'interest_amount')::numeric f
+ FROM r JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.rows) o WHERE (o->>'installment_number')::int=r.n) original ON true), dist AS (
+ SELECT n,j,round(principal*cp/s.principal,2)-round(principal*(cp-p)/s.principal,2) p,
+ CASE WHEN s.financed_interest=0 THEN 0 ELSE round(financing*cf/s.financed_interest,2)-round(financing*(cf-f)/s.financed_interest,2) END f FROM weights)
+ SELECT jsonb_agg(j||jsonb_build_object('amount',p+f,'principal_amount',p,'interest_amount',f) ORDER BY n) INTO rows FROM dist;
+ SELECT client_id INTO customer FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id=d.partner_id AND commercial_owner_organization_id=org;
+ category:=(s.condition->>'category_id')::uuid; method_id:=(s.condition->>'payment_method_id')::uuid;
+ IF customer IS NULL OR category IS NULL OR method_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.financial_categories WHERE id=category AND active AND upper(btrim(type))='RECEITA') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.payment_methods WHERE id=method_id AND active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FINANCIAL_REFS_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ INSERT INTO platform_private.b2b_title_permits VALUES(txid_current(),u,org,tid,d.order_id,d.partner_id,customer,rows);
+ INSERT INTO public.accounts_receivable(id,organization_id,origin_type,origin_id,customer_id,partner_id,description,category_id,total_amount,issue_date,first_due_date,installment_count,status,payment_method_id,created_by,b2b_document_id)
+ VALUES(tid,org,'B2B_ORDER',d.order_id,customer,d.partner_id,'Documento fiscal autorizado — candidato interno',category,final,d.issue_date,(rows->0->>'due_date')::date,jsonb_array_length(rows),'OPEN',method_id,u,d.id);
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_title_permits WHERE transaction_id=txid_current() AND title_id=tid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_TITLE_PERMIT_NOT_CONSUMED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ INSERT INTO platform_private.b2b_document_allocations(document_id,organization_id,order_id,partner_id,receivable_id,source_digest,principal,financed_interest,items,item_money,rows) VALUES(d.id,org,d.order_id,d.partner_id,tid,d.source_digest,principal,financing,d.items,accepted,rows);
+ RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'document_id',d.id,'receivable_id',tid,'principal',principal,'financed_interest',financing,'residual',platform_private.b2b_order_residual(d.order_id),'replayed',false);
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_reverse_allocation(p_document uuid,p_replacement uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE x platform_private.b2b_document_allocations; org uuid; d platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents;
+BEGIN
+ SELECT * INTO x FROM platform_private.b2b_document_allocations WHERE document_id=p_document;
+ org:=platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(x.partner_id,true); PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_dependencies();
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id=x.order_id FOR UPDATE; PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(x.partner_id,true);
+ PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('b2b_credit:'||x.partner_id::text,0)); PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(x.partner_id,true);
+ IF x.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_TENANT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals r WHERE r.document_id=p_document) THEN
+  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals r WHERE r.document_id=p_document AND r.replacement_document_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_replacement) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_REPLAY_DIVERGENCE' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'replayed',true);
+ END IF;
+ -- Paid or adjusted histories require independent reconciliation, never automatic cancellation.
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments WHERE receivable_id=x.receivable_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(x.partner_id,true);
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_dependencies();
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.receivable_payments p JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments i ON i.id=p.installment_id WHERE i.receivable_id=x.receivable_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_PAID_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+ IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=x.receivable_id)<>jsonb_array_length(x.rows)
+ OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable a WHERE a.id=x.receivable_id AND a.status='OPEN' AND a.b2b_document_id=x.document_id AND a.total_amount=x.principal+x.financed_interest)
+ OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=x.receivable_id AND
+ (i.status<>'OPEN' OR i.received_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::numeric OR i.interest_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::numeric OR i.penalty_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::numeric OR i.discount_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::numeric
+ OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(x.rows) r WHERE (r->>'installment_number')::int=i.installment_number AND (r->>'amount')::numeric=i.original_amount AND (r->>'due_date')::date=i.due_date)))
+ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_PAID_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+ SELECT * INTO d FROM platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents WHERE id=p_replacement AND organization_id=org AND order_id=x.order_id AND partner_id=x.partner_id AND state='AUTHORIZED';
+ IF p_replacement IS NOT NULL AND (NOT FOUND OR p_replacement=p_document OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_cancellation_attestations c WHERE c.document_id=p_replacement)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_REPLACEMENT_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ -- Cancellation ingestion itself remains an unproven dependency; no buyer callback accepted.
+ IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_cancellation_attestations c WHERE c.document_id=p_document AND c.organization_id=org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_CANCELLATION_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ INSERT INTO platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals VALUES(p_document,p_replacement,x.source_digest,now());
+ UPDATE public.accounts_receivable_installments SET status='CANCELED' WHERE receivable_id=x.receivable_id;
+ UPDATE public.accounts_receivable SET status='CANCELED' WHERE id=x.receivable_id;
+ IF p_replacement IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM platform_private.b2b_allocate_document(p_replacement); END IF;
+ RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'replayed',false);
+END $$;

+-- INACTIVE COMPOSITION; no hosted installation and no client grants.
+-- Requires existing Price/installments candidate and captured canonical order guards.
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout='3s';
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_condition_versions (
+ organization_id uuid NOT NULL, plan_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.commercial_payment_plans(id), version int NOT NULL CHECK(version>0),
+ method text NOT NULL CHECK(method IN ('dinheiro','pix','cartao_debito','boleto','promissoria','cartao_credito')),
+ deadline_days int NOT NULL CHECK(deadline_days>=0), installment_count int NOT NULL CHECK(installment_count BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
+ monthly_rate numeric NOT NULL CHECK(monthly_rate>=0 AND monthly_rate::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')),
+ approved_by uuid NOT NULL, approved_at timestamptz NOT NULL, configuration_approved boolean NOT NULL CHECK(configuration_approved),
+ calendar_version text NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_private.holiday_calendars(version), category_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.financial_categories(id), payment_method_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.payment_methods(id),
+ PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,plan_id,version,method),
+ CHECK(method NOT IN ('dinheiro','pix','cartao_debito') OR (installment_count=1 AND monthly_rate=0)),
+ CHECK(method<>'boleto' OR (installment_count<=3 AND deadline_days=30))
+);
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_condition_assignments (
+ organization_id uuid NOT NULL, partner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.partner_accounts(id), plan_id uuid NOT NULL,
+ version int NOT NULL, method text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,partner_id,plan_id,version,method),
+ FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,plan_id,version,method) REFERENCES platform_private.b2b_condition_versions(organization_id,plan_id,version,method)
+);
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_order_condition_snapshots (
+ order_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.partner_orders(id), organization_id uuid NOT NULL, partner_id uuid NOT NULL,
+ actor_id uuid NOT NULL, plan_id uuid NOT NULL, choice jsonb NOT NULL, condition jsonb NOT NULL, request_hash text NOT NULL,
+ rows jsonb NOT NULL, principal numeric NOT NULL, financed_interest numeric NOT NULL, financed_total numeric NOT NULL,
+ CHECK(principal>0 AND financed_interest>=0 AND financed_total=principal+financed_interest)
+);
+-- Private attestation is NOT a fiscal ingestion endpoint. No issuer populates it in this candidate.
+-- Production authority remains unproven: the dependency gate below always denies.
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents (
+ id uuid PRIMARY KEY, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, partner_id uuid NOT NULL, order_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.partner_orders(id),
+ kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('NFE','NFSE')), issue_date date NOT NULL CHECK(isfinite(issue_date)),
+ event_key text NOT NULL, source_digest text NOT NULL CHECK(source_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
+ items jsonb NOT NULL, state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('AUTHORIZED','CANCELED')),
+ UNIQUE(organization_id,kind,event_key)
+);
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_document_allocations (
+ document_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents(id), organization_id uuid NOT NULL,
+ order_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.partner_orders(id), partner_id uuid NOT NULL,
+ receivable_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES public.accounts_receivable(id), source_digest text NOT NULL,
+ principal numeric NOT NULL CHECK(principal>0), financed_interest numeric NOT NULL CHECK(financed_interest>=0),
+ items jsonb NOT NULL, item_money jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(item_money)='array'), rows jsonb NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_allocation_reversals (
+ document_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES platform_private.b2b_document_allocations(document_id),
+ replacement_document_id uuid REFERENCES platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents(id), source_digest text NOT NULL,
+ created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_title_permits (
+ transaction_id bigint NOT NULL, actor_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, title_id uuid NOT NULL,
+ order_id uuid NOT NULL, partner_id uuid NOT NULL, customer_id uuid NOT NULL, rows jsonb NOT NULL,
+ PRIMARY KEY(transaction_id,title_id)
+);
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_condition_retirements (
+ organization_id uuid NOT NULL, plan_id uuid NOT NULL, version int NOT NULL, method text NOT NULL,
+ PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,plan_id,version,method),
+ FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,plan_id,version,method) REFERENCES platform_private.b2b_condition_versions(organization_id,plan_id,version,method)
+);
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.b2b_cancellation_attestations (
+ document_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents(id), organization_id uuid NOT NULL,
+ event_key text NOT NULL, source_digest text NOT NULL CHECK(source_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), UNIQUE(organization_id,event_key)
+);
+-- The captured active-title/order index is another 1:1 barrier. Keep it for all
+-- legacy rows; candidate documents gain their own unique fiscal identity.
+ALTER TABLE public.accounts_receivable ADD COLUMN b2b_document_id uuid REFERENCES platform_private.b2b_authorized_documents(id);
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX b2b_one_title_per_document ON public.accounts_receivable(b2b_document_id) WHERE b2b_document_id IS NOT NULL;
+DROP INDEX public.ux_ar_one_active_per_b2b_order;
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_ar_one_active_per_b2b_order ON public.accounts_receivable(origin_id) WHERE origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND status<>'CANCELED' AND b2b_document_id IS NULL;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_integration_dependencies() RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_FISCAL_ATTESTATION_ACCOUNTING_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(p_partner uuid, p_internal boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid:=public.h15_actor_organization(); owner_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+ IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_READ_COMMITTED_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='0A000'; END IF;
+ IF u IS NULL OR org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACTOR_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ PERFORM platform_private.c2_order_actor_scope(u,p_partner);
+ SELECT commercial_owner_organization_id INTO owner_org FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id=p_partner AND ativo IS TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL;
+ IF owner_org IS DISTINCT FROM org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_TENANT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF p_internal AND (public.is_financial_staff(u) IS NOT TRUE
+  OR public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::public.app_role)
+  OR public.has_role(u,'cliente_produtor'::public.app_role)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ONLY' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ RETURN org;
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_choice(p jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v numeric; d numeric;
+BEGIN
+ IF jsonb_typeof(p)<>'object' OR jsonb_typeof(p->'payment_method') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+ OR p->>'payment_method' NOT IN ('dinheiro','pix','cartao_debito','boleto','promissoria','cartao_credito')
+ OR jsonb_typeof(p->'payment_condition_version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
+ OR jsonb_typeof(p->'payment_deadline_days') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'payment_choice_required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ v:=(p->>'payment_condition_version')::numeric; d:=(p->>'payment_deadline_days')::numeric;
+ IF v<>trunc(v) OR v<1 OR v>2147483647 OR d<>trunc(d) OR d<0 OR d>36500 OR (p-ARRAY['payment_method','payment_condition_version','payment_deadline_days'])<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'payment_choice_required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ RETURN jsonb_build_object('payment_method',p->>'payment_method','payment_condition_version',v::int,'payment_deadline_days',d::int);
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_resolve_condition(p_partner uuid,p_plan uuid,p_choice jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE org uuid; c platform_private.b2b_condition_versions; choice jsonb;
+BEGIN
+ org:=platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(p_partner); choice:=platform_private.b2b_choice(p_choice);
+ SELECT v.* INTO c FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_versions v
+ JOIN platform_private.b2b_condition_assignments a USING(organization_id,plan_id,version,method)
+ JOIN public.commercial_payment_plans p ON p.id=v.plan_id AND p.active IS TRUE
+ WHERE a.partner_id=p_partner AND v.organization_id=org AND v.plan_id=p_plan
+ AND v.version=(choice->>'payment_condition_version')::int AND v.method=choice->>'payment_method'
+ AND v.deadline_days=(choice->>'payment_deadline_days')::int AND v.configuration_approved IS TRUE
+ AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_retirements r WHERE (r.organization_id,r.plan_id,r.version,r.method)=(v.organization_id,v.plan_id,v.version,v.method));
+ IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'payment_condition_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+ PERFORM platform_private.c2_owner_order_guard(auth.uid(),p_partner,p_plan);
+ IF platform_private.b2b_credit_config_block(p_partner) IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CREDIT_SETTINGS_INCOMPLETE' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+ RETURN to_jsonb(c);
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.partner_payment_condition_capability_v1(p_partner_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE org uuid;
+BEGIN
+ org:=platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(p_partner_id);
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_integration_dependencies();
+ IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_assignments a JOIN public.commercial_payment_plans p ON p.id=a.plan_id AND p.active WHERE a.organization_id=org AND a.partner_id=p_partner_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'payment_condition_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+ RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract','B2B_PAYMENT_CONDITION_V1','actor_id',auth.uid(),'organization_id',org,'partner_id',p_partner_id,'simulate',true,'create',true);
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_business_day(d date,c platform_private.holiday_calendars) RETURNS date
+LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path='' AS $$
+BEGIN
+ IF d IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(d) OR c.locality IS DISTINCT FROM 'Paracatu-MG' OR nullif(btrim(c.version),'') IS NULL
+ OR c.coverage_start IS NULL OR c.coverage_end IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(c.coverage_start) OR NOT isfinite(c.coverage_end)
+ OR c.coverage_end<c.coverage_start OR c.holidays IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(c.holidays) h WHERE h IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(h) OR h<c.coverage_start OR h>c.coverage_end)
+ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CALENDAR_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ LOOP
+  IF d<c.coverage_start OR d>c.coverage_end THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CALENDAR_COVERAGE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  IF extract(isodow FROM d)<6 AND NOT(d=ANY(c.holidays)) THEN RETURN d; END IF;
+  d:=d+1;
+ END LOOP;
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_schedule(principal numeric,rate numeric,n int,issue date,deadline int,cal platform_private.holiday_calendars)
+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE bal numeric; pmt numeric; intr numeric; amort numeric; amount numeric; first date; nom date; rows jsonb:='[]';
+BEGIN
+ IF principal IS NULL OR principal::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR principal<=0 OR principal<>round(principal,2)
+ OR rate IS NULL OR rate::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR rate<0 OR n IS NULL OR n NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120
+ OR issue IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(issue) OR deadline IS NULL OR deadline<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ bal:=principal; first:=issue+deadline;
+ pmt:=round(CASE WHEN rate=0 THEN principal/n ELSE principal*(rate/100)/(1-power(1+rate/100,-n)) END,2);
+ FOR k IN 1..n LOOP
+  intr:=round(bal*rate/100,2); amount:=CASE WHEN k=n THEN bal+intr ELSE pmt END; amort:=amount-intr;
+  IF amort<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+  nom:=(first+make_interval(months=>k-1))::date;
+  rows:=rows||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('installment_number',k,'principal_amount',amort,'interest_amount',intr,'amount',amount,'nominal_due_date',nom,'due_date',platform_private.b2b_business_day(nom,cal),'received_amount',0));
+  bal:=bal-amort;
+ END LOOP;
+ IF bal<>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE_RESIDUAL' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+ RETURN rows;
+END $$;
+
+DO $$ DECLARE t text; BEGIN
+ FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY['b2b_condition_versions','b2b_condition_assignments','b2b_order_condition_snapshots','b2b_authorized_documents','b2b_document_allocations','b2b_allocation_reversals','b2b_condition_retirements','b2b_cancellation_attestations'] LOOP
+  EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE platform_private.%I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY',t);
+  EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.%I FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated,service_role',t);
+  EXECUTE format('CREATE TRIGGER immutable_update_delete BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON platform_private.%I FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION platform_private.price_immutable()',t);
+  EXECUTE format('CREATE TRIGGER immutable_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON platform_private.%I FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION platform_private.price_immutable()',t);
+ END LOOP;
+END $$;
+ALTER TABLE platform_private.b2b_title_permits ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.b2b_title_permits FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated,service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.partner_payment_condition_capability_v1(uuid),platform_private.b2b_integration_dependencies(),platform_private.b2b_integration_actor(uuid,boolean),platform_private.b2b_choice(jsonb),platform_private.b2b_resolve_condition(uuid,uuid,jsonb),platform_private.b2b_business_day(date,platform_private.holiday_calendars),platform_private.b2b_schedule(numeric,numeric,int,date,int,platform_private.holiday_calendars) FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated,service_role;
+COMMIT;

+-- INACTIVE OFFLINE CANDIDATE. Disposable PostgreSQL only. No grants/hosted install.
+-- Reads the generator's immutable snapshot; unknown legacy origins are NOT backfilled.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.rpc_receivable_money_projection_v1(p_receivable_id uuid DEFAULT NULL, p_offset int DEFAULT 0, p_limit int DEFAULT 1000)
+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $$
+DECLARE u uuid := auth.uid(); org uuid := public.h15_actor_organization(); result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF u IS NULL OR org IS NULL OR public.is_financial_staff(u) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'MONEY_ORIGIN_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset < 0 OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'MONEY_ORIGIN_PAGE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_receivable_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable a WHERE a.id=p_receivable_id AND a.organization_id=org) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'MONEY_ORIGIN_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(projected ORDER BY id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO result FROM (
+    SELECT i.id, to_jsonb(i) || jsonb_build_object(
+      'monetary_semantics','financed_total_v1',
+      -- Existing Price writer stores financing only in snapshot; column interest is late interest.
+      'interest_amount',i.interest_amount + (r->>'interest')::numeric,
+      'financed_interest_amount',(r->>'interest')::numeric,
+      'monetary_origin',jsonb_build_object('contract','RECEIVABLE_MONEY_V1','source','price_snapshot_v1',
+        'installment_id',i.id,'receivable_id',i.receivable_id,'snapshot_principal',(r->>'principal')::numeric,
+        'snapshot_interest',(r->>'interest')::numeric)) AS projected
+    FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i
+    JOIN public.accounts_receivable a ON a.id=i.receivable_id
+    LEFT JOIN platform_private.price_schedule_snapshots s ON s.receivable_id=a.id AND s.organization_id=org
+    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x AS r FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.rows) x WHERE (x->>'installment_number')::int=i.installment_number) snapshot_row ON true
+    WHERE a.organization_id=org AND (p_receivable_id IS NULL OR a.id=p_receivable_id)
+    ORDER BY i.id OFFSET p_offset LIMIT p_limit
+  ) rows;
+  -- Missing snapshot yields null proof and is rejected by the operational consumer.
+  RETURN result;
+END $$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.rpc_receivable_money_projection_v1(uuid,int,int) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;

+-- Fechamento ACL INATIVO e separado (não faz parte do install). NÃO APLICAR sem autorização.
+-- Captura 01/11: anon/authenticated possuem TRUNCATE, TRIGGER e REFERENCES em product_fiscal_profiles
+-- (default ACL arwdDxtm). TRUNCATE ignora RLS e triggers de linha; nenhum guard de TRUNCATE foi capturado.
+-- Mantém SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (fluxos existentes governados por RLS + a00/a10; DELETE policy=false).
+-- Nunca exercitar TRUNCATE real — verificação somente por has_table_privilege.
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s';
+DO $pre$ BEGIN
+  IF NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.product_fiscal_profiles','SELECT') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: unexpected grants (re-capture first)'; END IF;
+END $pre$;
+REVOKE TRUNCATE, TRIGGER, REFERENCES ON public.product_fiscal_profiles FROM anon, authenticated;
+DO $post$ DECLARE r text; p text; BEGIN
+  FOREACH r IN ARRAY ARRAY['anon','authenticated'] LOOP
+    FOREACH p IN ARRAY ARRAY['TRUNCATE','TRIGGER','REFERENCES'] LOOP
+      IF has_table_privilege(r,'public.product_fiscal_profiles',p) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: % still has %', r, p; END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+  END LOOP;
+  FOREACH p IN ARRAY ARRAY['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE'] LOOP
+    IF NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.product_fiscal_profiles',p) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: existing flow lost %', p; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+END $post$;
+COMMIT;
+-- Reversão (somente se um fluxo legítimo comprovadamente depender): GRANT pontual registrado, nunca ALL.

+"""Gera install.sql.review a partir do template + capturas READ ONLY (anexo materializado).
+Determinístico; nunca conecta a banco. Pins vêm da captura hosted, não do harness."""
+import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
+H = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT = H.parents[1]
+EV = ROOT / "docs/auditorias/evidencias/reconciliacao-fiscal-catalogo-20261101/original-80c64c38"
+LIVE = json.loads((EV / "live_readonly_audit.json").read_text())[0]["audit"]
+FISC = json.loads((EV / "live_fiscal_details.json").read_text())[0]["audit"]
+TABLE = "product_fiscal_profiles"
+PINNED_FUNCS = [
+    "platform_private.global_product_fiscal_before_write()",
+    "platform_private.global_product_fiscal_statement_gate()",
+    "platform_private.global_product_fiscal_write_ready()",
+    "platform_private.global_product_fiscal_read_ready()",
+    "platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(uuid)",
+    "platform_private.h15_actor_organization()",
+    "fiscal_audit_trigger()",
+]
+
+
+def q(s): return "'" + s.replace("'", "''") + "'"
+def md5(s): return hashlib.md5(s.encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def fn(sig):
+    for f in LIVE["functions"] + FISC["functions"]:
+        if f["signature"] == sig:
+            return f
+    raise SystemExit(f"capture missing {sig}")
+
+
+def regproc(sig):
+    return sig if sig.startswith("platform_private.") else "public." + sig
+
+
+def policy_line(p):
+    return "|".join([p["policyname"], p["cmd"], p["permissive"], ",".join(p["roles"]),
+                     p["qual"] or "~", p["with_check"] or "~"])
+
+
+def policies():
+    return sorted(policy_line(p) for p in LIVE["policies"] if p["tablename"] == TABLE)
+
+
+def triggers():
+    return sorted(t["definition"] for t in LIVE["triggers"] if t["table"] == TABLE)
+
+
+def grants():
+    return sorted({f'{g["grantee"]}:{g["privilege_type"]}' for g in LIVE["grants"]
+                   if g["table_name"] == TABLE and g["grantee"] in ("anon", "authenticated", "service_role")})
+
+
+def default_acl():
+    for d in FISC["default_acl"]:
+        if d["owner"] == "postgres" and d["schema"] == "public" and d["type"] == "f":
+            return sorted(d["acl"])
+    raise SystemExit("default acl missing")
+
+
+def constraints():
+    return sorted(FISC["constraints"])
+
+
+def pins():
+    out = ["DO $pins$ BEGIN"]
+    for sig in PINNED_FUNCS:
+        f = fn(sig)
+        out.append(f"  IF md5(pg_get_functiondef({q(regproc(sig))}::regprocedure)) <> {q(md5(f['definition']))} THEN"
+                   f" RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: body drift {sig}'; END IF;")
+        acl = ",".join(q(a) for a in sorted(f["acl"]))
+        out.append(f"  IF (SELECT array_agg(a::text ORDER BY a::text) FROM pg_proc p, unnest(p.proacl) a WHERE p.oid={q(regproc(sig))}::regprocedure)"
+                   f" IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY[{acl}]::text[] THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: ACL drift {sig}'; END IF;")
+    pol = "\n".join(policies())
+    out.append("  IF (SELECT md5(string_agg(policyname||'|'||cmd||'|'||permissive||'|'||array_to_string(roles,',')||'|'||"
+               "coalesce(qual,'~')||'|'||coalesce(with_check,'~'), E'\\n' ORDER BY policyname||'|'||cmd||'|'||permissive||'|'||array_to_string(roles,',')||'|'||coalesce(qual,'~')||'|'||coalesce(with_check,'~') COLLATE \"C\"))"
+               f" FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='{TABLE}') <> {q(md5(pol))}"
+               " THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: policy definition drift (same count is not enough)'; END IF;")
+    trg = "\n".join(triggers())
+    out.append(f"  IF (SELECT md5(string_agg(pg_get_triggerdef(oid), E'\\n' ORDER BY pg_get_triggerdef(oid) COLLATE \"C\")) FROM pg_trigger"
+               f" WHERE tgrelid='public.{TABLE}'::regclass AND NOT tgisinternal) <> {q(md5(trg))}"
+               " THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: trigger drift'; END IF;")
+    # Capture lacks tgenabled; enabled-origin is an explicit assumption re-pinned at hosted recapture.
+    out.append(f"  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.{TABLE}'::regclass AND NOT tgisinternal AND tgenabled<>'O')"
+               " THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: trigger disabled/replica-only'; END IF;")
+    gr = "\n".join(grants())
+    out.append("  IF (SELECT md5(string_agg(grantee||':'||privilege_type, E'\\n' ORDER BY grantee||':'||privilege_type COLLATE \"C\")) FROM"
+               f" (SELECT DISTINCT grantee::text, privilege_type::text FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='{TABLE}'"
+               f" AND grantee IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role')) g) <> {q(md5(gr))} THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: table grant drift'; END IF;")
+    da = ",".join(q(a) for a in default_acl())
+    out.append("  IF (SELECT array_agg(a::text ORDER BY a::text) FROM pg_default_acl d, unnest(d.defaclacl) a WHERE d.defaclrole='postgres'::regrole"
+               f" AND d.defaclnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND d.defaclobjtype='f') IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY[{da}]::text[]"
+               " THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: default ACL drift'; END IF;")
+    cons = "\n".join(constraints())
+    out.append(f"  IF (SELECT md5(string_agg(pg_get_constraintdef(oid), E'\\n' ORDER BY pg_get_constraintdef(oid) COLLATE \"C\")) FROM pg_constraint"
+               f" WHERE conrelid='public.{TABLE}'::regclass AND contype<>'n') <> {q(md5(cons))} THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: constraint drift'; END IF;")
+    out.append(f"  IF NOT (SELECT relrowsecurity AND NOT relforcerowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.{TABLE}'::regclass)"
+               " THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: RLS flag drift'; END IF;")
+    out.append("END $pins$;")
+    return "\n".join(out)
+
+
+def build():
+    t = (H / "install.template.sql").read_text()
+    a10acl = ",".join(q(a) for a in sorted(fn("platform_private.global_product_fiscal_before_write()")["acl"]))
+    s = t.replace("-- @@PINS@@", pins()).replace("@@A10_ACL@@", a10acl)
+    (H / "install.sql.review").write_text(s)
+    meta = dict(policies=policies(), triggers=triggers(), grants=grants(), default_acl=default_acl(),
+                constraints=constraints(), functions={s: md5(fn(s)["definition"]) for s in PINNED_FUNCS})
+    (H / "pre-pins.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
+    return s
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    build()
+    print(hashlib.sha256((H / "install.sql.review").read_bytes()).hexdigest())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Reconciliação 09/10/13 da fundação ownership sobre definições LIVE capturadas (READ ONLY).
+
+NO_GO. Gera apenas arquivos *.sql.review. Não conecta a nenhum banco.
+Delta mínimo = definição LIVE atual + filtro ownership global-only do candidato original.
+Nunca reverte guards/CAS/isolamento atuais; nunca troca só o hash esperado.
+Substituições ancoradas: cada âncora deve ocorrer exatamente N vezes, senão aborta.
+"""
+import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, sys
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+EVID = ROOT / "docs/auditorias/evidencias/reconciliacao-fiscal-catalogo-20261101/foundation-live-pins-20261101"
+RBAC = ROOT / "scripts/rbac-audit"
+LIVE = json.loads((EVID / "live_foundation_pins.json").read_text())
+MANIFEST = json.loads((RBAC / "ownership-ordered-manifest.json").read_text())
+
+ORIG_EXPECTED = {"09": "e3b94ad47b93b02c9717a6a694163552", "10": "5e364c8f67c92fb31ff9568310eb876c",
+                 "13": "806751acb0477165ed863320ab24c6d0"}
+SIG = {"09": "public.rpc_cc_validate_matrix(uuid, text, uuid, uuid)",
+       "10": "public.rpc_fiscal_draft_save(uuid, jsonb, jsonb, integer)",
+       "13": "platform_private.catalog_tenant_set_visibility_core(text, uuid, boolean, integer, text, uuid)"}
+FILES = {"09": "proposed-tenant-catalog-ownership-09-commercial-matrix.sql",
+         "10": "proposed-tenant-catalog-ownership-10-global-roots.sql",
+         "13": "proposed-tenant-catalog-ownership-13-visibility-target.sql"}
+
+# Âncoras de hardening atual que DEVEM sobreviver no candidato reconciliado (prova pós-replace).
+MUST_KEEP = {
+    "09": ["platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(p_buyer_scope,p_partner_id,p_customer_id)",
+           "platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(i.assignment_id", "platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(assignment_id",
+           "public.fn_cc_can_prepare(auth.uid())"],
+    "10": ["PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();", "public.h15_require_invoice(p_invoice_id)",
+           "draft_version IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_version", "USING ERRCODE = 'PT409'",
+           "AND draft_version = p_expected_version;", "AND public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)"],
+    "13": ["USING ERRCODE='PT409'", "pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws(':','ctvk'",
+           "catalog_tenant_visibility_ledger", "platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate')"],
+}
+MUST_ADD = {"09": "owner_organization_id IS NULL", "10": "pr.owner_organization_id IS NULL",
+            "13": "owner_organization_id IS NULL"}
+
+# (âncora, substituição, ocorrências exatas)
+DELTAS = {
+    "09": [("     WHERE COALESCE(p.ativo,true)\n", "     WHERE p.owner_organization_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.ativo,true)\n", 1),
+           ("     WHERE COALESCE(m.ativo,true)\n", "     WHERE m.owner_organization_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(m.ativo,true)\n", 1)],
+    "10": [("SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = v_source_id)",
+            "SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = v_source_id AND pr.owner_organization_id IS NULL)", 1)],
+    "13": [("FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_entity_id;", "FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_entity_id AND owner_organization_id IS NULL;", 1),
+           ("FROM public.microrganismos WHERE id=p_entity_id;", "FROM public.microrganismos WHERE id=p_entity_id AND owner_organization_id IS NULL;", 1),
+           ("FROM public.culturas WHERE id=p_entity_id;", "FROM public.culturas WHERE id=p_entity_id AND owner_organization_id IS NULL;", 1)],
+}
+
+
+def md5(s): return hashlib.md5(s.encode()).hexdigest()
+def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def live_def(k):
+    f = next(x for x in LIVE["functions"] if x["signature"] == SIG[k])
+    if md5(f["definition"]) != f["md5"]:
+        sys.exit(f"captura {k} md5 divergente do próprio pin")
+    return f["definition"], f["md5"]
+
+
+def reconcile(k):
+    body, pin = live_def(k)
+    out = body
+    for a, b, n in DELTAS[k]:
+        c = out.count(a)
+        if c != n:
+            sys.exit(f"{k}: âncora {a!r} ocorre {c}x (esperado {n})")
+        out = out.replace(a, b)
+    for m in MUST_KEEP[k]:
+        if m not in out:
+            sys.exit(f"{k}: hardening atual perdido: {m}")
+    return body, pin, out
+
+
+def lit(s): return "'" + s.replace("'", "''") + "'"
+
+
+def post_guard(k, tag):
+    checks = "\n".join(f"  IF strpos(v_def, {lit(m)}) = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '{tag}_post_hardening_lost'; END IF;"
+                       for m in MUST_KEEP[k] + [MUST_ADD[k]])
+    return (f"DO $post$ DECLARE v_def text := pg_get_functiondef({lit(SIG[k])}::regprocedure); BEGIN\n{checks}\nEND $post$;\n")
+
+
+def emit_file(k, live_body, pin, rec):
+    src = (RBAC / FILES[k]).read_text()
+    if ORIG_EXPECTED[k] not in src:
+        sys.exit(f"{k}: hash original não encontrado no arquivo fonte")
+    head = rec.rstrip("\n") + ";\n"
+    if k == "10":
+        i = src.index("CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_draft_save")
+        j = src.index("$function$;", src.index("AS $function$", i) + 13) + len("$function$;")
+        new = src[:i] + head + post_guard(k, "ownership10r") + src[j + 1:]
+    else:
+        i = src.index("CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION")
+        j = src.index("$function$;", src.index("AS $function$", i) + 13) + len("$function$;")
+        new = src[:i] + head + post_guard(k, f"ownership{k}r") + src[j + 1:]
+    assert new.count(ORIG_EXPECTED[k]) == 1
+    new = new.replace(ORIG_EXPECTED[k], pin)
+    banner = (f"-- RECONCILIADO {k}r (NO_GO, NÃO APLICAR). Fonte original preservada em scripts/rbac-audit/{FILES[k]}.\n"
+              f"-- Pin original {ORIG_EXPECTED[k]} DIVERGE do live {pin} (captura READ ONLY 2026-11-01).\n"
+              "-- Corpo = definição LIVE + filtro ownership global-only; guards/CAS/isolamento atuais preservados\n"
+              "-- e reverificados após o REPLACE. Requer 00-pre-global aprovado na MESMA transação.\n")
+    return banner + new
+
+
+def pre_global():
+    pins = []
+    for c in LIVE["comparison"]:
+        pins.append((c["signature"], c["actual"]))
+    rows = ",\n".join(f"    ({lit(s)}, {lit(h)})" for s, h in pins)
+    absent = ["platform_private.catalog_ownership_enabled()"]
+    return f"""-- 00 PRE GLOBAL da fundação ownership — NO_GO, NÃO APLICAR.
+-- Somente leitura: executa em transação READ ONLY; qualquer write falharia (25006).
+-- Valida TODAS as dependências/pins ANTES da primeira DDL do arquivo 01. Se qualquer item
+-- falhar, aborta sem nenhuma alteração. Pins = live READ ONLY 2026-11-01 ({LIVE['project_ref']}).
+-- 17 pins: 14 iguais ao original, 3 reconciliados (09/10/13) com delta mínimo revisado.
+BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
+DO $pre$
+DECLARE r record; v_fail text[] := ARRAY[]::text[]; v_md5 text;
+BEGIN
+  IF current_setting('transaction_read_only') <> 'on' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pre_global_must_be_read_only'; END IF;
+  FOR r IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES
+{rows}
+  ) AS t(sig, pin) LOOP
+    IF to_regprocedure(r.sig) IS NULL THEN v_fail := v_fail || ('missing:' || r.sig);
+    ELSE
+      v_md5 := md5(pg_get_functiondef(to_regprocedure(r.sig)));
+      IF v_md5 <> r.pin THEN v_fail := v_fail || ('drift:' || r.sig || ':' || v_md5); END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  -- Estado anterior auditado: fundação NÃO instalada. Presença parcial => abortar.
+  IF to_regprocedure('platform_private.catalog_ownership_enabled()') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_fail := v_fail || 'partial:catalog_ownership_enabled_present'::text; END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
+             WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('produtos','microrganismos','culturas')
+               AND a.attname='owner_organization_id' AND NOT a.attisdropped) THEN
+    v_fail := v_fail || 'partial:owner_organization_id_present'::text; END IF;
+  -- Dependências referenciadas pelos deltas reconciliados.
+  IF to_regprocedure('platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(text,uuid,uuid)') IS NULL THEN v_fail := v_fail || 'dep:c2p1_assignment_allowed'::text; END IF;
+  IF to_regprocedure('platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(uuid,uuid,text,uuid,uuid)') IS NULL THEN v_fail := v_fail || 'dep:c2p1_item_allowed'::text; END IF;
+  IF to_regprocedure('platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor(text)') IS NULL THEN v_fail := v_fail || 'dep:catalog_tenant_actor'::text; END IF;
+  IF to_regprocedure('public.h15_company_access(uuid)') IS NULL THEN v_fail := v_fail || 'dep:h15_company_access'::text; END IF;
+  FOREACH v_md5 IN ARRAY ARRAY['produtos','microrganismos','culturas','commercial_condition_item_prices',
+      'catalog_tenant_visibility','catalog_tenant_visibility_ledger','fiscal_invoices','fiscal_invoice_items'] LOOP
+    IF to_regclass('public.' || v_md5) IS NULL THEN v_fail := v_fail || ('dep:table:' || v_md5); END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF cardinality(v_fail) > 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ownership_pre_global_failed' USING DETAIL = array_to_string(v_fail, ' | ');
+  END IF;
+END $pre$;
+COMMIT;
+"""
+
+
+def main():
+    out = {}
+    comparisons = []
+    for c in LIVE["comparison"]:
+        comparisons.append(dict(file=c["file"], signature=c["signature"], expected_original=c["expected"],
+                                actual_live=c["actual"], equal=c["expected"] == c["actual"],
+                                resolution=("unchanged" if c["expected"] == c["actual"] else "reconciled_minimal_delta")))
+    assert len(comparisons) == 17 and sum(x["equal"] for x in comparisons) == 14
+    for k in ("09", "10", "13"):
+        body, pin, rec = reconcile(k)
+        assert pin != ORIG_EXPECTED[k]
+        name = FILES[k].replace(".sql", "-reconciled.sql.review")
+        (HERE / name).write_text(emit_file(k, body, pin, rec))
+        (HERE / f"reconciled-{k}.function.sql").write_text(rec)
+        out[k] = dict(file=name, live_md5=pin, original_expected=ORIG_EXPECTED[k],
+                      reconciled_body_md5_textual=md5(rec), deltas=[a for a, _, _ in DELTAS[k]])
+    (HERE / "00-pre-global-foundation.sql.review").write_text(pre_global())
+    manifest_order = [f["path"] for f in MANIFEST["files"]]
+    pins = dict(project_ref=LIVE["project_ref"], status="NO_GO", apply_authorized=False,
+                comparisons=comparisons, reconciled=out, manifest_order=manifest_order,
+                original_manifest_sha256={f["path"]: f["sha256"] for f in MANIFEST["files"]},
+                original_sources_sha256={FILES[k]: sha(RBAC / FILES[k]) for k in FILES},
+                live_capture_sha256=sha(EVID / "live_foundation_pins.json"),
+                generated_sha256={p.name: sha(p) for p in sorted(HERE.glob("*.review"))})
+    (HERE / "foundation-pins.json").write_text(json.dumps(pins, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
+    print(json.dumps({k: v["file"] for k, v in out.items()}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""PostgreSQL DESCARTÁVEL para PRE GLOBAL + reconciliação 09/10/13. Zero hosted.
+
+Usa as 3 definições LIVE capturadas verbatim + stubs sintéticos para dependências.
+Os 14 pins iguais não têm corpo capturado: são stubs cujo md5 local substitui o pin
+(classificado PG_SEAM_STUB_PIN, não prova da fundação instalada).
+"""
+import json, os, pathlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
+
+HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
+OUT = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/tmp/foundation-delta-run")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+LOG = open(OUT / "harness.log", "w")
+LIVE = json.loads((ROOT / "docs/auditorias/evidencias/reconciliacao-fiscal-catalogo-20261101/foundation-live-pins-20261101/live_foundation_pins.json").read_text())
+RBAC = ROOT / "scripts/rbac-audit"
+checks = []
+
+
+def check(cid, scen, exp, act, kind="PG_DISPOSABLE_CAPTURED_DEFS_SYNTHETIC_AUTH"):
+    r = dict(id=cid, scenario=scen, expected=exp, actual=act, status="PASS" if exp == act else "FAIL", kind=kind)
+    checks.append(r); print(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+class PG:
+    def __init__(self):
+        for v in [k for k in os.environ if k.startswith("PG")]: os.environ.pop(v)
+        self.d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="pgfound-"); os.chown(self.d, 1000, 1000)
+        self.port = str(57000 + os.getpid() % 900)
+        self.as_ = ["setpriv", "--reuid=1000", "--regid=1000", "--clear-groups"] if os.getuid() == 0 else []
+        subprocess.run(self.as_ + ["initdb", "-D", f"{self.d}/data", "-U", "postgres", "-A", "trust", "-E", "UTF8"], check=True, capture_output=True)
+        subprocess.run(self.as_ + ["pg_ctl", "-D", f"{self.d}/data", "-o", f"-p {self.port} -k {self.d} -c listen_addresses=''",
+                                   "-l", f"{self.d}/log", "-w", "start"], check=True, capture_output=True)
+
+    def sql(self, s, ok=True):
+        r = subprocess.run(["psql", "-X", "-q", "-At", "-h", self.d, "-p", self.port, "-U", "postgres", "-d", "postgres",
+                            "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1"], input=s, text=True, capture_output=True)
+        LOG.write(f"--- ok={ok} rc={r.returncode}\n{s[:400]}\n>> {r.stdout[-600:]}{r.stderr[-600:]}\n"); LOG.flush()
+        if ok and r.returncode: raise RuntimeError(r.stderr)
+        return r.stdout.strip() if r.returncode == 0 else "ERR:" + r.stderr.strip()
+
+    def stop(self):
+        subprocess.run(self.as_ + ["pg_ctl", "-D", f"{self.d}/data", "-m", "immediate", "stop"], capture_output=True)
+        shutil.rmtree(self.d, ignore_errors=True)
+

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_cc_validate_matrix(p_plan_id uuid, p_buyer_scope text, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_missing jsonb; v_drafts int; v_quote int;
+BEGIN
+ IF NOT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(p_buyer_scope,p_partner_id,p_customer_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NOT public.fn_cc_can_prepare(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('tipo',tipo,'id',id,'nome',nome)),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_missing
+  FROM (
+    SELECT 'produto' tipo, p.id, p.nome FROM public.produtos p
+     WHERE p.owner_organization_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.ativo,true)
+       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
+            WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(i.assignment_id,i.plan_id,i.buyer_scope,i.partner_id,i.customer_id) AND i.plan_id=p_plan_id AND i.product_id=p.id AND i.buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
+              AND i.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
+              AND i.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id
+              AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval','published'))
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT 'microrganismo', m.id, m.nome FROM public.microrganismos m
+     WHERE m.owner_organization_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(m.ativo,true)
+       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
+            WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(i.assignment_id,i.plan_id,i.buyer_scope,i.partner_id,i.customer_id) AND i.plan_id=p_plan_id AND i.microrganismo_id=m.id AND i.buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
+              AND i.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
+              AND i.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id
+              AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval','published'))
+  ) s;
+  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='draft'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE pricing_mode='quote_only')
+    INTO v_drafts, v_quote
+  FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices
+   WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(assignment_id,plan_id,buyer_scope,partner_id,customer_id) AND plan_id=p_plan_id AND buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
+     AND partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
+     AND customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id;
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', jsonb_array_length(v_missing)=0,
+    'missing_items', v_missing, 'draft_count', COALESCE(v_drafts,0), 'quote_only_count', COALESCE(v_quote,0));
+END $function$;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.partner_apply_default_discount(p_partner_id uuid)
+ RETURNS integer
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_desc numeric(5,2);
+  v_count integer := 0;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required'; END IF;
+  IF NOT (has_role(v_uid, 'administrador') OR has_role(v_uid, 'gestor_comercial')) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT desconto_padrao INTO v_desc FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id = p_partner_id AND ativo IS TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE;
+  IF v_desc IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'partner_not_found' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.partner_product_prices(partner_id, product_id, preco_tabela, desconto_percentual, preco_final, ativo)
+  SELECT p_partner_id, p.id,
+         COALESCE(p.valor_ha_brl, 0),
+         v_desc,
+         ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_ha_brl, 0) * (1 - v_desc/100.0), 2),
+         true
+  FROM public.produtos p
+  WHERE p.ativo = true AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL
+  ON CONFLICT (partner_id, product_id) WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE
+    SET preco_tabela = EXCLUDED.preco_tabela,
+        desconto_percentual = EXCLUDED.desconto_percentual,
+        preco_final = EXCLUDED.preco_final,
+        ativo = true;
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
+  RETURN v_count;
+END;
+$function$;

+BEGIN
+  v_def := pg_get_functiondef(v_oid);
