+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_draft_save(p_invoice_id uuid, p_invoice jsonb, p_items jsonb, p_expected_version integer)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_user           uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_row            public.fiscal_invoices;
+  v_new_id         uuid;
+  v_total          numeric(14,2) := 0;
+  v_item           jsonb;
+  v_seq            integer := 0;
+  v_env            text;
+  v_invoice_type   text;
+  v_customer_id    uuid;
+  v_qty            numeric;
+  v_unit           numeric;
+  v_gross          numeric;
+  v_disc           numeric;
+  v_net            numeric;
+  v_kind           text;
+  v_items_count    integer;
+  v_emit_uf        text;
+  v_dest_uf        text;
+  v_freight_total  numeric := 0;
+  v_insurance_total numeric := 0;
+  v_other_total    numeric := 0;
+  v_gross_arr      numeric[];
+  v_fr_arr         numeric[];
+  v_in_arr         numeric[];
+  v_ot_arr         numeric[];
+  v_computed_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_profile_snap   jsonb;
+  v_tax_snap       jsonb;
+  FORBIDDEN_KEYS   text[] := ARRAY[
+    'sefaz_key','access_key','protocol_number','authorization_number',
+    'authorized_at','authorization_xml','xml','pdf','signed_xml',
+    'cancel_protocol','provider_response'
+  ];
+  k text;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();
+  IF p_invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM public.h15_require_invoice(p_invoice_id); END IF;
+
+  IF v_user IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT (public.has_role(v_user, 'administrador'::app_role)
+          OR public.has_role(v_user, 'financeiro'::app_role)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_invoice IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_invoice) <> 'object' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invoice_object_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_items IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'items_array_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF public.fiscal_json_has_sensitive_key(p_invoice)
+     OR public.fiscal_json_has_sensitive_key(p_items) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sensitive_key_in_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  FOREACH k IN ARRAY FORBIDDEN_KEYS LOOP
+    IF p_invoice ? k THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'emission_field_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  v_items_count := jsonb_array_length(p_items);
+  IF v_items_count < 1 OR v_items_count > 500 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'items_count_out_of_range' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_invoice_type := COALESCE(p_invoice->>'invoice_type','');
+  IF v_invoice_type NOT IN ('NFE','NFSE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invoice_type_invalid' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_env := COALESCE(p_invoice->>'environment','NOT_CONFIGURED');
+  IF v_env NOT IN ('HOMOLOGATION','NOT_CONFIGURED') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'environment_not_allowed' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_customer_id := NULLIF(p_invoice->>'customer_id','')::uuid;
+  IF v_customer_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'customer_id_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes WHERE id = v_customer_id) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'customer_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- FASE C2/C3: UFs e encargos resolvidos no servidor (o cliente nao e autoridade).
+  SELECT upper(coalesce(state,'')) INTO v_emit_uf
+    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.company_fiscal_settings WHERE id = COALESCE((SELECT company_settings_id FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fiscal_invoices WHERE id=p_invoice_id),public.h15_active_company())) company_fiscal_settings WHERE is_active ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1;
+  SELECT upper(coalesce(fiscal_state,'')) INTO v_dest_uf
+    FROM public.customer_fiscal_profiles WHERE customer_id = v_customer_id;
+  v_dest_uf := coalesce(nullif(v_dest_uf,''), v_emit_uf);
+
+  v_freight_total   := round(coalesce(nullif(p_invoice->>'freight_value','')::numeric, 0), 2);
+  v_insurance_total := round(coalesce(nullif(p_invoice->>'insurance_value','')::numeric, 0), 2);
+  v_other_total     := round(coalesce(nullif(p_invoice->>'other_value','')::numeric, 0), 2);
+  IF v_freight_total < 0 OR v_insurance_total < 0 OR v_other_total < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invoice_charges_negative' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  FOR v_item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) LOOP
+    v_seq  := v_seq + 1;
+    v_kind := COALESCE(v_item->>'item_kind','');
+    IF v_invoice_type = 'NFE'  AND v_kind <> 'PRODUCT' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfe_requires_product_items' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_invoice_type = 'NFSE' AND v_kind <> 'SERVICE' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfse_requires_service_items' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_qty  := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_item->>'quantity','')::numeric, 0);
+    v_unit := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_item->>'unit_value','')::numeric, 0);
+    v_disc := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_item->>'discount_value','')::numeric, 0);
+
+    IF v_qty <= 0 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'item_quantity_must_be_positive' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_unit < 0 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'item_unit_value_negative' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_disc < 0 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'item_discount_negative' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_gross := round(v_qty * v_unit, 2);
+    IF v_disc > v_gross THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'item_discount_gt_gross' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    v_net  := round(v_gross - v_disc, 2);
+
+    -- 3.16.2-C: whitelist FAIL-CLOSED por item + verificação de source_item_id
+    DECLARE
+      v_item_profile jsonb := COALESCE(v_item->'fiscal_profile_snapshot', '{}'::jsonb);
+      v_item_tax     jsonb := COALESCE(v_item->'tax_snapshot', '{}'::jsonb);
+      v_item_input   jsonb := COALESCE(v_item->'tax_input_snapshot', '{}'::jsonb);
+      v_source_id    uuid  := NULLIF(v_item->>'source_item_id','')::uuid;
+      v_icms_obj     jsonb;
+      v_pis_obj      jsonb;
+      v_cofins_obj   jsonb;
+      v_ipi_obj      jsonb;
+      v_rate         numeric;
+      v_pfp          public.product_fiscal_profiles%ROWTYPE;
+      v_ncm_s        text;
+      v_cest_s       text;
+      v_orig_s       text;
+      v_cfop_s       text;
+      v_cst_s        text;
+      v_csosn_s      text;
+      v_withheld     jsonb;
+      v_rets         jsonb;
+    BEGIN
+      IF jsonb_typeof(v_item_profile) <> 'object' THEN v_item_profile := '{}'::jsonb; END IF;
+      IF jsonb_typeof(v_item_tax)     <> 'object' THEN v_item_tax     := '{}'::jsonb; END IF;
+      IF jsonb_typeof(v_item_input)   <> 'object' THEN v_item_input   := '{}'::jsonb; END IF;
+      IF NOT public.fn_fiscal_tax_input_valid(v_item_input) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_input_snapshot_invalid:%', v_seq USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END IF;
+      IF public.fiscal_json_has_sensitive_key(v_item_profile)
+         OR public.fiscal_json_has_sensitive_key(v_item_tax) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'sensitive_key_in_snapshot' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END IF;
+
+      IF v_invoice_type = 'NFE' THEN
+        -- Whitelist do perfil NF-e
+        PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(
+          v_item_profile,
+          ARRAY['ncm','cest','cfop','origem_mercadoria','cst_icms','csosn','unidade'],
+          'nfe_profile'
+        );
+        -- Whitelist da tributação NF-e (somente configuração preparatória)
+        PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(
+          v_item_tax, ARRAY['pis','cofins','ipi','icms'], 'nfe_tax'
+        );
+        v_icms_obj   := v_item_tax->'icms';
+        v_pis_obj    := v_item_tax->'pis';
+        v_cofins_obj := v_item_tax->'cofins';
+        v_ipi_obj    := v_item_tax->'ipi';
+        IF v_icms_obj IS NOT NULL THEN
+          IF jsonb_typeof(v_icms_obj) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfe_tax_icms_not_object' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
+          PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(
+            v_icms_obj, ARRAY['cst','csosn','aliquota','base_calculo_modalidade'], 'nfe_tax.icms'
+          );
+        END IF;
+        IF v_pis_obj IS NOT NULL THEN
+          IF jsonb_typeof(v_pis_obj) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfe_tax_pis_not_object' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
+          PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(v_pis_obj, ARRAY['cst','aliquota'], 'nfe_tax.pis');
+        END IF;
+        IF v_cofins_obj IS NOT NULL THEN
+          IF jsonb_typeof(v_cofins_obj) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfe_tax_cofins_not_object' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
+          PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(v_cofins_obj, ARRAY['cst','aliquota'], 'nfe_tax.cofins');
+        END IF;
+        IF v_ipi_obj IS NOT NULL THEN
+          IF jsonb_typeof(v_ipi_obj) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfe_tax_ipi_not_object' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
+          PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(v_ipi_obj, ARRAY['cst','aliquota'], 'nfe_tax.ipi');
+        END IF;
+
+        -- Verificação de existência do source_item_id (produto + perfil)
+        IF v_source_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+          IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = v_source_id AND pr.owner_organization_id IS NULL) THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'source_item_product_not_found:%', v_seq USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+          END IF;
+          SELECT * INTO v_pfp FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles pfp
+            WHERE pfp.product_id = v_source_id AND pfp.is_active = true LIMIT 1;
+          IF NOT FOUND THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'source_item_product_profile_missing:%', v_seq USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+          END IF;
+        END IF;
+
+        -- FASE C2: materializacao server-side dos snapshots fisicos do item.
+        v_ncm_s   := nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_pfp.ncm,        v_item_profile->>'ncm',              '')), '');
+        v_cest_s  := nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_pfp.cest,       v_item_profile->>'cest',             '')), '');
+        v_orig_s  := nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_pfp.origin_code,v_item_profile->>'origem_mercadoria','')), '');
+        v_cfop_s  := nullif(btrim(coalesce(
+                        CASE WHEN v_dest_uf = v_emit_uf THEN v_pfp.cfop_in_state ELSE v_pfp.cfop_interstate END,
+                        v_item_profile->>'cfop', '')), '');
+        v_cst_s   := nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_pfp.icms_cst,   v_item_profile->>'cst_icms', '')), '');
+        v_csosn_s := nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_pfp.icms_csosn, v_item_profile->>'csosn',    '')), '');
+        IF v_ncm_s IS NULL THEN
+          RAISE EXCEPTION 'item_ncm_unresolved:%', v_seq USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+        END IF;
+      ELSE
+        -- NFS-e
+        PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(
+          v_item_profile,
+          ARRAY['lc116_item','cnae','municipal_tax_code','national_tax_code','municipality_ibge_code'],
+          'nfse_profile'
+        );
+        PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(
+          v_item_tax, ARRAY['iss_rate','iss_withheld','retencoes_suportadas'], 'nfse_tax'
+        );
+        IF v_item_tax ? 'iss_rate' THEN
+          IF jsonb_typeof(v_item_tax->'iss_rate') <> 'number' THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfse_iss_rate_not_number' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+          END IF;
+          v_rate := (v_item_tax->>'iss_rate')::numeric;
+          IF v_rate < 0 OR v_rate > 100 THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfse_iss_rate_out_of_range' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+          END IF;
+        END IF;
+        v_withheld := v_item_tax->'iss_withheld';
+        IF v_withheld IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(v_withheld) <> 'boolean' THEN
+          RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfse_iss_withheld_not_boolean' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+        END IF;
+        v_rets := v_item_tax->'retencoes_suportadas';
+        IF v_rets IS NOT NULL THEN
+          IF jsonb_typeof(v_rets) <> 'object' THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'nfse_retencoes_not_object' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+          END IF;
+          PERFORM public.fiscal_validate_snapshot_keys(
+            v_rets, ARRAY['pis','cofins','csll','irrf','inss'], 'nfse_tax.retencoes_suportadas'
+          );
+        END IF;
+
+        IF v_source_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+          IF NOT EXISTS (
+            SELECT 1 FROM public.service_fiscal_profiles sfp
+            WHERE sfp.service_id = v_source_id AND sfp.is_active = true
+          ) THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'source_item_service_profile_missing:%', v_seq USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+          END IF;
+        END IF;
+      END IF;
+
+      v_computed_items := v_computed_items || jsonb_build_object(
+        'seq', v_seq,
+        'item_kind', v_kind,
+        'description', COALESCE(v_item->>'description',''),
+        'quantity', v_qty,
+        'commercial_unit', v_item->>'commercial_unit',
+        'unit_value', v_unit,
+        'gross_value', v_gross,
+        'discount_value', v_disc,
+        'net_value', v_net,
+        'source_item_type', v_item->>'source_item_type',
+        'source_item_id',   NULLIF(v_item->>'source_item_id','')::uuid,
+        'fiscal_profile_snapshot', v_item_profile,
+        'tax_snapshot',            v_item_tax,
+        'tax_input_snapshot',      v_item_input,
+        'ncm_snapshot',       v_ncm_s,
+        'cest_snapshot',      v_cest_s,
+        'origem_snapshot',    v_orig_s,
+        'cfop_snapshot',      v_cfop_s,
+        'cst_icms_snapshot',  v_cst_s,
+        'csosn_snapshot',     v_csosn_s
+      );
+    END;
+    v_total := v_total + v_net;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  -- FASE C3: rateio canonico server-side, proporcional ao valor bruto, sem perder centavos.
+  SELECT array_agg((it->>'gross_value')::numeric ORDER BY (it->>'seq')::integer)
+    INTO v_gross_arr FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_computed_items) it;
+  v_fr_arr := public.fn_fiscal_apportion_v1(v_freight_total,   v_gross_arr);
+  v_in_arr := public.fn_fiscal_apportion_v1(v_insurance_total, v_gross_arr);
+  v_ot_arr := public.fn_fiscal_apportion_v1(v_other_total,     v_gross_arr);
+  v_total := round(v_total + v_freight_total + v_insurance_total + v_other_total, 2);
+
+  v_profile_snap := COALESCE(p_invoice->'fiscal_profile_snapshot', '{}'::jsonb);
+  v_tax_snap     := COALESCE(p_invoice->'tax_snapshot', '{}'::jsonb);
+  IF jsonb_typeof(v_profile_snap) <> 'object' THEN v_profile_snap := '{}'::jsonb; END IF;
+  IF jsonb_typeof(v_tax_snap)     <> 'object' THEN v_tax_snap     := '{}'::jsonb; END IF;
+  IF public.fiscal_json_has_sensitive_key(v_profile_snap)
+     OR public.fiscal_json_has_sensitive_key(v_tax_snap) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sensitive_key_in_snapshot' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_invoice_id IS NULL THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.fiscal_invoices (company_settings_id, 
+      invoice_type, document_model, document_origin, environment, provider,
+      status, normalized_status, series, issue_date, notes,
+      company_cnpj, customer_id, receivable_id, delivery_id,
+      customer_snapshot, company_snapshot, fiscal_totals_snapshot,
+      fiscal_profile_snapshot, tax_snapshot,
+      draft_version, created_by, total_amount
+    ) VALUES (public.h15_active_company(), 
+      v_invoice_type,
+      p_invoice->>'document_model',
+      'MANUAL_RECORD',
+      v_env,
+      'NONE',
+      'DRAFT',
+      'DRAFT',
+      p_invoice->>'series',
+      NULLIF(p_invoice->>'issue_date','')::date,
+      p_invoice->>'notes',
+      p_invoice->>'company_cnpj',
+      v_customer_id,
+      NULLIF(p_invoice->>'receivable_id','')::uuid,
+      NULLIF(p_invoice->>'delivery_id','')::uuid,
+      COALESCE(p_invoice->'customer_snapshot','{}'::jsonb),
+      COALESCE(p_invoice->'company_snapshot','{}'::jsonb),
+      jsonb_build_object('total_net', v_total, 'vFrete', v_freight_total, 'vSeg', v_insurance_total, 'vOutro', v_other_total, 'computed_at', now()),
+      v_profile_snap,
+      v_tax_snap,
+      1,
+      v_user,
+      v_total
+    ) RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;
+  ELSE
+    SELECT * INTO v_row FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fiscal_invoices WHERE id = p_invoice_id FOR UPDATE;
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invoice_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
+    PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();
+    PERFORM public.h15_require_invoice(p_invoice_id);
+    IF NOT (public.has_role(v_user,'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(v_user,'financeiro'::public.app_role)) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_row.locked_at IS NOT NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invoice_locked' USING ERRCODE = '55006';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_row.status <> 'DRAFT' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invoice_not_editable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_row.provider <> 'NONE' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invoice_has_provider' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_row.document_origin <> 'MANUAL_RECORD' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invoice_origin_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF p_expected_version IS NULL OR p_expected_version < 1 OR v_row.draft_version IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_version THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'conflict' USING ERRCODE = 'PT409';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.fiscal_invoices SET
+      invoice_type      = v_invoice_type,
+      document_model    = COALESCE(p_invoice->>'document_model', document_model),
+      document_origin   = 'MANUAL_RECORD',
+      environment       = v_env,
+      provider          = 'NONE',
+      status            = 'DRAFT',
+      normalized_status = 'DRAFT',
+      series            = COALESCE(p_invoice->>'series', series),
+      issue_date        = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_invoice->>'issue_date','')::date, issue_date),
+      notes             = COALESCE(p_invoice->>'notes', notes),
+      customer_id       = v_customer_id,
+      customer_snapshot = COALESCE(p_invoice->'customer_snapshot', customer_snapshot),
+      fiscal_profile_snapshot = v_profile_snap,
+      tax_snapshot            = v_tax_snap,
+      fiscal_totals_snapshot  = jsonb_build_object('total_net', v_total, 'vFrete', v_freight_total, 'vSeg', v_insurance_total, 'vOutro', v_other_total, 'computed_at', now()),
+      total_amount            = v_total,
+      draft_version           = draft_version + 1,
+      updated_at              = now()
+    WHERE id = p_invoice_id
+      AND company_settings_id = v_row.company_settings_id
+      AND public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)
+      AND draft_version = p_expected_version;
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'conflict' USING ERRCODE = 'PT409'; END IF;
+    v_new_id := p_invoice_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  DELETE FROM public.fiscal_invoice_items WHERE fiscal_invoice_id = v_new_id;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.fiscal_invoice_items (
+    fiscal_invoice_id, item_sequence, item_kind, description,
+    quantity, commercial_unit, unit_value, gross_value, discount_value, net_value,
+    source_item_type, source_item_id,
+    fiscal_profile_snapshot, tax_snapshot, tax_input_snapshot,
+    ncm_snapshot, cest_snapshot, origem_snapshot, cfop_snapshot,
+    cst_icms_snapshot, csosn_snapshot,
+    freight_value, insurance_value, other_value
+  )
+  SELECT
+    v_new_id,
+    (it->>'seq')::integer,
+    it->>'item_kind',
+    it->>'description',
+    (it->>'quantity')::numeric,
+    it->>'commercial_unit',
+    (it->>'unit_value')::numeric,
+    (it->>'gross_value')::numeric,
+    (it->>'discount_value')::numeric,
+    (it->>'net_value')::numeric,
+    it->>'source_item_type',
+    NULLIF(it->>'source_item_id','')::uuid,
+    COALESCE(it->'fiscal_profile_snapshot','{}'::jsonb),
+    COALESCE(it->'tax_snapshot','{}'::jsonb),
+    COALESCE(it->'tax_input_snapshot','{}'::jsonb),
+    it->>'ncm_snapshot',
+    it->>'cest_snapshot',
+    it->>'origem_snapshot',
+    it->>'cfop_snapshot',
+    it->>'cst_icms_snapshot',
+    it->>'csosn_snapshot',
+    COALESCE(v_fr_arr[(it->>'seq')::integer], 0),
+    COALESCE(v_in_arr[(it->>'seq')::integer], 0),
+    COALESCE(v_ot_arr[(it->>'seq')::integer], 0)
+  FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_computed_items) AS it;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_row FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fiscal_invoices WHERE id = v_new_id;
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'id',            v_row.id,
+    'draft_version', v_row.draft_version,
+    'total_amount',  v_row.total_amount
+  );
+END;
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_tenant_set_visibility_core(p_entity_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_hidden boolean, p_expected_version integer, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_org uuid;
+  v_reason text := btrim(COALESCE(p_reason,''));
+  v_hash text;
+  v_prev public.catalog_tenant_visibility%ROWTYPE;
+  v_ledger public.catalog_tenant_visibility_ledger%ROWTYPE;
+  v_ativo boolean;
+  v_new_version integer;
+  v_result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');
+  IF p_entity_type IS NULL OR p_entity_type NOT IN ('produto','microrganismo','cultura') OR p_entity_id IS NULL
+     OR p_hidden IS NULL OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR p_expected_version IS NULL OR p_expected_version < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_invalid_payload' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF char_length(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 500 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_reason_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  v_hash := md5(concat_ws('|', p_entity_type, p_entity_id::text, p_hidden::text, p_expected_version::text, v_reason));
+
+  -- Ordem fixa de locks: (1) ator+empresa+chave — serializa replay/conflito da MESMA chave mesmo em itens
+  -- distintos; (2) empresa+item — serializa primeira gravação/CAS. Sempre nesta ordem (sem deadlock cruzado).
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws(':','ctvk',v_uid::text,v_org::text,p_idempotency_key::text),0));
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws(':','ctv',v_org::text,p_entity_type,p_entity_id::text),0));
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_ledger FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility_ledger
+   WHERE actor_id=v_uid AND organization_id=v_org AND idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_ledger.payload_hash <> v_hash THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_idempotency_conflict' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    RETURN v_ledger.result || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Item global existente; inativo não pode ser exibido (preferência não reativa).
+  IF p_entity_type='produto' THEN SELECT ativo INTO v_ativo FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_entity_id AND owner_organization_id IS NULL;
+  ELSIF p_entity_type='microrganismo' THEN SELECT ativo INTO v_ativo FROM public.microrganismos WHERE id=p_entity_id AND owner_organization_id IS NULL;
+  ELSE SELECT ativo INTO v_ativo FROM public.culturas WHERE id=p_entity_id AND owner_organization_id IS NULL; END IF;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_item_not_found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
+  IF v_ativo IS NOT TRUE AND p_hidden IS FALSE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_item_inactive' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_prev FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility
+   WHERE organization_id=v_org AND entity_type=p_entity_type
+     AND COALESCE(produto_id,microrganismo_id,cultura_id)=p_entity_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF COALESCE(v_prev.version,0) <> p_expected_version THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_version_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  IF v_prev.id IS NOT NULL AND v_prev.hidden = p_hidden THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_no_change' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF v_prev.id IS NULL AND p_hidden IS FALSE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_no_change' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+
+  v_new_version := p_expected_version + 1;
+  IF v_prev.id IS NULL THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.catalog_tenant_visibility(organization_id,entity_type,produto_id,microrganismo_id,cultura_id,hidden,version,reason,updated_by)
+    VALUES (v_org,p_entity_type,
+      CASE WHEN p_entity_type='produto' THEN p_entity_id END,
+      CASE WHEN p_entity_type='microrganismo' THEN p_entity_id END,
+      CASE WHEN p_entity_type='cultura' THEN p_entity_id END,
+      p_hidden,v_new_version,v_reason,v_uid);
+  ELSE
+    UPDATE public.catalog_tenant_visibility SET hidden=p_hidden, version=v_new_version, reason=v_reason,
+      updated_by=v_uid, updated_at=now()
+     WHERE id=v_prev.id AND version=p_expected_version;
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_version_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_result := jsonb_build_object('entity_type',p_entity_type,'entity_id',p_entity_id,'hidden',p_hidden,
+    'version',v_new_version,'replayed',false);
+  INSERT INTO public.catalog_tenant_visibility_ledger(organization_id,actor_id,idempotency_key,payload_hash,entity_type,entity_id,
+    before_state,after_state,reason,result)
+  VALUES (v_org,v_uid,p_idempotency_key,v_hash,p_entity_type,p_entity_id,
+    CASE WHEN v_prev.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('hidden',v_prev.hidden,'version',v_prev.version) END,
+    jsonb_build_object('hidden',p_hidden,'version',v_new_version),v_reason,v_result);
+  RETURN v_result;
+END; $function$

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- gate próprio (desligado)
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate (
+  singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK (singleton),
+  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false

+INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate VALUES (true, false);

+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled() RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+  SELECT platform_private.catalog_ownership_enabled()
+     AND COALESCE((SELECT enabled FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate WHERE singleton), false) $$;

+-- Ator de empresa: empresa ativa do ator real (h15) com papel exigido; nunca SA; nunca GUC/payload.
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(p_write boolean) RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL OR NOT platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled()
+     OR public.is_platform_superadmin(v_uid)
+     OR NOT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(v_uid) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
+  IF v_org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NOT (platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'administrador') OR platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'financeiro')
+          OR (NOT p_write AND platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'gestor'))) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  RETURN v_org;
+END $$;

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- recibos e permissões privadas
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts (
+  idempotency_key uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  actor_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, product_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  request jsonb NOT NULL, receipt jsonb NOT NULL,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Prova privada one-shot: txid + ator + empresa + produto + operação. Só o writer DEFINER grava;
+-- o gatilho a10 consome (DELETE ... RETURNING) e reautoriza. Nenhuma GUC participa.
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits (
+  txid bigint NOT NULL, product_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  actor_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  op text NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('INSERT','UPDATE')),
+  PRIMARY KEY (txid, product_id)
+);
+REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- composição com a10 (guard global preservado)
+-- Ramo global (produto sem dono) = corpo capturado, inalterado. Ramo próprio exige a prova privada
+-- e reautoriza o ator NESTE ponto (depois de a00 e de todos os locks do writer).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.global_product_fiscal_before_write()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_owner uuid; v_permit platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+ SELECT p.owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND v_owner IS NULL THEN
+  SELECT p.owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = OLD.product_id;
+ END IF;
+ IF v_owner IS NULL THEN
+  IF NOT platform_private.global_product_fiscal_write_ready() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ ELSE
+  DELETE FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits w
+   WHERE w.txid = pg_catalog.txid_current() AND w.product_id = NEW.product_id
+     AND w.actor_id = auth.uid() AND w.organization_id = v_owner AND w.op = TG_OP
+  RETURNING * INTO v_permit;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner THEN
+   RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
+  IF OLD.is_active IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.product_id OR NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
+  -- Server-owned CAS token for ALL direct editor and IBS/CBS updates.
+  -- Strictly newer even inside one transaction; caller timestamps are ignored.
+  -- The existing AFTER fiscal audit observes this token in the same transaction.
+  NEW.updated_at:=greatest(clock_timestamp(),OLD.updated_at+interval '1 microsecond');
+ ELSE NEW.updated_at:=clock_timestamp(); END IF;
+ RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- RLS restritiva (do pacote original)
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_owner_read ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id
+    AND (p.owner_organization_id IS NULL OR p.owner_organization_id = platform_private.catalog_reader_org())));
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_global_insert ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL));
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_global_update ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
+  USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL))
+  WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL));
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- validação (18 campos; sem IBS/CBS)
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(p jsonb) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE k text;
+  v_allowed constant text[] := ARRAY['ncm','cest','cfop_in_state','cfop_interstate','origin_code','icms_cst','icms_csosn',
+    'ipi_cst','pis_cst','cofins_cst','commercial_unit','taxable_unit','gtin','taxable_gtin','tax_benefit_code',
+    'fiscal_description','accounting_notes'];
+BEGIN
+  IF p IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(p) LOOP
+    IF NOT k = ANY(v_allowed) OR jsonb_typeof(p->k) NOT IN ('string','null')
+       OR char_length(p->>k) > 2000 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF (p->>'ncm') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'ncm') !~ '^[0-9]{8}$'
+     OR (p->>'cest') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cest') !~ '^[0-9]{7}$'
+     OR (p->>'cfop_in_state') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cfop_in_state') !~ '^[1-7][0-9]{3}$'
+     OR (p->>'cfop_interstate') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cfop_interstate') !~ '^[1-7][0-9]{3}$'
+     OR (p->>'origin_code') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'origin_code') !~ '^[0-8]$'
+     OR (p->>'gtin') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'gtin') !~ '^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14}|SEM GTIN)$'
+     OR (p->>'taxable_gtin') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'taxable_gtin') !~ '^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14}|SEM GTIN)$' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- writer canônico
+-- Ordem de locks: chave → cf_user_guards_v1.state (mesmo singleton de a00) → produto FOR SHARE →
+-- produto advisory → perfil FOR UPDATE → profile do ator FOR SHARE. Reautoriza após CADA espera.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(p_product_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamptz,
+  p_values jsonb, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_owner uuid; v_prof public.product_fiscal_profiles%ROWTYPE;
+  v_req jsonb; v_old platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts%ROWTYPE; v_receipt jsonb; v_found boolean;
+BEGIN
+  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN
+    -- snapshot de transação não enxergaria revogação concorrente
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_isolation_unsupported' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true);
+  IF p_product_id IS NULL OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR p_reason IS NULL
+     OR char_length(btrim(p_reason)) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 500 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  PERFORM platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(p_values);
+  v_req := jsonb_build_object('product_id',p_product_id,'expected',p_expected_updated_at,'values',p_values,'reason',btrim(p_reason));
+
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('owned-fiscal:'||p_idempotency_key::text,0));
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO v_old FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts WHERE idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_old.actor_id<>v_uid OR v_old.organization_id<>v_org OR v_old.request IS DISTINCT FROM v_req THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_key_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    RETURN v_old.receipt || '{"idempotent":true}'::jsonb;
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM 1 FROM cf_user_guards_v1.state WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_GATE_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='PT503'; END IF;
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  SELECT owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_product_id FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_owner IS NULL OR v_owner<>v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('owned-fiscal-product:'||p_product_id::text,0));
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_prof FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles
+   WHERE product_id=p_product_id AND is_active IS TRUE FOR UPDATE;
+  v_found := FOUND;
+  -- reautorização obrigatória depois da espera pelo lock do perfil (revisão independente)
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  -- serializa com revogação de profile em andamento e reautoriza novamente
+  PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=v_uid FOR SHARE;
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  IF v_found THEN
+    IF p_expected_updated_at IS NULL OR v_prof.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits VALUES (pg_catalog.txid_current(), p_product_id, v_uid, v_org, 'UPDATE');
+    UPDATE public.product_fiscal_profiles SET
+      ncm=p_values->>'ncm', cest=p_values->>'cest', cfop_in_state=p_values->>'cfop_in_state',
+      cfop_interstate=p_values->>'cfop_interstate', origin_code=p_values->>'origin_code',
+      icms_cst=p_values->>'icms_cst', icms_csosn=p_values->>'icms_csosn', ipi_cst=p_values->>'ipi_cst',
+      pis_cst=p_values->>'pis_cst', cofins_cst=p_values->>'cofins_cst', commercial_unit=p_values->>'commercial_unit',
+      taxable_unit=p_values->>'taxable_unit', gtin=p_values->>'gtin', taxable_gtin=p_values->>'taxable_gtin',
+      tax_benefit_code=p_values->>'tax_benefit_code', fiscal_description=p_values->>'fiscal_description',
+      accounting_notes=p_values->>'accounting_notes',
+      profile_status=CASE WHEN v_prof.profile_status='BLOCKED' THEN 'BLOCKED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END,
+      accounting_validated_at=NULL, accounting_validated_by=NULL, updated_by=v_uid
+    WHERE id=v_prof.id RETURNING * INTO v_prof;
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  ELSE
+    IF p_expected_updated_at IS NOT NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits VALUES (pg_catalog.txid_current(), p_product_id, v_uid, v_org, 'INSERT');
+    INSERT INTO public.product_fiscal_profiles (product_id,is_active,profile_status,ncm,cest,cfop_in_state,cfop_interstate,
+      origin_code,icms_cst,icms_csosn,ipi_cst,pis_cst,cofins_cst,commercial_unit,taxable_unit,gtin,taxable_gtin,
+      tax_benefit_code,fiscal_description,accounting_notes,created_by,updated_by)
+    VALUES (p_product_id,true,'DRAFT',p_values->>'ncm',p_values->>'cest',p_values->>'cfop_in_state',p_values->>'cfop_interstate',
+      p_values->>'origin_code',p_values->>'icms_cst',p_values->>'icms_csosn',p_values->>'ipi_cst',p_values->>'pis_cst',
+      p_values->>'cofins_cst',p_values->>'commercial_unit',p_values->>'taxable_unit',p_values->>'gtin',p_values->>'taxable_gtin',
+      p_values->>'tax_benefit_code',p_values->>'fiscal_description',p_values->>'accounting_notes',v_uid,v_uid)
+    RETURNING * INTO v_prof;
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits WHERE txid=pg_catalog.txid_current()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_permit_not_consumed' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  v_receipt := jsonb_build_object('success',true,'product_id',p_product_id,'profile_id',v_prof.id,
+    'organization_id',v_org,'profile_status',v_prof.profile_status,'updated_at',v_prof.updated_at,
+    'idempotency_key',p_idempotency_key,'idempotent',false);
+  INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts VALUES (p_idempotency_key,v_uid,v_org,p_product_id,v_req,v_receipt,now());
+  RETURN v_receipt;
+END $$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- leitor da empresa
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(p_limit integer, p_offset integer) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  v_org := platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(false);
+  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('organization_id',v_org,
+    'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.produtos WHERE owner_organization_id=v_org),
+    'items',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(r ORDER BY r->>'nome', r->>'product_id') FROM (
+      SELECT jsonb_build_object('product_id',p.id,'nome',p.nome,'codigo',p.codigo,'familia',p.familia_catalogo,
+        'profile', (SELECT to_jsonb(f) - ARRAY['created_by','updated_by','accounting_validated_by']
+                      FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles f WHERE f.product_id=p.id AND f.is_active IS TRUE)) r
+      FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.owner_organization_id=v_org
+      ORDER BY p.nome, p.id LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset) s),'[]'::jsonb));
+END $$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- ACL explícita (default ACL real concede a anon/authenticated/service_role)
+DO $acl$ DECLARE s text; BEGIN
+  FOREACH s IN ARRAY ARRAY[
+    'platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled()','platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(boolean)',
+    'platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(jsonb)',
+    'public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(uuid,timestamp with time zone,jsonb,text,uuid)',
+    'public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(integer,integer)'] LOOP
+    EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role', s);
+  END LOOP;
+END $acl$;
+-- GRANT EXECUTE a authenticated: SOMENTE em etapa separada autorizada, após POST e prova JWT real.
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- POST verificável
+DO $post$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN
+  FOR r IN SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text AS sig, p.proacl FROM pg_proc p
+     WHERE p.oid IN ('platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled()'::regprocedure,'platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(boolean)'::regprocedure,
+       'platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(jsonb)'::regprocedure,
+       'public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(uuid,timestamp with time zone,jsonb,text,uuid)'::regprocedure,
+       'public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(integer,integer)'::regprocedure) LOOP
+    IF has_function_privilege('anon', r.sig, 'EXECUTE') OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', r.sig, 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('service_role', r.sig, 'EXECUTE')
+       OR r.proacl IS NULL OR cardinality(r.proacl) <> 1 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: ACL not closed for %: %', r.sig, r.proacl; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF (SELECT array_agg(a::text) FROM pg_proc p, unnest(p.proacl) a
+       WHERE p.oid='platform_private.global_product_fiscal_before_write()'::regprocedure) IS DISTINCT FROM
+     (SELECT array_agg(a::text) FROM unnest(ARRAY['postgres=X/postgres']) a) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: a10 ACL changed'; END IF;
+  IF has_table_privilege('authenticated','platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits','INSERT')
+     OR has_table_privilege('service_role','platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits','INSERT') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: permit table writable by client'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='product_fiscal_profiles') <> 7 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: policy count'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.product_fiscal_profiles'::regclass AND NOT tgisinternal AND tgenabled='O') <> 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: trigger set changed'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT enabled FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate WHERE singleton) IS NOT FALSE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: gate must stay disabled'; END IF;
+END $post$;
+
+COMMIT;

+-- fiscal-tenant-catalog-reconciled-20261101 — CANDIDATO INATIVO. NÃO APLICAR.

+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s';

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- PRE (fail-closed, pins completos)
+DO $pre$ BEGIN
+  IF current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true) <> '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: must run as owner, never under a client JWT'; END IF;

+     OR to_regprocedure('public.is_platform_superadmin(uuid)') IS NULL
+     OR to_regclass('cf_user_guards_v1.state') IS NULL THEN

+  IF to_regclass('platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate') IS NOT NULL
+     OR to_regclass('platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits') IS NOT NULL THEN

+  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: install must run in READ COMMITTED'; END IF;
+END $pre$;

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- gate próprio (desligado)
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate (
+  singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK (singleton),
+  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
+);
+INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate VALUES (true, false);
+REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled() RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+  SELECT platform_private.catalog_ownership_enabled()
+     AND COALESCE((SELECT enabled FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate WHERE singleton), false) $$;
+
+-- Ator de empresa: empresa ativa do ator real (h15) com papel exigido; nunca SA; nunca GUC/payload.
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(p_write boolean) RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL OR NOT platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled()
+     OR public.is_platform_superadmin(v_uid)
+     OR NOT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(v_uid) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
+  IF v_org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NOT (platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'administrador') OR platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'financeiro')
+          OR (NOT p_write AND platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'gestor'))) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  RETURN v_org;
+END $$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- recibos e permissões privadas
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts (
+  idempotency_key uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  actor_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, product_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  request jsonb NOT NULL, receipt jsonb NOT NULL,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Prova privada one-shot: txid + ator + empresa + produto + operação. Só o writer DEFINER grava;
+-- o gatilho a10 consome (DELETE ... RETURNING) e reautoriza. Nenhuma GUC participa.
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits (
+  txid bigint NOT NULL, product_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  actor_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  op text NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('INSERT','UPDATE')),
+  PRIMARY KEY (txid, product_id)
+);
+REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- composição com a10 (guard global preservado)
+-- Ramo global (produto sem dono) = corpo capturado, inalterado. Ramo próprio exige a prova privada
+-- e reautoriza o ator NESTE ponto (depois de a00 e de todos os locks do writer).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.global_product_fiscal_before_write()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_owner uuid; v_permit platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+ SELECT p.owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND v_owner IS NULL THEN
+  SELECT p.owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = OLD.product_id;
+ END IF;
+ IF v_owner IS NULL THEN
+  IF NOT platform_private.global_product_fiscal_write_ready() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ ELSE
+  DELETE FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits w
+   WHERE w.txid = pg_catalog.txid_current() AND w.product_id = NEW.product_id
+     AND w.actor_id = auth.uid() AND w.organization_id = v_owner AND w.op = TG_OP
+  RETURNING * INTO v_permit;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner THEN
+   RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
+  IF OLD.is_active IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.product_id OR NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
+  -- Server-owned CAS token for ALL direct editor and IBS/CBS updates.
+  -- Strictly newer even inside one transaction; caller timestamps are ignored.
+  -- The existing AFTER fiscal audit observes this token in the same transaction.
+  NEW.updated_at:=greatest(clock_timestamp(),OLD.updated_at+interval '1 microsecond');
+ ELSE NEW.updated_at:=clock_timestamp(); END IF;
+ RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- RLS restritiva (do pacote original)
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_owner_read ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id
+    AND (p.owner_organization_id IS NULL OR p.owner_organization_id = platform_private.catalog_reader_org())));
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_global_insert ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL));
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_global_update ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
+  USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL))
+  WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL));
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- validação (18 campos; sem IBS/CBS)
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(p jsonb) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE k text;
+  v_allowed constant text[] := ARRAY['ncm','cest','cfop_in_state','cfop_interstate','origin_code','icms_cst','icms_csosn',
+    'ipi_cst','pis_cst','cofins_cst','commercial_unit','taxable_unit','gtin','taxable_gtin','tax_benefit_code',
+    'fiscal_description','accounting_notes'];
+BEGIN
+  IF p IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(p) LOOP
+    IF NOT k = ANY(v_allowed) OR jsonb_typeof(p->k) NOT IN ('string','null')
+       OR char_length(p->>k) > 2000 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF (p->>'ncm') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'ncm') !~ '^[0-9]{8}$'
+     OR (p->>'cest') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cest') !~ '^[0-9]{7}$'
+     OR (p->>'cfop_in_state') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cfop_in_state') !~ '^[1-7][0-9]{3}$'
+     OR (p->>'cfop_interstate') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cfop_interstate') !~ '^[1-7][0-9]{3}$'
+     OR (p->>'origin_code') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'origin_code') !~ '^[0-8]$'
+     OR (p->>'gtin') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'gtin') !~ '^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14}|SEM GTIN)$'
+     OR (p->>'taxable_gtin') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'taxable_gtin') !~ '^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14}|SEM GTIN)$' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- writer canônico
+-- Ordem de locks: chave → cf_user_guards_v1.state (mesmo singleton de a00) → produto FOR SHARE →
+-- produto advisory → perfil FOR UPDATE → profile do ator FOR SHARE. Reautoriza após CADA espera.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(p_product_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamptz,
+  p_values jsonb, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_owner uuid; v_prof public.product_fiscal_profiles%ROWTYPE;
+  v_req jsonb; v_old platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts%ROWTYPE; v_receipt jsonb; v_found boolean;
+BEGIN
+  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN
+    -- snapshot de transação não enxergaria revogação concorrente
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_isolation_unsupported' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true);
+  IF p_product_id IS NULL OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR p_reason IS NULL
+     OR char_length(btrim(p_reason)) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 500 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  PERFORM platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(p_values);
+  v_req := jsonb_build_object('product_id',p_product_id,'expected',p_expected_updated_at,'values',p_values,'reason',btrim(p_reason));
+
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('owned-fiscal:'||p_idempotency_key::text,0));
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO v_old FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts WHERE idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_old.actor_id<>v_uid OR v_old.organization_id<>v_org OR v_old.request IS DISTINCT FROM v_req THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_key_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    RETURN v_old.receipt || '{"idempotent":true}'::jsonb;
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM 1 FROM cf_user_guards_v1.state WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_GATE_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='PT503'; END IF;
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  SELECT owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_product_id FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_owner IS NULL OR v_owner<>v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('owned-fiscal-product:'||p_product_id::text,0));
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_prof FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles
+   WHERE product_id=p_product_id AND is_active IS TRUE FOR UPDATE;
+  v_found := FOUND;
+  -- reautorização obrigatória depois da espera pelo lock do perfil (revisão independente)
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  -- serializa com revogação de profile em andamento e reautoriza novamente
+  PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=v_uid FOR SHARE;
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  IF v_found THEN
+    IF p_expected_updated_at IS NULL OR v_prof.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits VALUES (pg_catalog.txid_current(), p_product_id, v_uid, v_org, 'UPDATE');
+    UPDATE public.product_fiscal_profiles SET
+      ncm=p_values->>'ncm', cest=p_values->>'cest', cfop_in_state=p_values->>'cfop_in_state',
+      cfop_interstate=p_values->>'cfop_interstate', origin_code=p_values->>'origin_code',
+      icms_cst=p_values->>'icms_cst', icms_csosn=p_values->>'icms_csosn', ipi_cst=p_values->>'ipi_cst',
+      pis_cst=p_values->>'pis_cst', cofins_cst=p_values->>'cofins_cst', commercial_unit=p_values->>'commercial_unit',
+      taxable_unit=p_values->>'taxable_unit', gtin=p_values->>'gtin', taxable_gtin=p_values->>'taxable_gtin',
+      tax_benefit_code=p_values->>'tax_benefit_code', fiscal_description=p_values->>'fiscal_description',
+      accounting_notes=p_values->>'accounting_notes',
+      profile_status=CASE WHEN v_prof.profile_status='BLOCKED' THEN 'BLOCKED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END,
+      accounting_validated_at=NULL, accounting_validated_by=NULL, updated_by=v_uid
+    WHERE id=v_prof.id RETURNING * INTO v_prof;
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  ELSE
+    IF p_expected_updated_at IS NOT NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits VALUES (pg_catalog.txid_current(), p_product_id, v_uid, v_org, 'INSERT');
+    INSERT INTO public.product_fiscal_profiles (product_id,is_active,profile_status,ncm,cest,cfop_in_state,cfop_interstate,
+      origin_code,icms_cst,icms_csosn,ipi_cst,pis_cst,cofins_cst,commercial_unit,taxable_unit,gtin,taxable_gtin,
+      tax_benefit_code,fiscal_description,accounting_notes,created_by,updated_by)
+    VALUES (p_product_id,true,'DRAFT',p_values->>'ncm',p_values->>'cest',p_values->>'cfop_in_state',p_values->>'cfop_interstate',
+      p_values->>'origin_code',p_values->>'icms_cst',p_values->>'icms_csosn',p_values->>'ipi_cst',p_values->>'pis_cst',
+      p_values->>'cofins_cst',p_values->>'commercial_unit',p_values->>'taxable_unit',p_values->>'gtin',p_values->>'taxable_gtin',
+      p_values->>'tax_benefit_code',p_values->>'fiscal_description',p_values->>'accounting_notes',v_uid,v_uid)
+    RETURNING * INTO v_prof;
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits WHERE txid=pg_catalog.txid_current()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_permit_not_consumed' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  v_receipt := jsonb_build_object('success',true,'product_id',p_product_id,'profile_id',v_prof.id,
+    'organization_id',v_org,'profile_status',v_prof.profile_status,'updated_at',v_prof.updated_at,
+    'idempotency_key',p_idempotency_key,'idempotent',false);
+  INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts VALUES (p_idempotency_key,v_uid,v_org,p_product_id,v_req,v_receipt,now());
+  RETURN v_receipt;
+END $$;

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- leitor da empresa
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(p_limit integer, p_offset integer) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  v_org := platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(false);
+  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('organization_id',v_org,
+    'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.produtos WHERE owner_organization_id=v_org),
+    'items',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(r ORDER BY r->>'nome', r->>'product_id') FROM (
+      SELECT jsonb_build_object('product_id',p.id,'nome',p.nome,'codigo',p.codigo,'familia',p.familia_catalogo,
+        'profile', (SELECT to_jsonb(f) - ARRAY['created_by','updated_by','accounting_validated_by']
+                      FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles f WHERE f.product_id=p.id AND f.is_active IS TRUE)) r
+      FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.owner_organization_id=v_org
+      ORDER BY p.nome, p.id LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset) s),'[]'::jsonb));
+END $$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- ACL explícita (default ACL real concede a anon/authenticated/service_role)
+DO $acl$ DECLARE s text; BEGIN
+  FOREACH s IN ARRAY ARRAY[
+    'platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled()','platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(boolean)',
+    'platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(jsonb)',
+    'public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(uuid,timestamp with time zone,jsonb,text,uuid)',
+    'public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(integer,integer)'] LOOP
+    EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role', s);
+  END LOOP;
+END $acl$;
+-- GRANT EXECUTE a authenticated: SOMENTE em etapa separada autorizada, após POST e prova JWT real.
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- POST verificável
+DO $post$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN
+  FOR r IN SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text AS sig, p.proacl FROM pg_proc p
+     WHERE p.oid IN ('platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled()'::regprocedure,'platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(boolean)'::regprocedure,
+       'platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(jsonb)'::regprocedure,
+       'public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(uuid,timestamp with time zone,jsonb,text,uuid)'::regprocedure,
+       'public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(integer,integer)'::regprocedure) LOOP
+    IF has_function_privilege('anon', r.sig, 'EXECUTE') OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', r.sig, 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('service_role', r.sig, 'EXECUTE')
+       OR r.proacl IS NULL OR cardinality(r.proacl) <> 1 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: ACL not closed for %: %', r.sig, r.proacl; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF (SELECT array_agg(a::text) FROM pg_proc p, unnest(p.proacl) a
+       WHERE p.oid='platform_private.global_product_fiscal_before_write()'::regprocedure) IS DISTINCT FROM
+     (SELECT array_agg(a::text) FROM unnest(ARRAY[@@A10_ACL@@]) a) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: a10 ACL changed'; END IF;
+  IF has_table_privilege('authenticated','platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits','INSERT')
+     OR has_table_privilege('service_role','platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits','INSERT') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: permit table writable by client'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='product_fiscal_profiles') <> 7 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: policy count'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.product_fiscal_profiles'::regclass AND NOT tgisinternal AND tgenabled='O') <> 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: trigger set changed'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT enabled FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate WHERE singleton) IS NOT FALSE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST: gate must stay disabled'; END IF;
+END $post$;
+
+COMMIT;

+-- Rollback deny-only do candidato reconciliado. NÃO APLICAR sem autorização.
+-- Não remove policies restritivas, recibos nem a tabela de permissões; não restaura o corpo antigo
+-- de a10 (o ramo próprio sem permissão já nega; o ramo global é o corpo capturado). Fecha gate e EXECUTE.
+BEGIN;
+UPDATE platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate SET enabled=false WHERE singleton;
+DELETE FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_write_permits;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(uuid,timestamptz,jsonb,text,uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(integer,integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+DO $post$ BEGIN
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(uuid,timestamptz,jsonb,text,uuid)','EXECUTE')
+     OR (SELECT enabled FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'POST rollback: not closed'; END IF;
+END $post$;
+COMMIT;

+def check(cid, scenario, expected, actual, kind="PG_DISPOSABLE_CAPTURED_DEFS_SYNTHETIC_AUTH"):
+    r = dict(id=cid, scenario=scenario, expected=expected, actual=actual,
+             status="PASS" if expected == actual else "FAIL", kind=kind)
+    checks.append(r); print(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)

+class PG:
+    def __init__(self, name):
+        for v in [k for k in os.environ if k.startswith("PG")]:
+            os.environ.pop(v)
+        self.d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"pgfisc-{name}-"); os.chown(self.d, 1000, 1000)
+        self.port = str(56000 + (os.getpid() + len(name)) % 900)
+        self.as_ = ["setpriv", "--reuid=1000", "--regid=1000", "--clear-groups"] if os.getuid() == 0 else []
+        subprocess.run(self.as_ + ["initdb", "-D", f"{self.d}/data", "-U", "postgres", "-A", "trust", "-E", "UTF8"], check=True, capture_output=True)
+        subprocess.run(self.as_ + ["pg_ctl", "-D", f"{self.d}/data", "-o", f"-p {self.port} -k {self.d} -c listen_addresses=''",
+                                   "-l", f"{self.d}/log", "-w", "start"], check=True, capture_output=True)
+
+    def psql(self):
+        return ["psql", "-X", "-q", "-At", "-h", self.d, "-p", self.port, "-U", "postgres", "-d", "postgres", "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1"]
+
+    def sql(self, s, ok=True):
+        r = subprocess.run(self.psql(), input=s, text=True, capture_output=True)
+        LOG.write(f"--- SQL ok={ok} rc={r.returncode}\n{s[:600]}\n>> {r.stdout[-800:]}{r.stderr[-800:]}\n"); LOG.flush()
+        if ok and r.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(r.stderr)
+        return (r.stdout.strip() if r.returncode == 0 else "ERR:" + r.stderr.strip())
+
+    def stop(self):
+        subprocess.run(self.as_ + ["pg_ctl", "-D", f"{self.d}/data", "-m", "immediate", "stop"], capture_output=True)
+        shutil.rmtree(self.d, ignore_errors=True)

+def fidelity(pg, prefix):

+def wait_lock(pg, pattern, timeout=8):
+    for _ in range(timeout * 10):
+        if pg.sql(f"SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type='Lock' AND query LIKE '%{pattern}%' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()") != "0":
+            return True
+        time.sleep(0.1)
+    return False
+
+
+def concurrency(pg, prefix="G", deny=True):
+    cur = lambda: pg.sql(f"SELECT updated_at FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles WHERE product_id='{PA}' AND is_active")
+    scenarios = [
+        (f"{prefix}-50", "controle: espera lock do perfil e grava sem revogação", None, False),
+        (f"{prefix}-51", "revogação de papel concorrente durante espera do lock do perfil", f"DELETE FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id='{UA}' AND role='administrador';", True),
+    ]
+    for i, (cid, name, revoke, expect_deny) in enumerate(scenarios):
+        holder = subprocess.Popen(pg.psql(), stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
+        holder.stdin.write(f"BEGIN; SELECT 1 FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles WHERE product_id='{PA}' AND is_active FOR UPDATE;\n"); holder.stdin.flush()
+        time.sleep(0.4)
+        key = f"91000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000{i}"
+        writer = subprocess.Popen(pg.psql(), stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
+        writer.stdin.write(as_user(UA) + SAVE.format(p=PA, exp=f"'{cur()}'", v='{"ncm":"3101000' + str(i) + '"}', k=key) + ";\n"); writer.stdin.close()
+        blocked = wait_lock(pg, "tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save")
+        if revoke:
+            pg.sql(revoke)
+        holder.stdin.write("COMMIT;\n"); holder.stdin.close(); holder.wait(10)
+        out, err = writer.communicate(timeout=15)
+        LOG.write(f"--- concurrency {cid} blocked={blocked}\n{out}\n{err}\n")
+        denied = "owned_fiscal_forbidden" in err
+        check(cid, name if prefix == "G" else "mutação: " + name, [True, expect_deny and deny], [blocked, denied],
+              "PG_DISPOSABLE_CONCURRENCY_READ_COMMITTED" if prefix == "G" else "PG_DISPOSABLE_MUTATION_SENSITIVITY")
+        if revoke:
+            pg.sql(f"INSERT INTO public.user_roles VALUES ('{UA}','administrador') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;")
+    # profile deactivation in flight: writer waits on profiles FOR SHARE then re-checks
+    rev = subprocess.Popen(pg.psql(), stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
+    rev.stdin.write(f"BEGIN; UPDATE public.profiles SET ativo=false WHERE user_id='{UA}';\n"); rev.stdin.flush(); time.sleep(0.4)
+    writer = subprocess.Popen(pg.psql(), stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
+    writer.stdin.write(as_user(UA) + SAVE.format(p=PA, exp=f"'{cur()}'", v='{"ncm":"31010099"}', k="91000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa") + ";\n"); writer.stdin.close()
+    blocked = wait_lock(pg, "tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save")
+    rev.stdin.write("COMMIT;\n"); rev.stdin.close(); rev.wait(10)
+    out, err = writer.communicate(timeout=15)
+    LOG.write(f"--- concurrency G-52 blocked={blocked}\n{out}\n{err}\n")
+    if prefix == "G":
+        check("G-52", "desativação de profile em andamento: writer espera FOR SHARE e reautoriza (nega)", [True, True],
+              [blocked, "owned_fiscal_forbidden" in err], "PG_DISPOSABLE_CONCURRENCY_READ_COMMITTED")
+    else:  # sem FOR SHARE o writer não serializa com a revogação em andamento: grava antes dela
+        check(f"{prefix}-52", "mutação sem FOR SHARE: escrita não negada (prova que o FOR SHARE é o que serializa)", False,
+              "owned_fiscal_forbidden" in err, "PG_DISPOSABLE_MUTATION_SENSITIVITY")
+    pg.sql(f"UPDATE public.profiles SET ativo=true WHERE user_id='{UA}';")
+
+
+RECHECK_AFTER_PROFILE = """  -- reautorização obrigatória depois da espera pelo lock do perfil (revisão independente)
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  -- serializa com revogação de profile em andamento e reautoriza novamente
+  PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=v_uid FOR SHARE;
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+"""
+TRIGGER_RECHECK = "IF NOT FOUND OR platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner THEN"
+
+
+def run_mutations():
+    """Prova de sensibilidade: sem rechecks pós-lock, a10 ainda nega (defesa em profundidade);
+    sem rechecks no writer E no a10, a revogação concorrente passa — o teste discrimina."""
+    base = build.build()
+    assert RECHECK_AFTER_PROFILE in base and TRIGGER_RECHECK in base
+    for prefix, text, deny in [("MUT1-writer-sem-recheck", base.replace(RECHECK_AFTER_PROFILE, ""), True),
+                               ("MUT2-writer-e-a10-sem-recheck", base.replace(RECHECK_AFTER_PROFILE, "").replace(TRIGGER_RECHECK, "IF NOT FOUND THEN"), False)]:
+        pg = PG(prefix[:4].lower())
+        try:
+            stub(pg); foundation(pg); pg.sql(text); enable_local(pg)
+            pg.sql(as_user(UA) + SAVE.format(p=PA, exp="NULL", v='{"ncm":"31010000"}', k=K1) + ";")
+            concurrency(pg, prefix, deny)
+        finally:
+            pg.stop()
+

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._comunicacao_publish_system_event(_event_key text, _source_type text, _source_id uuid, _payload jsonb, _idempotency_key text)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'suppressed',true,'code','NOTIF3_GLOBAL_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE'); END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._notify_role(p_role app_role, p_tipo text, p_titulo text, p_mensagem text, p_link text)
+ RETURNS void
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_advance_solicitacao_on_registro()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+ IF NEW.solicitacao_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.hora_inicio IS NULL AND NEW.hora_inicio IS NOT NULL THEN
+  UPDATE public.portal_solicitacoes SET status='em_visita',updated_at=now()
+   WHERE id=NEW.solicitacao_id AND status NOT IN ('concluida','cancelada');
+ END IF;
+ -- Não concluir solicitação no encaminhamento; OS/comerciais têm ciclos próprios.
+ RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_catalog_tecnico(_uid uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_uid)
+     AND (public.has_role(_uid,'administrador')
+      OR public.has_role(_uid,'gestor')
+      OR public.has_role(_uid,'consultor_tecnico')
+      OR public.has_role(_uid,'tecnico_agronomo'));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_technical_visit(p_user_id uuid, p_registro_id uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT public.technical_actor_ready(p_user_id) AND EXISTS (
+ SELECT 1 FROM public.registros_consultor r
+ WHERE r.id=p_registro_id AND public.technical_refs_in_actor_tenant(r.cliente_id,r.fazenda_id,r.talhao_id)
+ AND (public.has_role(p_user_id,'administrador') OR public.has_role(p_user_id,'gestor')
+ OR ((public.has_role(p_user_id,'consultor_tecnico') OR public.has_role(p_user_id,'tecnico_agronomo'))
+ AND public.technical_client_link(p_user_id,r.cliente_id,ARRAY['execute','manage'])
+ AND public.is_visit_responsible(p_user_id,r.id))));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_access_aplicacao(_aplicacao_id uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT COALESCE(
+    _aplicacao_id IS NOT NULL
+    AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
+    AND EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1
+      FROM public.aplicacoes a
+      LEFT JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id = a.ordem_servico_id
+      LEFT JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = os.cliente_id
+      LEFT JOIN public.ordens_servico_onfarm oso ON oso.id = a.ordem_servico_onfarm_id
+      LEFT JOIN public.clientes co ON co.id = oso.cliente_id
+      WHERE a.id = _aplicacao_id
+        AND a.organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()
+        -- Every present parent must exist and remain in the application's tenant.
+        AND (a.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR (
+          os.id IS NOT NULL AND os.organization_id = a.organization_id
+          AND c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.organization_id = a.organization_id
+        ))
+        -- On-farm has no organization_id: its persisted client is the tenant origin.
+        AND (a.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL OR (
+          oso.id IS NOT NULL AND co.id IS NOT NULL
+          AND co.organization_id = a.organization_id
+        ))
+        AND (
+          public.is_operational_staff(auth.uid())
+          OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::app_role)
+          OR os.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid()))
+          OR oso.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid()))
+        )
+    ), false
+  );
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_access_cliente(_user_id uuid, _cliente_id uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF _user_id IS NULL OR _cliente_id IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN false;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'administrador'::app_role), false)
+     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'gestor_comercial'::app_role), false)
+     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'gestor'::app_role), false)
+  THEN
+    RETURN true;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- HARDENING: papéis técnicos exigem carteira ativa e vigente.
+  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'tecnico_agronomo'::app_role), false)
+     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'consultor_tecnico'::app_role), false)
+  THEN
+    RETURN COALESCE(
+      public.has_active_user_cliente_access(
+        _user_id, _cliente_id, ARRAY['read','execute','manage']
+      ), false);
+  END IF;
+
+  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'parceiro_b2b'::app_role), false) THEN
+    RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_clients pc
+      JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.partner_id = pc.partner_id
+      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id
+      WHERE pu.user_id = _user_id AND pc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND pc.active = true
+        AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL
+        AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+        AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND pu.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND pu.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+    )), false);
+  END IF;
+
+  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::app_role), false) THEN
+    RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_user_clients puc
+      JOIN public.partner_users pu2 ON pu2.partner_id = puc.partner_id AND pu2.user_id = puc.user_id
+      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa2 ON pa2.id = puc.partner_id
+      WHERE puc.user_id = _user_id AND puc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND puc.active = true
+        AND pu2.revoked_at IS NULL
+        AND pa2.ativo = true AND pa2.deleted_at IS NULL
+        AND pa2.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND pu2.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND pu2.tenant_id = pa2.commercial_owner_organization_id
+    ) OR EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_technician_clients ptc
+      JOIN public.partner_users pu3 ON pu3.partner_id = ptc.partner_id AND pu3.user_id = ptc.technician_user_id
+      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa3 ON pa3.id = ptc.partner_id
+      WHERE ptc.technician_user_id = _user_id AND ptc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND ptc.active = true
+        AND pu3.revoked_at IS NULL
+        AND pa3.ativo = true AND pa3.deleted_at IS NULL
+        AND pa3.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND pu3.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND pu3.tenant_id = pa3.commercial_owner_organization_id
+    )), false);
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_clientes uc
+    WHERE uc.user_id = _user_id
+      AND uc.cliente_id = _cliente_id
+      AND uc.is_active = true
+      AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL
+      AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from <= now())
+      AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
+  )), false);
+END;
+$function$;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cf_user_guards_v1.acquire_gate()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+ IF TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT' OR TG_RELID NOT IN ('public.profiles'::regclass,'public.user_roles'::regclass,'public.user_clientes'::regclass,'public.partner_users'::regclass,'auth.users'::regclass) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_user_guard_context' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF current_setting('role',true) IN ('anon','authenticated') AND auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'user_edit_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ UPDATE cf_user_guards_v1.state SET revision=revision+1 WHERE singleton;
+ IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'user_guard_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='PT503'; END IF;
+ RETURN NULL;
+END $function$;
