+    public.has_role(_uid,'administrador'::app_role)
+    OR public.has_role(_uid,'gestor'::app_role)
+    OR public.has_role(_uid,'financeiro'::app_role));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_generate_receivable_installments()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  i int;
+  v_context platform_private.financial_initial_installments;
+  v_inst jsonb;
+  v_qtd int := NEW.installment_count;
+  v_base numeric(14,2) := ROUND(NEW.total_amount / v_qtd, 2);
+  v_acc numeric(14,2) := 0;
+  v_amt numeric(14,2);
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.organization_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FINANCIAL_TENANT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  DELETE FROM platform_private.financial_initial_installments
+    WHERE transaction_id=txid_current() AND title_id=NEW.id AND kind='receivable'
+    RETURNING * INTO v_context;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_context.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() OR v_context.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id
+       OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_context.actor_id OR NEW.origin_type <> 'MANUAL'
+       OR platform_private.h15_actor_organization() IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id
+       OR NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FIN_INITIAL_CONTEXT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF jsonb_array_length(v_context.installments) <> NEW.installment_count
+       OR (SELECT sum((x->>'amount')::numeric) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_context.installments) x) IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.total_amount THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FIN_TITLE_INVALID_SUM' USING ERRCODE='23514';
+    END IF;
+    FOR v_inst IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_context.installments) LOOP
+      INSERT INTO public.accounts_receivable_installments(organization_id,receivable_id,installment_number,due_date,original_amount,net_amount,status)
+        VALUES(NEW.organization_id,NEW.id,(v_inst->>'installment_number')::int,(v_inst->>'due_date')::date,
+          (v_inst->>'amount')::numeric,(v_inst->>'amount')::numeric,'OPEN');
+    END LOOP;
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+  IF NEW.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders o WHERE o.id=NEW.origin_id AND o.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL) THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.accounts_receivable_installments(receivable_id,installment_number,due_date,original_amount,net_amount,status,organization_id,interest_amount)
+    SELECT NEW.id,s.installment_number,s.due_date,s.amount,s.amount,'OPEN',NEW.organization_id,s.interest_amount
+    FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s JOIN public.partner_orders o ON o.id=s.partner_order_id AND o.payment_terms_id=s.payment_terms_id
+    WHERE o.id=NEW.origin_id ORDER BY s.installment_number;
+    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments WHERE receivable_id=NEW.id)<>v_qtd THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INSTALLMENT_CARDINALITY_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+  FOR i IN 1..v_qtd LOOP
+    IF i < v_qtd THEN
+      v_amt := v_base;
+      v_acc := v_acc + v_amt;
+    ELSE
+      v_amt := NEW.total_amount - v_acc;
+    END IF;
+    INSERT INTO public.accounts_receivable_installments
+      (receivable_id, installment_number, due_date, original_amount, net_amount, status, organization_id)
+    VALUES
+      (NEW.id, i, (NEW.first_due_date + ((i-1) || ' months')::interval)::date, v_amt, v_amt, 'OPEN', NEW.organization_id);
+  END LOOP;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts(p_microorganism_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+  WITH g AS (
+    SELECT (auth.uid() IS NULL
+            OR public.fn_regulatory_can_read(auth.uid())
+            OR public.fn_fiscal_can_read_internal(auth.uid())
+            OR public.can_view_catalog_internal(auth.uid())) AS ok
+  ), d AS (
+    SELECT * FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers
+     WHERE microorganism_id = p_microorganism_id AND deleted_at IS NULL
+       AND (SELECT ok FROM g)
+     ORDER BY (status='VALIDATED') DESC, version DESC
+     LIMIT 1)
+  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (SELECT ok FROM g) THEN NULL
+              WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d) THEN NULL ELSE (
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+      'dossier_id', d.id,
+      'version', d.version,
+      'status', d.status,
+      'blocked_reason', d.blocked_reason,
+      'regulatory_category', d.regulatory_category,
+      'strain', coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.strain_code,'')),''), nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.strain_name,'')),'')),
+      'formulation', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.formulation,'')),''),
+      'label_guarantee', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.label_guarantee,'')),''),
+      'mapa_status', d.mapa_status,
+      'mapa_registration_number', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_registration_number,'')),''),
+      'mapa_holder', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_holder,'')),''),
+      'mapa_valid_until', d.mapa_valid_until,
+      'mapa_not_applicable_reason', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_not_applicable_reason,'')),''),
+      'published_ncm', d.published_ncm,
+      'published_cest', d.published_cest,
+      'effective_from', d.effective_from,
+      'effective_to', d.effective_to,
+      'review_technical', d.technical_review_status,
+      'review_regulatory', d.regulatory_review_status,
+      'review_fiscal', d.fiscal_review_status,
+      'has_label_document', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
+                                     WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND x.doc_type='ROTULO'),
+      'has_report_document', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
+                                     WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND x.doc_type IN ('LAUDO','CERTIFICADO_ANALISE')),
+      'expired_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
+                             WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL
+                               AND x.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND x.valid_until < current_date),
+      'ncm_approved', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c
+                               WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.status='APPROVED'),
+      'ncm_candidates', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id),
+      'checklist_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id),
+      'checklist_pending', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.item_key ORDER BY c.item_key)
+                                      FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
+                                      WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='PENDING'),'[]'::jsonb),
+      'checklist_not_applicable', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+                                      'item_key',c.item_key,'justification',c.justification) ORDER BY c.item_key)
+                                      FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
+                                      WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='NOT_APPLICABLE'),'[]'::jsonb),
+      'checklist_confirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
+                               WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='CONFIRMED'),
+      'presentations_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id),
+      'presentations_units_unconfirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p
+                                           WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id AND NOT p.units_confirmed),
+      'presentations_gtin_unconfirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p
+                                          WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id AND NOT p.gtin_confirmed))
+    FROM d) END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_notify_lab_on_programacao()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$ DECLARE org uuid; prod text; cli text; BEGIN
+ IF NEW.status::text<>'aguardando' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
+ org:=platform_private.notification_source_org('programacao_producao',NEW.id);
+ IF org IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
+ SELECT nome INTO prod FROM public.produtos WHERE id=NEW.produto_id;
+ SELECT c.nome INTO cli FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id AND c.organization_id=org WHERE o.id=NEW.ordem_servico_id;
+ INSERT INTO public.notificacoes_operacionais(usuario_id,tipo,titulo,mensagem,link,source_type,source_id)
+ SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id,'nova_demanda_producao','Nova demanda de produção',coalesce(prod,'Bioinsumo')||coalesce(' · '||cli,'')||coalesce(' · '||round(NEW.volume_necessario/1000.0,1)::text||' L',''),'/pcp?coluna=aguardando','programacao_producao',NEW.id
+ FROM public.user_roles ur WHERE ur.role IN ('producao','administrador','gestor') AND platform_private.notification_user_ok(ur.user_id,org);
+ RETURN NEW; END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_regulatory_can_prepare(_uid uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT _uid IS NOT NULL AND public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_uid) AND (
+    public.has_role(_uid,'administrador'::app_role)
+    OR public.has_role(_uid,'gestor'::app_role));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_regulatory_can_read(_uid uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT _uid IS NOT NULL AND public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_uid) AND (
+    public.has_role(_uid,'administrador'::app_role)
+    OR public.has_role(_uid,'gestor'::app_role)
+    OR public.has_role(_uid,'financeiro'::app_role)
+    OR public.has_role(_uid,'tecnico_agronomo'::app_role));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_validate_envase_volume()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_produzido numeric;
+  v_envasado numeric;
+  v_novo numeric;
+  v_codigo text;
+  v_saldo numeric;
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.quantidade IS NULL OR NEW.quantidade <= 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A quantidade do envase deve ser maior que zero.' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
+  END IF;
+  IF NEW.volume_por_unidade IS NULL OR NEW.volume_por_unidade <= 0 OR NEW.volume_por_unidade::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'O volume por unidade deve ser maior que zero.' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- H5-B01/B02: serializa qualquer INSERT de envase (inclusive direto via RLS) pela linha do lote.
+  -- Ordem de lock compatível com rpc_cockpit_registrar_envase_v1 (programacao -> lote).
+  SELECT volume_produzido, codigo_lote INTO v_produzido, v_codigo
+  FROM public.lotes WHERE id = NEW.lote_id FOR UPDATE;
+
+  IF v_codigo IS NULL AND v_produzido IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Lote % inexistente para envase.', NEW.lote_id USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_produzido IS NULL OR v_produzido <= 0 OR v_produzido::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'O lote % não possui volume produzido informado. Registre a produção antes de envasar.', COALESCE(v_codigo,'(desconhecido)')
+      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_envasado := public.lote_volume_envasado(NEW.lote_id);
+  v_novo := COALESCE(NEW.volume_por_unidade,0) * COALESCE(NEW.quantidade,0);
+  v_saldo := v_produzido - v_envasado;
+
+  IF (v_envasado + v_novo) > v_produzido THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Envase excede o volume produzido do lote %. Produzido: % L, já envasado: % L, saldo disponível: % L, solicitado: % L.',
+      COALESCE(v_codigo,'(desconhecido)'),
+      ROUND(v_produzido/1000.0, 2),
+      ROUND(v_envasado/1000.0, 2),
+      ROUND(v_saldo/1000.0, 2),
+      ROUND(v_novo/1000.0, 2)
+      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_b2b_receivable_secure(p_partner_order_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+ IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    IF pg_trigger_depth()=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'b2b_phase1_scope_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  ELSIF NOT (public.b2b_phase1_order_visible(p_partner_order_id) OR EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.id=p_partner_order_id
+      AND platform_private.c2p1_settings_allowed(po.partner_id,true))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'b2b_phase1_scope_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NOT (pg_trigger_depth() > 0 or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
+      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
+      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id=p_partner_order_id AND internal_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_DOWNSTREAM_UNVERIFIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id=p_partner_order_id AND c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF p_partner_order_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'partner_order_id_required' USING ERRCODE='P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Canonical row-before-receipt order, matching approval and its billing trigger.
+  PERFORM 1 FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id=p_partner_order_id FOR UPDATE;
+
+  -- Serializa concorrencia real (clique duplo / chamadas simultaneas).
+  -- Chave unica bigint: assinatura pg_advisory_xact_lock(bigint).
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
+    hashtextextended('b2b_receivable:' || p_partner_order_id::text, 0)
+  );
+
+  IF NOT public.fn_b2b_order_priceable(p_partner_order_id) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_not_priceable_quote_required' USING ERRCODE='P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN public.generate_b2b_receivable_secure_impl(p_partner_order_id);
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_b2b_receivable_secure_impl(p_partner_order_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_order record;
+  v_partner record;
+  v_settings record;
+  v_terms record;
+  v_receivable_id uuid;
+  v_category_id uuid;
+  v_payment_method_id uuid;
+  v_existing uuid;
+  v_sch record;
+  v_ari_id uuid;
+  v_installments_json jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_system_call boolean := (v_uid IS NULL);
+  v_gate jsonb;
+  v_fiscal jsonb;
+  v_uf text;
+  v_org uuid;
+  v_org_count integer; -- b2b_f1_financial_tenant
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT v_system_call THEN
+    IF NOT (has_role(v_uid,'administrador') OR has_role(v_uid,'financeiro') OR has_role(v_uid,'gestor') OR has_role(v_uid,'gestor_comercial')) THEN
+      INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs(order_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_novos)
+        VALUES (p_partner_order_id, v_uid, 'financeiro_permissao_negada', jsonb_build_object('motivo','sem permissão'));
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sem permissão para gerar cobrança B2B';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id = p_partner_order_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido não encontrado'; END IF;
+
+  -- Deterministic partner ownership, never caller-supplied organization.
+  SELECT count(*), min(o.id::text)::uuid INTO v_org_count,v_org
+    FROM public.organizations o WHERE o.partner_account_id=v_order.partner_id;
+  -- c2_ord_owner_tenant: cliente comercial sem tenant próprio fatura no tenant dono.
+  IF v_org_count = 0 THEN
+    SELECT count(*), min(o.id::text)::uuid INTO v_org_count, v_org
+      FROM public.partner_accounts pa JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+     WHERE pa.id = v_order.partner_id AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+       AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status = 'ativa';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_org_count <> 1 OR v_org IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_FINANCIAL_TENANT_AMBIGUOUS' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_uid IS NOT NULL THEN
+    -- c2_ord_internal_scope: emissor interno é limitado por h15 = tenant do título (abaixo);
+    -- quem tem papel B2B externo continua passando pelo assert canônico.
+    IF public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b'::app_role) OR public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::app_role) THEN
+      PERFORM platform_private.assert_b2b_partner_scope(v_uid,v_order.partner_id);
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT public.is_platform_superadmin(v_uid) AND public.h15_actor_organization() IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_FINANCIAL_TENANT_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_order.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN
+    PERFORM platform_private.c2_external_origin_assert(v_order.c2_external_origin_snapshot,v_order.partner_id,v_order.cliente_id);
+    IF v_org::text IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'creditor_organization_id' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_CREDITOR_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- GATE Fase C: elegibilidade server-side
+  v_gate := public.fn_b2b_order_billing_eligibility(p_partner_order_id);
+  IF NOT (v_gate->>'eligible')::boolean THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs(order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_novos)
+      VALUES (p_partner_order_id, v_order.partner_id, v_uid, 'financeiro_bloqueado_gate', v_gate);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'billing_not_eligible:%', v_gate->>'reason_code';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- H6C-001: condicao canonica vinculada ao pedido (nunca a mais recente).
+  SELECT * INTO v_terms FROM public.partner_order_payment_terms
+    WHERE id = NULLIF(v_gate->>'payment_terms_id','')::uuid
+      AND partner_order_id = p_partner_order_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'payment_terms_not_canonical'; END IF;
+
+  SELECT receivable_id INTO v_existing FROM public.partner_order_financial_links WHERE partner_order_id = p_partner_order_id;
+  IF v_existing IS NOT NULL THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs(order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_novos)
+      VALUES (p_partner_order_id, v_order.partner_id, v_uid, 'financeiro_duplicidade_bloqueada', jsonb_build_object('receivable_id', v_existing));
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('receivable_id', v_existing, 'partner_order_id', p_partner_order_id, 'duplicado', true);
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_partner FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id = v_order.partner_id;
+  SELECT * INTO v_settings FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = v_order.partner_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    -- c2_ord_p1_no_provision: only the existing P1 CAS RPC creates settings.
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_FINANCIAL_SETTINGS_NOT_CONFIGURED' USING ERRCODE='P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- External manual billing must honor configured delivery prerequisite too.
+  IF v_order.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND v_settings.billing_trigger='na_entrega' AND v_order.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'entregue' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_DELIVERY_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_uf := to_jsonb(v_partner) ->> 'uf';
+
+  -- Derivação fiscal (fail-closed; nunca NOT_REQUIRED silencioso)
+  v_fiscal := public.fn_fiscal_requirement_resolve(
+    'b2b_partner', 'venda_mercadoria', v_uf, 'partner_order', p_partner_order_id, CURRENT_DATE);
+
+  -- c2_ord_strict_refs: financial_categories/payment_methods são catálogos globais por desenho (sem organization_id, RLS is_financial_staff; sem DDL de tenant
+  -- no schema canônico); resolução estrita, sem fallback de tipo/inativo, falha explícita.
+  SELECT id INTO v_category_id FROM public.financial_categories
+   WHERE upper(btrim(type)) = 'RECEITA' AND active IS TRUE
+   ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1;
+  IF v_category_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_REVENUE_CATEGORY_NOT_CONFIGURED' USING ERRCODE='P0001';
+  END IF;
+  IF NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_settings.default_payment_method,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_CONFIGURED' USING ERRCODE='P0001';
+  END IF;
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.payment_methods pm
+       WHERE pm.active IS TRUE AND lower(btrim(pm.name)) = lower(btrim(v_settings.default_payment_method))) <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_CONFIGURED' USING ERRCODE='P0001';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT pm.id INTO v_payment_method_id FROM public.payment_methods pm
+   WHERE pm.active IS TRUE AND lower(btrim(pm.name)) = lower(btrim(v_settings.default_payment_method));
+  IF v_partner.client_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes cl WHERE cl.id = v_partner.client_id AND cl.organization_id = v_org) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_CUSTOMER_TENANT_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.accounts_receivable(
+    organization_id, origin_type, origin_id, customer_id, partner_id, description,
+    category_id, total_amount, issue_date, first_due_date, installment_count,
+    status, fiscal_invoice_required, fiscal_invoice_status,
+    fiscal_requirement_source, fiscal_policy_id, fiscal_exemption_id,
+    payment_method_id, notes, created_by
+  ) VALUES (
+    v_org, 'B2B_ORDER', p_partner_order_id,
+    NULLIF(v_partner.client_id, NULL), v_order.partner_id,
+    format('Pedido B2B %s - %s', v_order.numero, COALESCE(v_partner.nome_fantasia, v_partner.razao_social)),
+    v_category_id, v_terms.final_amount, CURRENT_DATE, v_terms.first_due_date, v_terms.installment_count,
+    'OPEN',
+    (v_fiscal->>'required')::boolean,
+    v_fiscal->>'status',
+    v_fiscal->>'source',
+    NULLIF(v_fiscal->>'policy_id','')::uuid,
+    NULLIF(v_fiscal->>'exemption_id','')::uuid,
+    v_payment_method_id,
+    format(E'Condição: %s (%s)\nDesconto: %s%%  Juros: %s%% a.m. x %s meses\nTabela: %s  Líquido: %s  Final: %s\nFiscal: %s (%s)',
+           v_terms.plan_name_snapshot, v_terms.plan_code_snapshot,
+           v_terms.discount_percent_snapshot, v_terms.monthly_interest_percent_snapshot, v_terms.months_count_snapshot,
+           v_terms.table_amount, v_terms.net_amount_after_discount, v_terms.final_amount,
+           v_fiscal->>'status', v_fiscal->>'source'),
+    COALESCE(v_uid, v_order.created_by)
+  ) RETURNING id INTO v_receivable_id;
+
+  -- b2b_f1_fresh_title: no deletion; formal financial history protection preserved.
+
+  FOR v_sch IN
+    SELECT * FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule
+     WHERE partner_order_id = p_partner_order_id AND payment_terms_id = v_terms.id
+     ORDER BY installment_number
+  LOOP
+    -- b2b_f1_reuse_installments: generic title trigger already created them.
+    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments
+         WHERE receivable_id=v_receivable_id AND installment_number=v_sch.installment_number
+           AND organization_id=v_org) <> 1 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INSTALLMENT_CARDINALITY_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514';
+    END IF;
+    UPDATE public.accounts_receivable_installments
+       SET due_date=v_sch.due_date, original_amount=v_sch.amount,
+           interest_amount=COALESCE(v_sch.interest_amount,0), net_amount=v_sch.amount
+     WHERE receivable_id=v_receivable_id AND installment_number=v_sch.installment_number
+       AND organization_id=v_org
+     RETURNING id INTO v_ari_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.partner_order_payment_schedule
+       SET status = 'generated', receivable_installment_id = v_ari_id
+     WHERE id = v_sch.id;
+
+    v_installments_json := v_installments_json || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'installment_number', v_sch.installment_number,
+      'due_date', v_sch.due_date,
+      'amount', v_sch.amount
+    ));
+  END LOOP;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.partner_order_financial_links(
+    partner_order_id, partner_id, receivable_id, financial_status, billing_trigger, created_by
+  ) VALUES (
+    p_partner_order_id, v_order.partner_id, v_receivable_id, 'gerado', v_settings.billing_trigger, v_uid
+  );
+
+  UPDATE public.partner_orders SET
+    financial_status = 'gerado',
+    receivable_generated = true,
+    receivable_generated_at = now(),
+    receivable_generated_by = v_uid,
+    payment_due_date = v_terms.first_due_date,
+    payment_method = COALESCE(v_settings.default_payment_method,'pix')
+  WHERE id = p_partner_order_id;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs(order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_novos)
+  VALUES (p_partner_order_id, v_order.partner_id, v_uid, 'financeiro_gerado_com_plano',
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'receivable_id', v_receivable_id,
+      'plan_code', v_terms.plan_code_snapshot,
+      'plan_name', v_terms.plan_name_snapshot,
+      'table_amount', v_terms.table_amount,
+      'discount_amount', v_terms.discount_amount,
+      'net_amount', v_terms.net_amount_after_discount,
+      'interest_amount', v_terms.financial_interest_amount,
+      'final_amount', v_terms.final_amount,
+      'first_due_date', v_terms.first_due_date,
+      'installment_count', v_terms.installment_count,
+      'fiscal', v_fiscal,
+      'gate', v_gate,
+      'installments', v_installments_json
+    ));
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'receivable_id', v_receivable_id,
+    'partner_order_id', p_partner_order_id,
+    'valor', v_terms.final_amount,
+    'vencimento', v_terms.first_due_date,
+    'installment_count', v_terms.installment_count,
+    'fiscal_invoice_required', (v_fiscal->>'required')::boolean,
+    'fiscal_invoice_status', v_fiscal->>'status',
+    'fiscal_requirement_source', v_fiscal->>'source',
+    'status', 'OPEN'
+  );
+END 
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_production_orders_from_partner(p_partner_order_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_planning_id uuid;
+  v_partner_id uuid;
+  v_order_numero text;
+  v_order_status text;
+  v_ready boolean;
+  v_partner_nome text;
+  v_grp RECORD;
+  v_item RECORD;
+  v_os_id uuid;
+  v_numero text;
+  v_count int := 0;
+  v_nonlab_count int := 0;
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_ids uuid[] := ARRAY[]::uuid[];
+  v_anchor_item_id uuid;
+BEGIN
+ IF NOT platform_private.lab_partner_order_authorized(p_partner_order_id) THEN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'LAB_PARTNER_SCOPE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id=p_partner_order_id AND internal_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_DOWNSTREAM_UNVERIFIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  -- H5-B01: serializa geração concorrente por pedido (idempotência de resultado)
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('generate_production_orders_from_partner:' || p_partner_order_id::text));
+
+  SELECT po.partner_id, po.numero, po.status::text, po.ready_for_production
+    INTO v_partner_id, v_order_numero, v_order_status, v_ready
+  FROM public.partner_orders po
+  WHERE po.id = p_partner_order_id;
+
+  IF v_partner_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido B2B não encontrado';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_order_status IN ('cancelado','reprovado','faturado','entregue') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido B2B não pode gerar produção (status: %)', v_order_status;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Fase 7: bloqueia produção enquanto aprovação financeira exigida está pendente/rejeitada
+   IF EXISTS (
+     SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders po2
+     WHERE po2.id = p_partner_order_id
+       AND po2.requires_financial_approval = true
+       AND po2.financial_approval_status IN ('pending','rejected')
+   ) THEN
+     RAISE EXCEPTION 'financial_approval_required_before_production';
+   END IF;
+
+   IF v_order_status <> 'aprovado' OR v_ready IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido B2B ainda não está aprovado para produção.';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT id INTO v_planning_id FROM public.production_planning WHERE partner_order_id = p_partner_order_id;
+  IF v_planning_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Planejamento não encontrado para o pedido %', p_partner_order_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(nome_fantasia, razao_social) INTO v_partner_nome FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id = v_partner_id;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_nonlab_count FROM public.partner_order_items poi
+   WHERE poi.order_id=p_partner_order_id
+     AND NOT platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable(poi.product_id,poi.microrganismo_id);
+
+  FOR v_grp IN
+    WITH itens AS (
+      SELECT poi.id,
+             poi.product_id,
+             poi.quantidade,
+             COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') AS unidade_medida,
+             poi.preco_tabela_snapshot,
+             poi.preco_unitario,
+             poi.produto_nome_snapshot,
+             poi.produto_codigo_snapshot,
+             poi.created_at,
+             cv.volume_ml AS vasilhame_volume_ml
+      FROM public.partner_order_items poi
+      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+        SELECT cv2.volume_ml
+          FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv2
+         WHERE cv2.item_tipo = 'produto'
+           AND cv2.produto_id = poi.product_id
+           AND cv2.ativo = true
+         ORDER BY (cv2.preco_brl = COALESCE(poi.preco_tabela_snapshot, poi.preco_unitario)) DESC,
+                  ABS(cv2.preco_brl - COALESCE(poi.preco_tabela_snapshot, poi.preco_unitario)) ASC
+         LIMIT 1
+      ) cv ON true
+      WHERE poi.order_id = p_partner_order_id
+        AND poi.product_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable(poi.product_id,poi.microrganismo_id)
+        AND COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') <> 'hectare'
+        AND NOT EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1 FROM public.production_order_link l WHERE l.partner_order_item_id = poi.id
+        )
+    )
+    SELECT product_id,
+           MIN(produto_nome_snapshot) AS produto_nome,
+           MIN(produto_codigo_snapshot) AS produto_codigo,
+           SUM(
+             CASE unidade_medida
+               WHEN 'ml'    THEN quantidade
+               WHEN 'litro' THEN quantidade * 1000
+               WHEN 'unidade' THEN quantidade * vasilhame_volume_ml
+               WHEN 'dose'    THEN quantidade * vasilhame_volume_ml
+               ELSE NULL
+             END
+           ) AS volume_total_ml,
+           bool_or(
+             unidade_medida IN ('unidade','dose') AND vasilhame_volume_ml IS NULL
+           ) AS faltou_vasilhame,
+           array_agg(id ORDER BY created_at, id) AS item_ids,
+           (array_agg(id ORDER BY created_at, id))[1] AS anchor_id
+    FROM itens
+    GROUP BY product_id
+  LOOP
+    IF v_grp.faltou_vasilhame THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Produto % (%) está em unidade/dose mas não tem vasilhame ativo no catálogo. Configure o vasilhame antes de gerar produção.',
+        COALESCE(v_grp.produto_nome,'?'), COALESCE(v_grp.produto_codigo,'?');
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_grp.volume_total_ml IS NULL OR v_grp.volume_total_ml <= 0 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não foi possível calcular o volume do produto % (%).',
+        COALESCE(v_grp.produto_nome,'?'), COALESCE(v_grp.produto_codigo,'?');
+    END IF;
+
+    v_anchor_item_id := v_grp.anchor_id;
+    v_numero := 'OS-B2B-' || to_char(now(),'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text,'-',''),1,6);
+
+    INSERT INTO public.ordens_servico (
+      cliente_id, fazenda_id, talhao_id, produto_id, volume_total_ml, area_hectares,
+      prioridade, status, tipo_item, numero_os,
+      partner_order_id, partner_order_item_id, origem
+    ) VALUES (
+      NULL, NULL, NULL, v_grp.product_id, v_grp.volume_total_ml, NULL,
+      'media','aberta','produto', v_numero,
+      p_partner_order_id, v_anchor_item_id, 'b2b'
+    ) RETURNING id INTO v_os_id;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.production_order_link (
+      partner_order_id, partner_order_item_id, planning_id, ordem_servico_id, created_by
+    )
+    SELECT p_partner_order_id, unnest(v_grp.item_ids), v_planning_id, v_os_id, v_uid;
+
+    v_ids := array_append(v_ids, v_os_id);
+    v_count := v_count + 1;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  FOR v_item IN
+    SELECT poi.* FROM public.partner_order_items poi
+    WHERE poi.order_id = p_partner_order_id
+      AND platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable(poi.product_id,poi.microrganismo_id)
+      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.production_order_link l WHERE l.partner_order_item_id = poi.id)
+      AND (
+        poi.product_id IS NULL
+        OR COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'hectare'
+      )
+  LOOP
+    v_numero := 'OS-B2B-' || to_char(now(),'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text,'-',''),1,6);
+
+    INSERT INTO public.ordens_servico (
+      cliente_id, fazenda_id, talhao_id, produto_id, microrganismo_id, volume_total_ml, area_hectares,
+      prioridade, status, tipo_item, numero_os,
+      partner_order_id, partner_order_item_id, origem
+    ) VALUES (
+      NULL, NULL, NULL, v_item.product_id, v_item.microrganismo_id, NULL,
+      CASE WHEN COALESCE(v_item.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'hectare' THEN v_item.quantidade ELSE NULL END,
+      'media','aberta',
+      CASE WHEN v_item.product_id IS NULL THEN 'microrganismo' ELSE 'produto' END,
+      v_numero,
+      p_partner_order_id, v_item.id, 'b2b'
+    ) RETURNING id INTO v_os_id;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.production_order_link (
+      partner_order_id, partner_order_item_id, planning_id, ordem_servico_id, created_by
+    ) VALUES (p_partner_order_id, v_item.id, v_planning_id, v_os_id, v_uid);
+
+    v_ids := array_append(v_ids, v_os_id);
+    v_count := v_count + 1;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  IF v_count = 0 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'os_created', 0, 'planning_id', v_planning_id,
+                              'non_lab_items',v_nonlab_count, 'message', 'Nenhuma nova OS biológica gerada; itens não laboratoriais permanecem no pedido.');
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.production_planning
+     SET status = 'planejado', updated_at = now()
+   WHERE id = v_planning_id AND status = 'aguardando_planejamento';
+
+  INSERT INTO public.production_timeline_events (partner_order_id, event_type, actor_id, meta)
+  VALUES (p_partner_order_id, 'op_gerada', v_uid, jsonb_build_object('os_count', v_count, 'planning_id', v_planning_id));
+
+  INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs (order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_novos)
+  VALUES (
+    p_partner_order_id, v_partner_id, v_uid, 'op_gerada',
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'planning_id', v_planning_id,
+      'os_count', v_count,
+      'ordens_servico_ids', to_jsonb(v_ids),
+      'created_at', now()
+    )
+  );
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'os_created', v_count, 'planning_id', v_planning_id, 'ordens_servico_ids', to_jsonb(v_ids), 'non_lab_items',v_nonlab_count);
+END
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gerar_codigo_lote(_ano integer DEFAULT (EXTRACT(year FROM now()))::integer)
+ RETURNS text
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_prefix text := 'LT-' || _ano::text || '-';
+  v_next int;
+BEGIN
+  IF _ano IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'LOTE_ANO_INVALIDO';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Serializa o cálculo sequencial por ano dentro da transação chamadora.
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('gerar_codigo_lote:' || _ano::text));
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(regexp_replace(split_part(codigo_lote, '-', 3), '\D', '', 'g'), '')::int), 0) + 1
+    INTO v_next
+    FROM public.lotes
+   WHERE codigo_lote LIKE v_prefix || '%';
+
+  RETURN v_prefix || lpad(v_next::text, 4, '0');
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(_user_id uuid)
+ RETURNS uuid[]
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT CASE WHEN public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_user_id) THEN ARRAY(
+    SELECT uc.cliente_id
+      FROM public.user_clientes uc
+     WHERE uc.user_id = _user_id
+       AND uc.is_active = true
+       AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL
+       AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from <= now())
+       AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
+    UNION
+    SELECT pr.cliente_id
+      FROM public.profiles pr
+     WHERE pr.user_id = _user_id
+       AND pr.cliente_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND EXISTS (
+         SELECT 1 FROM public.user_clientes uc2
+          WHERE uc2.user_id = pr.user_id
+            AND uc2.cliente_id = pr.cliente_id
+            AND uc2.is_active = true
+            AND uc2.revoked_at IS NULL
+            AND (uc2.valid_from IS NULL OR uc2.valid_from <= now())
+            AND (uc2.valid_until IS NULL OR uc2.valid_until >= now())
+       )
+  ) ELSE ARRAY[]::uuid[] END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_alerts(p_reference_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
+ RETURNS TABLE(alert_type text, severity text, title text, description text, amount numeric, count integer, action_key text)
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
+
+  -- 1 entregas sem faturamento
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT 'DELIVERIES_PENDING_BILLING'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
+         'Entregas confirmadas sem faturamento'::text,
+         'Existem entregas concluídas que ainda não geraram conta a receber.'::text,
+         COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)::numeric,
+         COUNT(*)::int, 'entregas-nao-faturadas'::text
+    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
+   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL
+  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
+
+  -- 2 recebimentos vencidos
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT 'OVERDUE_RECEIVABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
+         'Recebimentos vencidos'::text,
+         'Parcelas a receber em atraso.'::text,
+         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
+         COUNT(*)::int, 'receber-vencidos'::text
+    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
+   WHERE ari.due_date < p_reference_date AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
+  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
+
+  -- 3 pagamentos vencidos
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT 'OVERDUE_PAYABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
+         'Pagamentos vencidos'::text,
+         'Parcelas a pagar em atraso.'::text,
+         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
+         COUNT(*)::int, 'pagar-vencidos'::text
+    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
+   WHERE api.due_date < p_reference_date AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
+  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
+
+  -- 4 NF-e pendente
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT 'PENDING_FISCAL_INVOICE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
+         'NF-e pendente'::text,
+         'Contas a receber aguardando emissão de NF-e.'::text,
+         COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'nfe-pendente'::text
+    FROM accounts_receivable
+   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
+  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
+
+  -- 5 categorias sem DRE
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT 'UNCLASSIFIED_DRE'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
+         'Categorias sem classificação DRE'::text,
+         'Algumas categorias usadas em títulos não têm grupo DRE definido.'::text,
+         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'categorias-dre'::text
+    FROM financial_categories fc
+   WHERE fc.dre_group IS NULL
+     AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.category_id = fc.id)
+       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable ap WHERE ap.category_id = fc.id))
+  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
+
+  -- 6 recorrências com falha
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT 'RECURRING_FAILED'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
+         'Recorrências com falha'::text,
+         'Erros recentes na geração automática de títulos recorrentes.'::text,
+         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
+    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= (p_reference_date - INTERVAL '30 days')
+  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
+
+  -- 7 recorrências atrasadas
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT 'RECURRING_DUE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
+         'Recorrências atrasadas para geração'::text,
+         'Modelos recorrentes ativos com geração pendente.'::text,
+         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
+    FROM recurring_financial_templates
+   WHERE active = true AND auto_generate = true
+     AND next_generation_date IS NOT NULL AND next_generation_date < p_reference_date
+  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
+
+  -- 8 contas sem centro de custo
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT 'MISSING_COST_CENTER'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
+         'Contas sem centro de custo'::text,
+         'Títulos financeiros sem centro de custo associado.'::text,
+         0::numeric,
+         ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
+        + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'))::int,
+         'centros-custo'::text
+   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
+      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED');
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_dashboard_summary(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_cost_center_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  r jsonb;
+  v_rec_expected numeric := 0; v_rec_received numeric := 0;
+  v_rec_open numeric := 0; v_rec_overdue numeric := 0; v_rec_partial numeric := 0;
+  v_rec_overdue_count int := 0; v_rec_avg_days int := 0;
+  v_pay_expected numeric := 0; v_pay_paid numeric := 0;
+  v_pay_open numeric := 0; v_pay_overdue numeric := 0; v_pay_partial numeric := 0;
+  v_pay_overdue_count int := 0;
+  v_nfe_count int := 0; v_nfe_amount numeric := 0;
+  v_deliv_count int := 0; v_deliv_amount numeric := 0;
+  v_rec_recurring numeric := 0; v_pay_recurring numeric := 0;
+  v_rec_errors int := 0;
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
+  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- A receber (previsto: pelo vencimento no período)
+  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount),0),
+         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
+           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
+         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
+           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
+         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
+           FILTER (WHERE ari.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
+         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)::int,
+         COALESCE(AVG((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - ari.due_date)
+           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0)::int
+    INTO v_rec_expected, v_rec_open, v_rec_overdue, v_rec_partial, v_rec_overdue_count, v_rec_avg_days
+    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
+    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
+   WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
+     AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
+     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
+     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
+     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);
+
+  -- A receber (realizado: por payment_date)
+  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0)
+    INTO v_rec_received
+    FROM receivable_payments rp
+    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
+    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
+   WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
+     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
+     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
+     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);
+
+  -- A pagar (previsto)
+  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount),0),
+         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
+           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
+         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
+           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
+         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
+           FILTER (WHERE api.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
+         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)::int
+    INTO v_pay_expected, v_pay_open, v_pay_overdue, v_pay_partial, v_pay_overdue_count
+    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
+    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
+   WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
+     AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
+     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
+     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);
+
+  -- A pagar (realizado)
+  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid),0)
+    INTO v_pay_paid
+    FROM payable_payments pp
+    JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
+    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
+   WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
+     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
+     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);
+
+  -- NF-e pendente
+  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)
+    INTO v_nfe_count, v_nfe_amount
+    FROM accounts_receivable
+   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true
+     AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING';
+
+  -- Entregas pendentes faturamento
+  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)
+    INTO v_deliv_count, v_deliv_amount
+    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
+   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL;
+
+  -- Recorrências ativas
+  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='RECEIVABLE'),0),
+         COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='PAYABLE'),0)
+    INTO v_rec_recurring, v_pay_recurring
+    FROM recurring_financial_templates
+   WHERE active = true;
+
+  SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO v_rec_errors
+    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= ((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - INTERVAL '30 days');
+
+  r := jsonb_build_object(
+    'total_receivable_expected', v_rec_expected,
+    'total_receivable_received', v_rec_received,
+    'total_receivable_open', v_rec_open,
+    'total_receivable_overdue', v_rec_overdue,
+    'total_receivable_partial', v_rec_partial,
+    'overdue_receivables_count', v_rec_overdue_count,
+    'average_days_overdue', v_rec_avg_days,
+    'total_payable_expected', v_pay_expected,
+    'total_payable_paid', v_pay_paid,
+    'total_payable_open', v_pay_open,
+    'total_payable_overdue', v_pay_overdue,
+    'total_payable_partial', v_pay_partial,
+    'overdue_payables_count', v_pay_overdue_count,
+    'projected_balance', v_rec_expected - v_pay_expected,
+    'realized_balance', v_rec_received - v_pay_paid,
+    'collection_rate', CASE WHEN v_rec_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_rec_received / v_rec_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
+    'payment_rate', CASE WHEN v_pay_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_pay_paid / v_pay_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
+    'pending_fiscal_invoice_count', v_nfe_count,
+    'pending_fiscal_invoice_amount', v_nfe_amount,
+    'pending_billing_deliveries_count', v_deliv_count,
+    'pending_billing_deliveries_amount', v_deliv_amount,
+    'active_recurring_receivables_amount', v_rec_recurring,
+    'active_recurring_payables_amount', v_pay_recurring,
+    'recurring_net_balance', v_rec_recurring - v_pay_recurring,
+    'recurring_generation_errors_count', v_rec_errors
+  );
+  RETURN r;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id uuid)
+ RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_tipo text, product_id uuid, produto_nome text, produto_codigo text, descricao_curta text, preco_tabela numeric, desconto_percentual numeric, preco_parceiro numeric, produto_ativo boolean, resumo_curto text, explicacao_b2b text, beneficios_principais text, ficha_status text, ficha_aprovada boolean, valor_dose_brl numeric, valor_litro_brl numeric, valor_ha_brl numeric, unidade_preco_principal text)
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_visibility_scope uuid[];
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_super boolean; s record; r record;
+  v_pid uuid; v_mid uuid; j_ha jsonb; j_li jsonb; j_do jsonb;
+  n_ha numeric; n_li numeric; n_do numeric; v_base numeric; v_unid text;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF p_partner_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa
+       WHERE pa.id = p_partner_id AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'partner_not_found' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+  END IF;
+  v_super := public.is_platform_superadmin(v_uid);
+  IF NOT v_super THEN
+    IF public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::app_role) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_financial_terms' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT * INTO s FROM platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(v_uid);
+    IF (NOT s.profile_ok OR s.org_partner IS DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id OR NOT s.partner_valid)
+       AND NOT (platform_private.b2b_internal_commercial_actor()
+                AND platform_private.c2_internal_order_target_reason(v_uid, p_partner_id) IS NULL) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_partner' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b'::app_role) THEN
+      IF s.user_partner_count <> 1 OR s.user_partner IS DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_partner' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+      END IF;
+    ELSIF NOT (public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador'::app_role) OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor_comercial'::app_role)) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_role' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT s.has_catalog THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature_not_entitled' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_visibility_scope := platform_private.c1b_catalog_visibility_scope(p_partner_id);
+  FOR r IN
+    SELECT p.id, 'produto'::text AS tipo, p.nome, p.codigo, p.ativo,
+           ptp.status_validacao, ptp.resumo_curto, ptp.explicacao_b2b, ptp.beneficio_combinado AS beneficios
+      FROM public.produtos p LEFT JOIN public.product_technical_profiles ptp ON ptp.produto_id = p.id
+     WHERE p.ativo = true AND p.b2b_enabled = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility cv WHERE cv.organization_id=ANY(v_visibility_scope) AND cv.entity_type='produto' AND cv.hidden IS TRUE AND cv.produto_id=p.id)
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT m.id, 'microrganismo'::text, m.nome, m.codigo, m.ativo,
+           mtp.status_validacao, mtp.resumo_curto, mtp.explicacao_b2b, mtp.beneficios_agronomicos
+      FROM public.microrganismos m LEFT JOIN public.microorganism_technical_profiles mtp ON mtp.microrganismo_id = m.id
+     WHERE m.ativo = true AND m.b2b_enabled = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility cv WHERE cv.organization_id=ANY(v_visibility_scope) AND cv.entity_type='microrganismo' AND cv.hidden IS TRUE AND cv.microrganismo_id=m.id)
+  LOOP
+    v_pid := CASE WHEN r.tipo='produto' THEN r.id END;
+    v_mid := CASE WHEN r.tipo='microrganismo' THEN r.id END;
+    j_ha := public.fn_b2b_resolve_base_unit_price(p_partner_id, v_pid, v_mid, 'hectare', NULL, current_date);
+    j_li := public.fn_b2b_resolve_base_unit_price(p_partner_id, v_pid, v_mid, 'litro',   NULL, current_date);
+    j_do := public.fn_b2b_resolve_base_unit_price(p_partner_id, v_pid, v_mid, 'dose',    NULL, current_date);
+    n_ha := CASE WHEN COALESCE((j_ha->>'ok')::boolean,false) THEN NULLIF((j_ha->>'base_price')::numeric,0) END;
+    n_li := CASE WHEN COALESCE((j_li->>'ok')::boolean,false) THEN NULLIF((j_li->>'base_price')::numeric,0) END;
+    n_do := CASE WHEN COALESCE((j_do->>'ok')::boolean,false) THEN NULLIF((j_do->>'base_price')::numeric,0) END;
+    v_unid := CASE WHEN n_ha IS NOT NULL THEN 'hectare' WHEN n_li IS NOT NULL THEN 'litro'
+                   WHEN n_do IS NOT NULL THEN 'dose_100ml' ELSE 'sob_consulta' END;
+    v_base := COALESCE(n_ha, n_li, n_do);
+    item_id := r.id; item_tipo := r.tipo; product_id := v_pid;
+    produto_nome := r.nome; produto_codigo := r.codigo;
+    descricao_curta := CASE WHEN r.status_validacao='aprovado' THEN LEFT(COALESCE(r.resumo_curto,''),220) END;
+    preco_tabela := ROUND(v_base,2);
+    desconto_percentual := CASE WHEN v_base IS NOT NULL THEN 0::numeric END;
+    preco_parceiro := ROUND(v_base,2);
+    produto_ativo := r.ativo;
+    resumo_curto := CASE WHEN r.status_validacao='aprovado' THEN r.resumo_curto END;
+    explicacao_b2b := CASE WHEN r.status_validacao='aprovado' THEN r.explicacao_b2b END;
+    beneficios_principais := CASE WHEN r.status_validacao='aprovado' THEN r.beneficios END;
+    ficha_status := COALESCE(r.status_validacao,'sem_ficha');
+    ficha_aprovada := (r.status_validacao = 'aprovado');
+    valor_dose_brl := ROUND(n_do,2); valor_litro_brl := ROUND(n_li,2); valor_ha_brl := ROUND(n_ha,2);
+    unidade_preco_principal := v_unid;
+    RETURN NEXT;
+  END LOOP;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id uuid, p_catalog_v2 boolean)
+ RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_tipo text, product_id uuid, produto_nome text, produto_codigo text, descricao_curta text, preco_tabela numeric, desconto_percentual numeric, preco_parceiro numeric, produto_ativo boolean, resumo_curto text, explicacao_b2b text, beneficios_principais text, ficha_status text, ficha_aprovada boolean, valor_dose_brl numeric, valor_litro_brl numeric, valor_ha_brl numeric, unidade_preco_principal text, familia_catalogo text, catalog_contract text, ficha_conteudo jsonb)
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+ IF p_catalog_v2 IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_contract_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ RETURN QUERY SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='microrganismo' THEN 'biologico'::text ELSE p.familia_catalogo END, 'C1B_DUAL_TENANT_V1'::text,
+ CASE WHEN r.ficha_aprovada IS TRUE THEN jsonb_build_object(
+  'subtitulo', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.tipo::text ELSE m.nome_cientifico END,
+  'funcao', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.funcao_completa ELSE m.funcao_agronomica END,
+  'dose_ml_ha', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.dose_ml_ha ELSE m.dose_ml_ha END,
+  'explicacao_produtor', COALESCE(pp.explicacao_produtor,mp.explicacao_produtor),
+  'indicacoes_uso', COALESCE(pp.indicacoes_uso,mp.indicacoes_uso),
+  'cuidados_aplicacao', COALESCE(pp.cuidados_aplicacao,mp.cuidados_aplicacao),
+  'mecanismo_acao', mp.mecanismo_acao,
+  'alvos_count', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN
+    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.product_target_recommendations t WHERE t.produto_id=r.item_id AND t.ativo IS TRUE)
+    ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_targets t WHERE t.microrganismo_id=r.item_id AND t.ativo IS TRUE) END,
+  'fontes_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.catalog_technical_sources cs WHERE cs.entidade_id=r.item_id
+    AND cs.entidade_tipo IN (r.item_tipo, 'ficha_' || r.item_tipo))
+ ) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
+ FROM public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id) r
+ LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON r.item_tipo='produto' AND p.id=r.item_id
+ LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON r.item_tipo='microrganismo' AND m.id=r.item_id
+ LEFT JOIN public.product_technical_profiles pp ON r.item_tipo='produto' AND pp.produto_id=r.item_id AND pp.status_validacao='aprovado'
+ LEFT JOIN public.microorganism_technical_profiles mp ON r.item_tipo='microrganismo' AND mp.microrganismo_id=r.item_id AND mp.status_validacao='aprovado';
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_partner_catalog_tecnico_secure()
+ RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_tipo text, nome text, codigo text, descricao_curta text, tipo text, nome_cientifico text, funcao text, dose_ml_ha numeric, valor_dose_brl numeric, valor_litro_brl numeric, valor_ha_brl numeric, preco_tabela_dose numeric, preco_tabela_litro numeric, preco_tabela_ha numeric, unidade_preco_principal text, resumo_curto text, explicacao_b2b text, beneficios_principais text, ficha_status text, ficha_aprovada boolean)
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_visibility_scope uuid[];
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_super boolean; v_is_tec boolean; v_is_partner boolean; v_is_internal boolean;
+  v_partner uuid; v_show_fin boolean := false; s record; r record;
+  v_pid uuid; v_mid uuid; j_ha jsonb; j_li jsonb; j_do jsonb;
+  n_ha numeric; n_li numeric; n_do numeric;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  v_super := public.is_platform_superadmin(v_uid);
+  v_is_tec := public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::app_role);
+  v_is_partner := public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b'::app_role);
+  v_is_internal := public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador'::app_role) OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor_comercial'::app_role);
+
+  IF NOT v_super THEN
+    IF NOT (v_is_tec OR v_is_partner OR v_is_internal) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_role' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT * INTO s FROM platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(v_uid);
+    IF NOT s.profile_ok THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'inactive_scope' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+    IF v_is_tec OR v_is_partner THEN
+      IF s.user_partner_count <> 1 OR s.org_partner IS NULL OR s.user_partner IS DISTINCT FROM s.org_partner
+         OR NOT s.partner_valid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_partner' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+      END IF;
+      v_partner := s.org_partner;
+      v_show_fin := v_is_partner AND NOT v_is_tec;
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT s.has_catalog THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature_not_entitled' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_visibility_scope := platform_private.c1b_catalog_visibility_scope(v_partner);
+  FOR r IN
+    SELECT p.id, 'produto'::text AS itipo, p.nome, p.codigo, p.tipo::text AS ptipo,
+           NULL::text AS nome_cientifico, p.funcao_completa AS funcao, p.dose_ml_ha,
+           ptp.status_validacao, ptp.resumo_curto, ptp.explicacao_b2b, ptp.beneficio_combinado AS beneficios, p.descricao
+      FROM public.produtos p JOIN public.product_technical_profiles ptp ON ptp.produto_id = p.id
+     WHERE p.ativo = true AND p.b2b_enabled = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility cv WHERE cv.organization_id=ANY(v_visibility_scope) AND cv.entity_type='produto' AND cv.hidden IS TRUE AND cv.produto_id=p.id) AND ptp.status_validacao = 'aprovado'
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT m.id, 'microrganismo'::text, m.nome, m.codigo, m.tipo::text,
+           m.nome_cientifico, m.funcao_agronomica, m.dose_ml_ha,
+           mtp.status_validacao, mtp.resumo_curto, mtp.explicacao_b2b, mtp.beneficios_agronomicos, m.descricao
+      FROM public.microrganismos m JOIN public.microorganism_technical_profiles mtp ON mtp.microrganismo_id = m.id
+     WHERE m.ativo = true AND m.b2b_enabled = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility cv WHERE cv.organization_id=ANY(v_visibility_scope) AND cv.entity_type='microrganismo' AND cv.hidden IS TRUE AND cv.microrganismo_id=m.id) AND mtp.status_validacao = 'aprovado'
+  LOOP
+    n_ha := NULL; n_li := NULL; n_do := NULL;
+    IF v_show_fin THEN
+      v_pid := CASE WHEN r.itipo='produto' THEN r.id END;
+      v_mid := CASE WHEN r.itipo='microrganismo' THEN r.id END;
+      j_ha := public.fn_resolve_commercial_price('partner', v_partner, NULL, NULL, v_pid, v_mid, 'hectare', NULL, current_date);
+      j_li := public.fn_resolve_commercial_price('partner', v_partner, NULL, NULL, v_pid, v_mid, 'litro',   NULL, current_date);
+      j_do := public.fn_resolve_commercial_price('partner', v_partner, NULL, NULL, v_pid, v_mid, 'dose',    NULL, current_date);
+      n_ha := CASE WHEN COALESCE((j_ha->>'ok')::boolean,false) AND NOT COALESCE((j_ha->>'quote_required')::boolean,false) THEN NULLIF((j_ha->>'final_unit_price')::numeric,0) END;
+      n_li := CASE WHEN COALESCE((j_li->>'ok')::boolean,false) AND NOT COALESCE((j_li->>'quote_required')::boolean,false) THEN NULLIF((j_li->>'final_unit_price')::numeric,0) END;
+      n_do := CASE WHEN COALESCE((j_do->>'ok')::boolean,false) AND NOT COALESCE((j_do->>'quote_required')::boolean,false) THEN NULLIF((j_do->>'final_unit_price')::numeric,0) END;
+    END IF;
+    item_id := r.id; item_tipo := r.itipo; nome := r.nome; codigo := r.codigo;
+    descricao_curta := COALESCE(r.resumo_curto, r.descricao);
+    tipo := r.ptipo; nome_cientifico := r.nome_cientifico; funcao := r.funcao; dose_ml_ha := r.dose_ml_ha;
+    valor_dose_brl := ROUND(n_do,2); valor_litro_brl := ROUND(n_li,2); valor_ha_brl := ROUND(n_ha,2);
+    preco_tabela_dose := ROUND(n_do,2); preco_tabela_litro := ROUND(n_li,2); preco_tabela_ha := ROUND(n_ha,2);
+    unidade_preco_principal := CASE WHEN n_ha IS NOT NULL THEN 'hectare' WHEN n_li IS NOT NULL THEN 'litro'
+                                    WHEN n_do IS NOT NULL THEN 'dose_100ml' ELSE 'sob_consulta' END;
+    resumo_curto := r.resumo_curto; explicacao_b2b := r.explicacao_b2b; beneficios_principais := r.beneficios;
+    ficha_status := r.status_validacao; ficha_aprovada := true;
+    RETURN NEXT;
+  END LOOP;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_partner_catalog_tecnico_secure(p_catalog_v2 boolean)
+ RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_tipo text, nome text, codigo text, descricao_curta text, tipo text, nome_cientifico text, funcao text, dose_ml_ha numeric, valor_dose_brl numeric, valor_litro_brl numeric, valor_ha_brl numeric, preco_tabela_dose numeric, preco_tabela_litro numeric, preco_tabela_ha numeric, unidade_preco_principal text, resumo_curto text, explicacao_b2b text, beneficios_principais text, ficha_status text, ficha_aprovada boolean, familia_catalogo text, catalog_contract text, ficha_conteudo jsonb)
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+ IF p_catalog_v2 IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_contract_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ RETURN QUERY SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='microrganismo' THEN 'biologico'::text ELSE p.familia_catalogo END, 'C1B_DUAL_TENANT_V1'::text,
+ CASE WHEN r.ficha_aprovada IS TRUE THEN jsonb_build_object(
+  'subtitulo', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.tipo::text ELSE m.nome_cientifico END,
+  'funcao', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.funcao_completa ELSE m.funcao_agronomica END,
+  'dose_ml_ha', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.dose_ml_ha ELSE m.dose_ml_ha END,
+  'explicacao_produtor', COALESCE(pp.explicacao_produtor,mp.explicacao_produtor),
+  'indicacoes_uso', COALESCE(pp.indicacoes_uso,mp.indicacoes_uso),
+  'cuidados_aplicacao', COALESCE(pp.cuidados_aplicacao,mp.cuidados_aplicacao),
+  'mecanismo_acao', mp.mecanismo_acao,
+  'alvos_count', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN
+    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.product_target_recommendations t WHERE t.produto_id=r.item_id AND t.ativo IS TRUE)
+    ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_targets t WHERE t.microrganismo_id=r.item_id AND t.ativo IS TRUE) END,
+  'fontes_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.catalog_technical_sources cs WHERE cs.entidade_id=r.item_id
+    AND cs.entidade_tipo IN (r.item_tipo, 'ficha_' || r.item_tipo))
+ ) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
+ FROM public.get_partner_catalog_tecnico_secure() r
+ LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON r.item_tipo='produto' AND p.id=r.item_id
+ LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON r.item_tipo='microrganismo' AND m.id=r.item_id
+ LEFT JOIN public.product_technical_profiles pp ON r.item_tipo='produto' AND pp.produto_id=r.item_id AND pp.status_validacao='aprovado'
+ LEFT JOIN public.microorganism_technical_profiles mp ON r.item_tipo='microrganismo' AND mp.microrganismo_id=r.item_id AND mp.status_validacao='aprovado';
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_portal_cliente_b2b_order_detail_secure(p_order_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_order public.partner_orders%ROWTYPE;
+  v_result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT x.* INTO v_order FROM public.partner_orders x
+  JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=x.partner_id
+  JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=x.cliente_id AND c.organization_id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+  WHERE x.id=p_order_id AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+  AND platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(x.cliente_id);
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  IF v_order.cliente_id IS NULL
+     OR NOT platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(v_order.cliente_id) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'header', jsonb_build_object(
+      'id', v_order.id,
+      'numero', v_order.numero,
+      'status', v_order.status,
+      'created_at', v_order.created_at,
+      'requested_delivery_date', v_order.requested_delivery_date,
+      'estimated_delivery_date', v_order.estimated_delivery_date,
+      'approved_at', v_order.approved_at,
+      'partner_id', v_order.partner_id,
+      'partner_nome', COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social),
+      'total', v_order.total,
+      'origin_simulation_id', v_order.origin_simulation_id,
+      'cultura', v_order.cultura,
+      'area_total_ha', v_order.area_total_ha
+    ),
+    'items', COALESCE((
+      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', it.id,
+        'nome', COALESCE(it.produto_nome_snapshot, p.nome, m.nome),
+        'codigo', COALESCE(it.produto_codigo_snapshot, p.codigo, m.codigo),
+        'item_tipo', CASE WHEN it.microrganismo_id IS NOT NULL AND it.product_id IS NULL THEN 'microrganismo' ELSE 'produto' END,
+        'quantidade', it.quantidade,
+        'unidade_medida', it.unidade_medida,
+        'volume_ml', it.volume_ml,
+        'preco_unitario', it.preco_unitario,
+        'subtotal', it.subtotal,
+        'produtos', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
+          'nome', p.nome,
+          'codigo', p.codigo,
+          'funcao_completa', p.funcao_completa,
+          'modo_acao', p.modo_acao,
+          'modo_aplicacao', p.modo_aplicacao,
+          'formulacoes', COALESCE((
+            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+              'microrganismos', jsonb_build_object(
+                'nome', mf.nome,
+                'concentracao_label', mf.concentracao_label
+              )
+            ) ORDER BY f.created_at)
+            FROM public.formulacoes f
+            LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos mf ON mf.id = f.microrganismo_id
+            WHERE f.produto_id = p.id AND mf.id IS NOT NULL
+          ), '[]'::jsonb)
+        ) END,
+        'microrganismos', CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
+          'nome', m.nome,
+          'codigo', m.codigo,
+          'concentracao_label', m.concentracao_label,
+          'funcao_agronomica', m.funcao_agronomica
+        ) END
+      ) ORDER BY it.created_at)
+      FROM public.partner_order_items it
+      LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON p.id = it.product_id
+      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = it.microrganismo_id
+      WHERE it.order_id = v_order.id
+    ), '[]'::jsonb)
+  ) INTO v_result
+  FROM public.partner_accounts pa
+  WHERE pa.id = v_order.partner_id;
+
+  RETURN v_result;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_portal_cliente_b2b_simulation_detail_secure(p_simulation_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_sim public.partner_simulations%ROWTYPE;
+  v_result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT x.* INTO v_sim FROM public.partner_simulations x
+  JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=x.partner_id
+  JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=x.cliente_id AND c.organization_id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+  WHERE x.id=p_simulation_id AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+  AND platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(x.cliente_id);
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  IF v_sim.cliente_id IS NULL
+     OR NOT platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(v_sim.cliente_id) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_sim.status::text NOT IN ('enviada_gestor', 'convertida_pedido') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'simulation_not_visible';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'header', jsonb_build_object(
+      'id', v_sim.id,
+      'titulo', v_sim.titulo,
+      'status', v_sim.status,
+      'total_cheio', v_sim.total_cheio,
+      'created_at', v_sim.created_at,
+      'updated_at', v_sim.updated_at,
+      'converted_order_id', v_sim.converted_order_id,
+      'partner_id', v_sim.partner_id,
+      'partner_nome', COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social),
+      'cultura', v_sim.cultura,
+      'area_total_ha', v_sim.area_total_ha,
+      'objetivo_tecnico', v_sim.objetivo_tecnico
+    ),
+    'items', COALESCE((
+      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', si.id,
+        'nome', COALESCE(si.produto_nome_snapshot, si.nome, p.nome, m.nome),
+        'codigo', COALESCE(si.produto_codigo_snapshot, p.codigo, m.codigo),
+        'item_tipo', si.item_tipo,
+        'quantidade', si.quantidade,
+        'unidade_medida', si.unidade_medida,
+        'volume_ml', si.volume_ml,
+        'valor_unitario_cheio', si.valor_unitario_cheio,
+        'subtotal', si.subtotal,
+        'produtos', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
+          'nome', p.nome,
+          'codigo', p.codigo,
+          'funcao_completa', p.funcao_completa,
+          'modo_acao', p.modo_acao,
+          'modo_aplicacao', p.modo_aplicacao,
+          'formulacoes', COALESCE((
+            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+              'microrganismos', jsonb_build_object(
+                'nome', mf.nome,
+                'concentracao_label', mf.concentracao_label
+              )
+            ) ORDER BY f.created_at)
+            FROM public.formulacoes f
+            LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos mf ON mf.id = f.microrganismo_id
+            WHERE f.produto_id = p.id AND mf.id IS NOT NULL
+          ), '[]'::jsonb)
+        ) END,
+        'microrganismos', CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
+          'nome', m.nome,
+          'codigo', m.codigo,
+          'concentracao_label', m.concentracao_label,
+          'funcao_agronomica', m.funcao_agronomica
+        ) END
+      ) ORDER BY si.created_at)
+      FROM public.partner_simulation_items si
+      LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON p.id = si.product_id
+      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = si.microrganismo_id
+      WHERE si.simulation_id = v_sim.id
+    ), '[]'::jsonb)
+  ) INTO v_result
+  FROM public.partner_accounts pa
+  WHERE pa.id = v_sim.partner_id;
+
+  RETURN v_result;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_partner_id()
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT CASE
+           WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL) <> 1 THEN NULL
+           WHEN bool_or(pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+                        AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
+                        AND pu.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
+                        AND pu.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id)
+                FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL)
+           THEN (array_agg(pu.partner_id) FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL))[1]
+         END
+  FROM public.partner_users pu
+  LEFT JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id
+  WHERE pu.user_id = auth.uid();
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_commercial_partner_registration()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_org uuid; v_owner uuid;
+BEGIN
+ v_org := public.h15_actor_organization();
+ IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_org IS NULL OR NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_context_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
+  IF NEW.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.commercial_owner_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_owner_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  NEW.commercial_owner_organization_id:=v_org;
+  NEW.created_by:=auth.uid(); NEW.codigo:='PARC-'||NEW.id::text;
+ ELSE
+  v_owner:=OLD.commercial_owner_organization_id;
+  IF v_owner IS NULL THEN SELECT c.organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id=OLD.client_id; END IF;
+  IF v_owner IS NULL OR v_owner IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_owner_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NEW.commercial_owner_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.commercial_owner_organization_id OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by OR NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.codigo IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.codigo THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_identity_immutable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  -- Individual edit with proven OLD client ownership, never a bulk legacy backfill.
+  NEW.commercial_owner_organization_id:=v_owner;
+ END IF;
+ IF NEW.client_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id=NEW.client_id AND c.organization_id=v_org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_client_scope_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF NEW.consultor_responsavel IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=NEW.consultor_responsavel AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.organization_id=v_org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_consultant_scope_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF length(trim(coalesce(NEW.razao_social,'')))<2 OR length(NEW.razao_social)>200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_invalid_name' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ IF NEW.desconto_padrao IS NULL OR NEW.desconto_padrao::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.desconto_padrao<0 OR NEW.desconto_padrao>100
+ OR (NEW.comissao_percentual IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.comissao_percentual::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.comissao_percentual<0 OR NEW.comissao_percentual>100))
+ OR (NEW.limite_credito_brl IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.limite_credito_brl::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.limite_credito_brl<0))
+ OR (NEW.meta_mensal_brl IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.meta_mensal_brl::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.meta_mensal_brl<0)) OR NEW.prazo_pagamento_padrao_dias<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_invalid_commercial_values' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_profile_sensitive_fields()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$ BEGIN IF current_user IN ('postgres','service_role','supabase_auth_admin') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador'::public.app_role) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN IF NEW.ativo IS DISTINCT FROM true OR NEW.cliente_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.organization_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.data_admissao IS NOT NULL OR NEW.observacoes_internas IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile_sensitive_fields_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; ELSE IF OLD.ativo IS NOT TRUE OR ROW(NEW.id,NEW.user_id,NEW.email,NEW.ativo,NEW.cliente_id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.created_at,NEW.data_admissao,NEW.observacoes_internas) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.user_id,OLD.email,OLD.ativo,OLD.cliente_id,OLD.organization_id,OLD.created_at,OLD.data_admissao,OLD.observacoes_internas) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile_sensitive_fields_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.h15_actor_organization()
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE sql

+ SET search_path TO ''

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_active_user_cliente_access(_user_id uuid, _cliente_id uuid, _levels text[] DEFAULT ARRAY['read'::text, 'execute'::text, 'manage'::text])
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF _user_id IS NULL OR _cliente_id IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN false;
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_user_id) THEN
+    RETURN false;
+  END IF;
+  IF public.has_role(_user_id, 'administrador'::public.app_role) THEN
+    RETURN true;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1
+      FROM public.user_clientes uc
+     WHERE uc.user_id = _user_id
+       AND uc.cliente_id = _cliente_id
+       AND uc.is_active = true
+       AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL
+       AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from <= now())
+       AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
+       AND uc.access_level::text = ANY(_levels)
+  );
+END
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$ SELECT platform_private.has_role(_user_id,_role); $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_visit_participant(p_user_id uuid, p_registro_id uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT public.technical_actor_ready(p_user_id) AND EXISTS (
