+ WHERE r.id=p_registro_id AND a.user_id=p_user_id AND a.is_active IS TRUE AND a.removed_at IS NULL
+ AND public.technical_refs_in_actor_tenant(r.cliente_id,r.fazenda_id,r.talhao_id)
+ AND public.technical_client_link(p_user_id,r.cliente_id,ARRAY['read','execute','manage']));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_delivery_staff(_uid uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_uid)
+     AND (public.has_role(_uid,'administrador'::app_role)
+      OR public.has_role(_uid,'gestor'::app_role)
+      OR public.has_role(_uid,'administrativo'::app_role)
+      OR public.has_role(_uid,'producao'::app_role)
+      OR public.has_role(_uid,'operador_onfarm'::app_role)
+      OR public.has_role(_uid,'aplicador'::app_role));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_financial_staff(_uid uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_uid) THEN
+    RETURN false;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN has_role(_uid, 'administrador'::app_role)
+      OR has_role(_uid, 'gestor'::app_role)
+      OR has_role(_uid, 'financeiro'::app_role);
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_operational_staff(_uid uuid)

+    OR public.has_role(_uid, 'producao'::app_role)
+    OR public.has_role(_uid, 'operador_onfarm'::app_role)
+  ), false);
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(p_user_id uuid, p_partner_id uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user_id)
+ AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
+ JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.user_id=p.user_id
+ JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id
+ JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+ WHERE p.user_id=p_user_id AND pa.id=p_partner_id AND p.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa'
+ AND owner.ativo AND owner.status='ativa' AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+ AND p.organization_id=pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id=owner.id
+ AND (o.partner_account_id IS NULL OR o.partner_account_id=pa.id)
+ AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND pu.valid_from<=now())
+ AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=p_user_id)=1
+ AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'))
+ AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role NOT IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_visit_responsible(p_user_id uuid, p_registro_id uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

+AS $function$

+ AND public.technical_refs_in_actor_tenant(r.cliente_id,r.fazenda_id,r.talhao_id)

+ OR r.consultor_profile_id IN (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id=p_user_id)));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_estoque_movimentacao()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_ctx jsonb := public.fn_estoque_ctx_read();
+  v_acao text;
+  v_dir text;
+  v_usuario uuid;
+  v_old_status text;
+  v_new_status text;
+  v_qtd numeric;
+  v_mudou boolean;
+  v_key text := v_ctx->>'idempotency_key';
+  v_meta jsonb := COALESCE(v_ctx->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb);
+  v_seq int;
+BEGIN
+  -- Uma operação do motor pode tocar mais de uma linha (reserva parcial).
+  -- O lançamento principal fica com a chave da operação; os complementares
+  -- recebem chave derivada determinística e são marcados como desdobramento.
+  IF v_key IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_seq
+      FROM public.estoque_movimentacoes
+     WHERE idempotency_key = v_key OR left(idempotency_key,length(v_key)+1) = v_key || '#';
+    IF v_seq > 0 THEN
+      v_meta := v_meta || jsonb_build_object('desdobramento', true, 'operacao_key', v_key);
+      v_key := v_key || '#' || v_seq::text;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.estoque_movimentacoes
+      (estoque_produto_id, acao, quantidade, status_novo, lote_id, usuario_id,
+       saldo_anterior, saldo_posterior, reservado_anterior, reservado_posterior,
+       volume_anterior, volume_posterior, unidade, direcao,
+       origem, referencia_tipo, referencia_id, motivo, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint,
+       movimentacao_origem_id, os_id, os_tipo, cliente_id, metadata)
+    VALUES (
+      NEW.id,
+      COALESCE(v_ctx->>'acao', 'entrada'),
+      NULLIF(NEW.quantidade, 0), NEW.status::text, NEW.lote_id,
+      COALESCE(auth.uid(), (v_ctx->>'usuario_id')::uuid),
+      0, COALESCE(NEW.quantidade, 0),
+      0, COALESCE(NEW.quantidade_reservada, 0),
+      0, COALESCE(NEW.volume_total, 0),
+      COALESCE(v_ctx->>'unidade', 'un'), 'entrada',
+      COALESCE(v_ctx->>'origem', 'trigger'),
+      v_ctx->>'referencia_tipo', (v_ctx->>'referencia_id')::uuid,
+      v_ctx->>'motivo', v_key, v_ctx->>'request_fingerprint',
+      (v_ctx->>'movimentacao_origem_id')::uuid,
+      NEW.reservado_para_os_id, NEW.reservado_para_os_tipo, NEW.reservado_para_cliente_id,
+      v_meta
+    );
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_mudou := (OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status)
+          OR (COALESCE(OLD.quantidade,0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(NEW.quantidade,0))
+          OR (COALESCE(OLD.quantidade_reservada,0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(NEW.quantidade_reservada,0))
+          OR (COALESCE(OLD.volume_total,0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(NEW.volume_total,0));
+  IF NOT v_mudou THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
+
+  v_old_status := OLD.status::text;
+  v_new_status := NEW.status::text;
+
+  v_acao := COALESCE(v_ctx->>'acao', CASE
+    WHEN v_new_status = 'reservado'  AND v_old_status = 'expedido'  THEN 'estorno_expedicao'
+    WHEN v_new_status = 'reservado'  AND v_old_status <> 'reservado' THEN 'reserva'
+    WHEN v_new_status = 'expedido'   AND v_old_status <> 'expedido'  THEN 'expedicao'
+    WHEN v_new_status = 'estornado'                                  THEN 'estorno_expedicao'
+    WHEN v_old_status = 'reservado'  AND v_new_status = 'disponivel' THEN 'cancelamento_reserva'
+    WHEN v_old_status = v_new_status THEN 'ajuste'
+    ELSE 'edicao'
+  END);
+
+  v_dir := COALESCE(v_ctx->>'direcao', CASE
+    WHEN COALESCE(NEW.quantidade,0) > COALESCE(OLD.quantidade,0) THEN 'entrada'
+    WHEN COALESCE(NEW.quantidade,0) < COALESCE(OLD.quantidade,0) THEN 'saida'
+    WHEN v_acao IN ('expedicao','descarte','perda','consumo','entrega') THEN 'saida'
+    WHEN v_acao IN ('estorno_expedicao','devolucao') THEN 'entrada'
+    ELSE 'neutro'
+  END);
+
+  v_usuario := COALESCE(auth.uid(), (v_ctx->>'usuario_id')::uuid,
+    CASE WHEN v_new_status = 'expedido' THEN NEW.expedido_por ELSE NEW.reservado_por END);
+
+  v_qtd := NULLIF(ABS(COALESCE(NEW.quantidade,0) - COALESCE(OLD.quantidade,0)), 0);
+  IF v_qtd IS NULL THEN
+    v_qtd := NULLIF(ABS(COALESCE(NEW.quantidade_reservada,0) - COALESCE(OLD.quantidade_reservada,0)), 0);
+  END IF;
+  IF v_qtd IS NULL THEN
+    v_qtd := NULLIF(COALESCE(NEW.quantidade_reservada, NEW.quantidade, 0), 0);
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.estoque_movimentacoes
+    (estoque_produto_id, acao, quantidade, status_anterior, status_novo,
+     os_id, os_tipo, cliente_id, lote_id, usuario_id, observacao,
+     saldo_anterior, saldo_posterior, reservado_anterior, reservado_posterior,
+     volume_anterior, volume_posterior, unidade, direcao,
+     origem, referencia_tipo, referencia_id, motivo,
+     idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, movimentacao_origem_id, metadata)
+  VALUES (
+    NEW.id, v_acao, v_qtd, v_old_status, v_new_status,
+    NEW.reservado_para_os_id, NEW.reservado_para_os_tipo, NEW.reservado_para_cliente_id,
+    NEW.lote_id, v_usuario, COALESCE(v_ctx->>'observacao', NEW.observacao_reserva),
+    COALESCE(OLD.quantidade,0), COALESCE(NEW.quantidade,0),
+    COALESCE(OLD.quantidade_reservada,0), COALESCE(NEW.quantidade_reservada,0),
+    COALESCE(OLD.volume_total,0), COALESCE(NEW.volume_total,0),
+    COALESCE(v_ctx->>'unidade','un'), v_dir,
+    COALESCE(v_ctx->>'origem','trigger'),
+    v_ctx->>'referencia_tipo', (v_ctx->>'referencia_id')::uuid, v_ctx->>'motivo',
+    v_key, v_ctx->>'request_fingerprint',
+    (v_ctx->>'movimentacao_origem_id')::uuid,
+    v_meta
+  );
+
+  IF v_acao = 'reserva' THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.notificacoes_operacionais (usuario_id, tipo, titulo, mensagem, link)
+    SELECT ur.user_id, 'nova_reserva', 'Nova reserva de estoque',
+           'Item reservado aguardando expedição.', '/estoque'
+      FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.user_id=ur.user_id AND pr.ativo IS TRUE JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id=NEW.lote_id AND l.organization_id=pr.organization_id JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=pr.organization_id AND o.ativo IS TRUE WHERE ur.role = 'administrativo'::app_role AND l.organization_id IS NOT NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.partner_apply_default_discount(p_partner_id uuid)
+ RETURNS integer
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_desc numeric(5,2);
+  v_count integer := 0;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required'; END IF;
+  IF NOT (has_role(v_uid, 'administrador') OR has_role(v_uid, 'gestor_comercial')) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT desconto_padrao INTO v_desc FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id = p_partner_id AND ativo IS TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE;
+  IF v_desc IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'partner_not_found' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.partner_product_prices(partner_id, product_id, preco_tabela, desconto_percentual, preco_final, ativo)
+  SELECT p_partner_id, p.id,
+         COALESCE(p.valor_ha_brl, 0),
+         v_desc,
+         ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_ha_brl, 0) * (1 - v_desc/100.0), 2),
+         true
+  FROM public.produtos p
+  WHERE p.ativo = true
+  ON CONFLICT (partner_id, product_id) WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE
+    SET preco_tabela = EXCLUDED.preco_tabela,
+        desconto_percentual = EXCLUDED.desconto_percentual,
+        preco_final = EXCLUDED.preco_final,
+        ativo = true;
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
+  RETURN v_count;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_create_global_product(p_payload jsonb, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+  SELECT platform_private.create_global_product_core(p_payload,p_reason,p_idempotency_key);
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(_uid uuid)
+ RETURNS TABLE(profile_ok boolean, org_partner uuid, user_partner uuid, user_partner_count integer, partner_valid boolean, has_catalog boolean)
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+  WITH pr AS (
+    SELECT o.partner_account_id
+      FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = p.organization_id
+     WHERE p.user_id = _uid AND p.ativo = true AND o.ativo = true AND o.status = 'ativa'
+     LIMIT 1
+  ), pu AS (
+    SELECT count(*)::int c, min(partner_id::text)::uuid pid
+      FROM public.partner_users
+     WHERE user_id = _uid AND revoked_at IS NULL
+  ), valid AS (
+    -- Caminho fornecedor: vínculo só resolve o parceiro com a cadeia completa
+    -- perfil→organização→tenant→proprietário comprovada no servidor.
+    SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT c FROM pu) = 1
+                 AND public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(_uid, (SELECT pid FROM pu))
+                 AND EXISTS (
+                   SELECT 1
+                     FROM public.partner_users puv
+                     JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = puv.partner_id
+                     JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+                     JOIN public.profiles pf ON pf.user_id = puv.user_id
+                     JOIN public.organizations porg ON porg.id = pf.organization_id
+                    WHERE puv.user_id = _uid
+                      AND puv.partner_id = (SELECT pid FROM pu)
+                      AND puv.revoked_at IS NULL
+                      AND (puv.valid_from IS NULL OR puv.valid_from <= now())
+                      AND pf.ativo = true
+                      AND porg.ativo = true AND porg.status = 'ativa'
+                      AND pf.organization_id = puv.tenant_id
+                      AND puv.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+                      AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+                      AND owner.ativo = true AND owner.status = 'ativa'
+                 )
+              THEN (SELECT pid FROM pu) END AS pid
+  )
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr),
+         -- Organização com parceiro explícito prevalece; sem ela, o vínculo autorizado
+         -- validado resolve o parceiro. Se ambos existirem e divergirem, org_partner
+         -- permanece o da organização e os consumidores negam por mismatch.
+         COALESCE((SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr), (SELECT pid FROM valid)),
+         (SELECT pid FROM valid),
+         (SELECT c FROM pu),
+         CASE WHEN (SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr) IS NOT NULL
+              THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pr.partner_account_id
+                            WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL)
+              ELSE (SELECT pid FROM valid) IS NOT NULL END,
+         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e WHERE e.feature_key = 'catalogo_precos');
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_coherent_self_partner(p_partner uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT COALESCE((platform_private.b2b_commercial_context()->>'partner_id')::uuid=p_partner,false);
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_commercial_context()
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid; pid uuid; rs text[]; result jsonb; BEGIN
+ org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
+ SELECT partner_id INTO pid FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u;
+ IF NOT public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,pid) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+ SELECT array_agg(role::text ORDER BY role::text) INTO rs FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=u;
+ result:=jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_MULTIPROFILE_V1','actor_id',u,'tenant_id',org,
+ 'organization_id',org,'partner_id',pid,'commercial_owner_organization_id',org,'external_roles',rs,
+ 'role',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'parceiro_b2b' ELSE 'parceiro_b2b_tecnico' END,
+ 'papel',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'gestor' ELSE 'tecnico' END,'mode','commercial_owner',
+ 'manager', 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs),'technician','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'=ANY(rs),
+ 'producer_links_valid',platform_private.c2_producer_links(u,org),
+ 'profile_stamp',(SELECT updated_at FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=u),
+ 'link_version',(SELECT version FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u));
+ RETURN result;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_direct_partner_row_allowed()
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT NOT EXISTS (
+ SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id=auth.uid()
+ AND (r.role='parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::public.app_role OR
+ (r.role='parceiro_b2b'::public.app_role AND EXISTS (
+ SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p
+ JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.user_id=p.user_id
+ JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id
+ WHERE p.user_id=r.user_id AND p.organization_id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+ ))));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_internal_assert_origin(s jsonb, partner uuid, client uuid)
+ RETURNS void
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE org uuid; uid uuid:=auth.uid();
+BEGIN
+ IF uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
+ IF org IS NULL OR NOT public.fn_cc_can_prepare(uid) OR NOT public._saas_user_has_feature(uid,'pedidos_b2b') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ACTOR_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF NOT platform_private.b2b_internal_origin_valid(s) OR s->>'organization_id' IS DISTINCT FROM org::text OR s->>'partner_id' IS DISTINCT FROM partner::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ORIGIN_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts p WHERE p.id=partner AND p.commercial_owner_organization_id=org AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
+ AND (p.client_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id=p.client_id AND c.organization_id=org))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_PARTNER_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF client IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id=client AND c.organization_id=org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_CLIENT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_internal_child_snapshot_guard()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE old_parent uuid; new_parent uuid; parent uuid; o public.partner_orders; before_value jsonb; after_value jsonb;
+BEGIN
+ IF TG_TABLE_NAME='partner_order_items' THEN
+  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN old_parent:=OLD.order_id; END IF;
+  IF TG_OP<>'DELETE' THEN new_parent:=NEW.order_id; END IF;
+ ELSE
+  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN old_parent:=OLD.partner_order_id; END IF;
+  IF TG_OP<>'DELETE' THEN new_parent:=NEW.partner_order_id; END IF;
+ END IF;
+ FOR parent IN SELECT DISTINCT x FROM unnest(ARRAY[old_parent,new_parent]) x WHERE x IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x LOOP
+  SELECT * INTO o FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id=parent FOR UPDATE;
+  IF o.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM platform_private.c2_external_origin_assert(o.c2_external_origin_snapshot,o.partner_id,o.cliente_id); END IF;
+  IF o.internal_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL OR o.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN
+   IF o.internal_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM platform_private.b2b_internal_assert_origin(o.internal_origin_snapshot,o.partner_id,o.cliente_id); END IF;
+   IF o.status IN ('cancelado','reprovado') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TERMINAL_STATUS' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+   IF o.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN
+    IF TG_OP<>'UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ECONOMICS_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+    before_value:=to_jsonb(OLD); after_value:=to_jsonb(NEW);
+    IF TG_TABLE_NAME='partner_order_payment_terms' THEN before_value:=before_value-ARRAY['updated_at','approval_status','approved_by','approved_at','approval_notes']; after_value:=after_value-ARRAY['updated_at','approval_status','approved_by','approved_at','approval_notes'];
+    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='partner_order_payment_schedule' THEN before_value:=before_value-ARRAY['status','receivable_installment_id']; after_value:=after_value-ARRAY['status','receivable_installment_id']; END IF;
+    IF before_value IS DISTINCT FROM after_value THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ECONOMICS_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+   END IF;
+  END IF;
+ END LOOP;
+ IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_internal_commercial_actor()
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$ SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND public.h15_actor_organization() IS NOT NULL AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(auth.uid()) AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id=auth.uid() AND r.role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico')); $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_internal_order_snapshot_guard()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE org uuid; uid uuid:=auth.uid(); cs public.company_fiscal_settings; candidate_count integer; economic jsonb; terms public.partner_order_payment_terms; items jsonb; schedule jsonb;
+BEGIN
+
+ -- Explicit external proof; NULL internal origin alone never authorizes a legacy order.
+ IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND platform_private.has_ticket('c2_external_order_create',NEW.partner_id) THEN
+  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL OR NEW.internal_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
+  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SNAPSHOT_SERVER_ONLY' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NOT platform_private.c2_owner_order_create_allowed(uid,NEW.partner_id) OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM uid
+  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_CREATE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT p.commercial_owner_organization_id,p.client_id INTO org,NEW.cliente_id FROM public.partner_accounts p WHERE p.id=NEW.partner_id FOR SHARE;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO candidate_count FROM public.company_fiscal_settings c WHERE c.organization_id=org AND c.is_active;
+  IF candidate_count>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ISSUER_AMBIGUOUS' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF candidate_count=1 THEN SELECT * INTO cs FROM public.company_fiscal_settings c WHERE c.organization_id=org AND c.is_active FOR SHARE; END IF;
+  IF candidate_count=1 AND cs.configuration_status='VALIDATED' AND cs.accounting_validated_at IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(cs.legal_name),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(cs.cnpj),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot:=jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_ORIGIN_V1','schema_version','1','organization_id',org,'creditor_organization_id',org,'issuer_organization_id',org,'company_settings_id',cs.id,'company_configuration_version',cs.configuration_version,'issuer_legal_name',cs.legal_name,'issuer_cnpj',cs.cnpj,'actor_user_id',uid,'partner_id',NEW.partner_id);
+  ELSE
+   -- C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING_V1: honest non-fiscal request; no issuer identity/attestation is copied or invented.
+   NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot:=jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1','schema_version','1','organization_id',org,'creditor_organization_id',org,'actor_user_id',uid,'partner_id',NEW.partner_id,'issuer_state',CASE WHEN candidate_count=0 THEN 'NOT_CONFIGURED' ELSE coalesce(cs.configuration_status,'UNKNOWN') END,'company_settings_id',cs.id,'accounting_validated',false);
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM platform_private.c2_external_origin_assert(NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot,NEW.partner_id,NEW.cliente_id);
+  IF NEW.ready_for_production OR NEW.status NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','aguardando_aprovacao_credito') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_INITIAL_STATE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+ END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SNAPSHOT_SERVER_ONLY' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL OR NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL) THEN
+  IF (NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot AND NOT platform_private.c2_accounting_promotion_ok(OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot,NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot,NEW.id)) OR NEW.internal_origin_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.internal_origin_snapshot OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.internal_economic_snapshot
+  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  PERFORM platform_private.c2_external_origin_assert(OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot,OLD.partner_id,OLD.cliente_id);
+  PERFORM platform_private.c2_external_origin_assert(NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot,NEW.partner_id,NEW.cliente_id);
+  IF NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id OR NEW.cliente_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cliente_id OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NEW.ready_for_production OR public.fn_b2b_status_is_operational(NEW.status) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_DOWNSTREAM_UNVERIFIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND OLD.status IN ('cancelado','reprovado') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TERMINAL_STATUS' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF OLD.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','updated_at','approval_notes','estimated_delivery_date','financial_status','receivable_generated','receivable_generated_at','receivable_generated_by','future_financial_link','commercial_notes','payment_due_date','payment_method']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','updated_at','approval_notes','estimated_delivery_date','financial_status','receivable_generated','receivable_generated_at','receivable_generated_by','future_financial_link','commercial_notes','payment_due_date','payment_method']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ECONOMICS_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF NEW.status='aprovado' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
+  IF NOT (public.has_role(uid,'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(uid,'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)) OR OLD.status NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','solicitado','rascunho') OR NEW.payment_condition_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'defined' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_APPROVAL_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO terms FROM public.partner_order_payment_terms t WHERE t.id=NEW.payment_terms_id AND t.partner_order_id=NEW.id FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TERMS_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NEW.total IS NULL OR NEW.total::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.total<0 OR terms.final_amount IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.total OR NEW.desconto_total<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TOTAL_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id AND (i.quantidade IS NULL OR i.quantidade<=0 OR i.quantidade::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR i.preco_unitario IS NULL OR i.preco_unitario<0 OR i.preco_unitario::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR i.desconto_percentual IS NULL OR i.desconto_percentual<0 OR i.desconto_percentual>100 OR i.desconto_percentual::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ITEM_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)-ARRAY['created_at'] ORDER BY i.id) INTO items FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id;
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)-ARRAY['created_at','status','receivable_installment_id'] ORDER BY s.installment_number,s.id) INTO schedule FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id AND s.payment_terms_id=terms.id;
+  IF schedule IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ IF NEW.subtotal IS NULL OR NEW.desconto_total IS NULL OR NEW.subtotal::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.desconto_total::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.subtotal<0 OR NEW.desconto_total<0 OR NEW.desconto_total>NEW.subtotal OR terms.discount_percent_snapshot IS NULL OR terms.discount_percent_snapshot::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR terms.discount_percent_snapshot<0 OR terms.discount_percent_snapshot>100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TOTAL_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id AND (i.subtotal IS NULL OR i.subtotal<0 OR i.subtotal::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))) OR (SELECT round(sum(i.subtotal),2) FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id) IS DISTINCT FROM round(terms.net_amount_after_discount,2) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ITEM_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id AND (s.payment_terms_id IS DISTINCT FROM terms.id OR s.installment_number<=0 OR s.due_date IS NULL OR s.amount IS NULL OR s.principal_amount IS NULL OR s.interest_amount IS NULL OR s.amount<0 OR s.principal_amount<0 OR s.interest_amount<0 OR s.amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR s.principal_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR s.interest_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id) IS DISTINCT FROM terms.installment_count::bigint OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT s.installment_number) FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id) IS DISTINCT FROM terms.installment_count::bigint OR (SELECT round(sum(s.amount),2) FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id) IS DISTINCT FROM round(terms.final_amount,2) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SCHEDULE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  economic:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','1','origin',OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot,'items',items,'terms',to_jsonb(terms)-ARRAY['updated_at','approval_status','approved_by','approved_at','approval_notes'],'schedule',schedule,'subtotal',NEW.subtotal,'discount',NEW.desconto_total,'total',NEW.total,'sealed_by',uid);
+  NEW.internal_economic_snapshot:=economic;
+
+ END IF;
+ RETURN NEW;
+ END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
+  IF uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
+  IF org IS NULL OR NOT public.fn_cc_can_prepare(uid) OR NOT public._saas_user_has_feature(uid,'pedidos_b2b') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ACTOR_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  -- No client/CNPJ/organizations.partner_account_id inference. All caller snapshots rejected.
+  IF NEW.internal_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SNAPSHOT_SERVER_ONLY' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO candidate_count FROM public.company_fiscal_settings c WHERE c.organization_id=org AND c.is_active IS TRUE;
+  IF candidate_count<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ISSUER_AMBIGUOUS' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO cs FROM public.company_fiscal_settings c WHERE c.organization_id=org AND c.is_active IS TRUE FOR SHARE;
+  IF cs.configuration_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'VALIDATED' OR cs.accounting_validated_at IS NULL OR nullif(btrim(cs.legal_name),'') IS NULL OR nullif(btrim(cs.cnpj),'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ISSUER_NOT_VALIDATED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  NEW.internal_origin_snapshot:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','1','organization_id',org,'creditor_organization_id',org,'issuer_organization_id',org,'company_settings_id',cs.id,'company_configuration_version',cs.configuration_version,'issuer_legal_name',cs.legal_name,'issuer_cnpj',cs.cnpj,'actor_user_id',uid,'partner_id',NEW.partner_id);
+  PERFORM platform_private.b2b_internal_assert_origin(NEW.internal_origin_snapshot,NEW.partner_id,NEW.cliente_id);
+  IF NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_DOWNSTREAM_UNVERIFIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; IF NEW.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue','faturado') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_INITIAL_STATUS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+ END IF;
+ IF NEW.internal_origin_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.internal_origin_snapshot OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.internal_economic_snapshot THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF OLD.internal_origin_snapshot IS NULL THEN
+  IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND NEW.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue','faturado') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_LEGACY_ORIGIN_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+ END IF;
+ PERFORM platform_private.b2b_internal_assert_origin(OLD.internal_origin_snapshot,OLD.partner_id,OLD.cliente_id);
+ IF NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id OR NEW.cliente_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cliente_id OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF OLD.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','updated_at','approval_notes','estimated_delivery_date','ready_for_production','financial_status','receivable_generated','receivable_generated_at','receivable_generated_by','future_financial_link','commercial_notes']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','updated_at','approval_notes','estimated_delivery_date','ready_for_production','financial_status','receivable_generated','receivable_generated_at','receivable_generated_by','future_financial_link','commercial_notes']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ECONOMICS_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND OLD.status IN ('cancelado','reprovado') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TERMINAL_STATUS' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_DOWNSTREAM_UNVERIFIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; IF public.fn_b2b_status_is_operational(NEW.status) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_DOWNSTREAM_UNVERIFIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; IF NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE AND NEW.status<>'aprovado' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_UNSEALED_OPERATION' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; IF NEW.status='aprovado' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
+  IF NOT (public.has_role(uid,'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(uid,'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)) OR OLD.status NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','solicitado','rascunho') OR NEW.payment_condition_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'defined' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_APPROVAL_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO terms FROM public.partner_order_payment_terms t WHERE t.id=NEW.payment_terms_id AND t.partner_order_id=NEW.id FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TERMS_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NEW.total IS NULL OR NEW.total::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.total<0 OR terms.final_amount IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.total OR NEW.desconto_total<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TOTAL_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id AND (i.quantidade IS NULL OR i.quantidade<=0 OR i.quantidade::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR i.preco_unitario IS NULL OR i.preco_unitario<0 OR i.preco_unitario::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR i.desconto_percentual IS NULL OR i.desconto_percentual<0 OR i.desconto_percentual>100 OR i.desconto_percentual::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ITEM_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)-ARRAY['created_at'] ORDER BY i.id) INTO items FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id;
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)-ARRAY['created_at','status','receivable_installment_id'] ORDER BY s.installment_number,s.id) INTO schedule FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id AND s.payment_terms_id=terms.id;
+  IF schedule IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ IF NEW.subtotal IS NULL OR NEW.desconto_total IS NULL OR NEW.subtotal::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.desconto_total::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.subtotal<0 OR NEW.desconto_total<0 OR NEW.desconto_total>NEW.subtotal OR terms.discount_percent_snapshot IS NULL OR terms.discount_percent_snapshot::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR terms.discount_percent_snapshot<0 OR terms.discount_percent_snapshot>100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_TOTAL_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id AND (i.subtotal IS NULL OR i.subtotal<0 OR i.subtotal::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))) OR (SELECT round(sum(i.subtotal),2) FROM public.partner_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=NEW.id) IS DISTINCT FROM round(terms.net_amount_after_discount,2) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_ITEM_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id AND (s.payment_terms_id IS DISTINCT FROM terms.id OR s.installment_number<=0 OR s.due_date IS NULL OR s.amount IS NULL OR s.principal_amount IS NULL OR s.interest_amount IS NULL OR s.amount<0 OR s.principal_amount<0 OR s.interest_amount<0 OR s.amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR s.principal_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR s.interest_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id) IS DISTINCT FROM terms.installment_count::bigint OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT s.installment_number) FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id) IS DISTINCT FROM terms.installment_count::bigint OR (SELECT round(sum(s.amount),2) FROM public.partner_order_payment_schedule s WHERE s.partner_order_id=NEW.id) IS DISTINCT FROM round(terms.final_amount,2) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_SCHEDULE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  economic:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','1','origin',OLD.internal_origin_snapshot,'items',items,'terms',to_jsonb(terms)-ARRAY['updated_at','approval_status','approved_by','approved_at','approval_notes'],'schedule',schedule,'subtotal',NEW.subtotal,'discount',NEW.desconto_total,'total',NEW.total,'sealed_by',uid);
+  NEW.internal_economic_snapshot:=economic;
+ ELSIF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND public.fn_b2b_status_is_operational(NEW.status) AND OLD.internal_economic_snapshot IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_INTERNAL_UNSEALED_OPERATION' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+ END IF;
+ RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_internal_origin_valid(s jsonb)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ IMMUTABLE
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT coalesce(jsonb_typeof(s)='object' AND s->>'schema_version'='1'
+ AND nullif(s->>'organization_id','') IS NOT NULL
+ AND s->>'organization_id'=s->>'creditor_organization_id'
+ AND s->>'organization_id'=s->>'issuer_organization_id'
+ AND nullif(s->>'company_settings_id','') IS NOT NULL
+ AND nullif(s->>'actor_user_id','') IS NOT NULL
+ AND nullif(s->>'partner_id','') IS NOT NULL,false)
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_organization_full_row_allowed()
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
+ AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id=auth.uid()
+   AND r.role::text IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_owner_internal_order_readable(p_order uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders o
+                 WHERE o.id = p_order AND platform_private.b2b_owner_internal_partner_readable(o.partner_id))
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_owner_internal_partner_readable(p_partner uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+  -- Read-only predicate. Internal staff (administrador/gestor_comercial/financeiro) of the active organization that
+  -- commercially owns an active partner. External roles or active partner links deny. Reads no partner_orders (no recursion).
+  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_partner IS NOT NULL
+    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = auth.uid()
+                    AND r.role::text IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'))
+    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_users pu WHERE pu.user_id = auth.uid() AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL)
+    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = auth.uid()
+                AND r.role::text IN ('administrador','gestor_comercial','financeiro'))
+    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa
+                JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+                     AND owner.ativo IS TRUE AND owner.status = 'ativa'
+                WHERE pa.id = p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+                  AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id = platform_private.h15_actor_organization())
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_phase1_order_visible(p_order uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders o WHERE o.id=p_order AND public.b2b_phase1_partner_visible(o.partner_id,false));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_phase1_partner_visible(p_partner uuid, p_technical boolean DEFAULT false)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE s record; u uuid:=auth.uid(); BEGIN
+ IF u IS NULL OR p_partner IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ IF public.is_platform_superadmin(u) THEN RETURN true; END IF;
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=u AND role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor')) THEN
+  RETURN public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,p_partner)
+   AND (public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b') OR (p_technical AND public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico')));
+ END IF;
+ SELECT * INTO s FROM platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(u);
+ RETURN s.profile_ok AND s.partner_valid AND s.org_partner=p_partner;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_phase1_simulation_visible(p_sim uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_simulations s WHERE s.id=p_sim AND public.b2b_phase1_partner_visible(s.partner_id,true) AND (NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(),'parceiro_b2b_tecnico') OR s.created_by=auth.uid()));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_save_technical_simulation(p_payload jsonb)
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); p uuid; s uuid; i jsonb; iid uuid; kind text; qty numeric; nm text; cl uuid;
+BEGIN
+ IF u IS NULL OR NOT public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ p:=(p_payload->>'partner_id')::uuid;
+ IF NOT platform_private.b2b_phase1_partner_visible(p,true) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'scope_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF NOT public._saas_user_has_feature(u,'simulacoes') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature_not_entitled' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF coalesce(p_payload->>'status','rascunho') NOT IN ('rascunho','enviada_gestor') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_status'; END IF;
+ IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'items') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_payload->'items')=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'empty_simulation'; END IF;
+ cl:=nullif(p_payload->>'cliente_id','')::uuid;
+ IF cl IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_user_clients puc WHERE puc.cliente_id=cl AND puc.user_id=u AND puc.partner_id=p AND puc.active=true) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_technician_clients ptc WHERE ptc.cliente_id=cl AND ptc.technician_user_id=u AND ptc.partner_id=p AND ptc.active=true)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'client_scope_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ INSERT INTO public.partner_simulations(partner_id,created_by,titulo,observacoes,cultura,area_total_ha,objetivo_tecnico,status,total_cheio,valid_until,cliente_id)
+ VALUES(p,u,left(p_payload->>'titulo',200),left(p_payload->>'observacoes',4000),left(p_payload->>'cultura',200),(p_payload->>'area_total_ha')::numeric,left(p_payload->>'objetivo_tecnico',2000),'rascunho',0,(p_payload->>'valid_until')::date,cl) RETURNING id INTO s;
+ FOR i IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'items') LOOP
+  iid:=(i->>'item_id')::uuid; kind:=i->>'item_tipo'; qty:=(i->>'quantidade')::numeric;
+  IF qty IS NULL OR qty<=0 OR qty::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_qty'; END IF;
+  IF kind='produto' THEN SELECT nome INTO nm FROM public.produtos WHERE id=iid AND ativo AND b2b_enabled;
+  ELSIF kind='microrganismo' THEN SELECT nome INTO nm FROM public.microrganismos WHERE id=iid AND ativo AND b2b_enabled;
+  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_item'; END IF;
+  IF nm IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'product_unavailable'; END IF;
+  IF coalesce(i->>'unidade_medida','hectare') NOT IN ('hectare','litro','dose','unidade') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_unit'; END IF;
+  IF i->>'unidade_medida'='unidade' AND coalesce((i->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0)<=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_volume'; END IF;
+  INSERT INTO public.partner_simulation_items(simulation_id,item_tipo,item_id,nome,quantidade,valor_unitario_cheio,subtotal,unidade_medida,volume_ml,area_ha)
+  VALUES(s,kind,iid,nm,qty,0,0,coalesce(i->>'unidade_medida','hectare'),(i->>'volume_ml')::numeric,(i->>'area_ha')::numeric);
+ END LOOP;
+ IF p_payload->>'status'='enviada_gestor' THEN PERFORM public.send_partner_simulation_to_manager_secure(s); END IF;
+ RETURN s;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c1b_catalog_visibility_scope(p_partner uuid)
+ RETURNS uuid[]
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_actor uuid; v_owner uuid;
+BEGIN
+ IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ v_actor := platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
+ IF v_actor IS NULL AND NOT public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid()) THEN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_actor_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF p_partner IS NULL THEN
+  SELECT o.partner_account_id INTO p_partner FROM public.organizations o WHERE o.id=v_actor;
+ END IF;
+ IF p_partner IS NOT NULL THEN
+  SELECT pa.commercial_owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.partner_accounts pa
+   JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status='ativa'
+   WHERE pa.id=p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL;
+  IF v_owner IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_commercial_owner_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ END IF;
+ IF v_actor IS NULL AND v_owner IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_scope_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ RETURN array_remove(ARRAY[v_actor,v_owner],NULL);
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_accounting_pending_guard()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+ -- While pending, only commercial review/quote, rejection or cancellation are possible: no approval,
+ -- credit decision, economics seal, receivable, production, NF or delivery.
+ -- INSERT: the canonical create may land in em_analise_comercial, aguardando_cotacao or (insufficient credit)
+ -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito; nothing operational/financial may be set at creation.
+ IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
+  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' AND (
+     NEW.status::text NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','aguardando_aprovacao_credito')
+     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
+     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
+   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+ END IF;
+ IF OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
+    AND NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' THEN
+  -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito may only stay as is (no hidden credit decision) or leave to cancel/reject.
+  IF NOT (NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','cancelado','reprovado')
+          OR (NEW.status=OLD.status AND OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito'))
+     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito' AND NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao'))
+     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
+     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_at OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at
+     -- review e1e9aa2f: no credit/financial decision field may advance by any privileged path while pending.
+     OR NEW.credit_approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_by OR NEW.credit_approval_notes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approval_notes
+     OR NEW.approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by
+     -- review 61b28: the canonical create (same txn, private create ticket) initializes not_required -> pending/not_required;
+     -- any other change (e.g. -> approved) is a financial decision and stays denied while pending.
+     OR (NEW.financial_approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.financial_approval_status
+         AND NOT (platform_private.has_ticket('c2_external_order_create',NEW.partner_id)
+                  AND OLD.financial_approval_status='not_required' AND NEW.financial_approval_status IN ('pending','not_required'))) THEN
+   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+  END IF;
+ END IF;
+ RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_accounting_promotion_ok(o jsonb, n jsonb, order_id uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT coalesce(o->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
+  AND n->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_ORIGIN_V1' AND platform_private.b2b_internal_origin_valid(n)
+  AND n->>'organization_id'=o->>'organization_id' AND n->>'partner_id'=o->>'partner_id' AND n->>'actor_user_id'=o->>'actor_user_id'
+  AND n->>'promoted_from_contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
+  AND platform_private.has_ticket('c2_accounting_promote',order_id),false)
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_external_final_state_guard()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND OLD.internal_economic_snapshot IS NULL AND NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'aprovado' THEN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_UNFINALIZED_APPROVAL' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+ END IF;
+ RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_external_origin_assert(s jsonb, partner uuid, client uuid)
+ RETURNS void
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE uid uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid; p public.partner_accounts;
+BEGIN
+ IF uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ SELECT * INTO p FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id=partner FOR SHARE;
+ org:=p.commercial_owner_organization_id;
+ IF NOT FOUND OR p.ativo IS NOT TRUE OR p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR org IS NULL
+ OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations o WHERE o.id=org AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa')
+ OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations o WHERE o.partner_account_id=partner)
+ OR NOT platform_private.c2_external_origin_contract_valid(s)
+ OR s->>'organization_id' IS DISTINCT FROM org::text OR s->>'partner_id' IS DISTINCT FROM partner::text
+ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_ORIGIN_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF client IS DISTINCT FROM p.client_id OR (client IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id=client AND c.organization_id=org))
+ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_CLIENT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ -- Initial writes are authorized only inside the existing canonical create transaction.
+ -- Subsequent administration uses P1's active internal owner authority, never buyer roles.
+ IF platform_private.has_ticket('c2_external_order_create',partner) THEN
+  IF s->>'actor_user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM uid::text OR NOT platform_private.c2_owner_order_create_allowed(uid,partner)
+  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_CREATE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  ELSE
+  IF public.h15_actor_organization() IS DISTINCT FROM org OR NOT platform_private.c2p1_settings_allowed(partner,true)
+  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_OWNER_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ END IF;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_external_origin_contract_valid(s jsonb)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ IMMUTABLE
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT coalesce(
+  (s->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_ORIGIN_V1' AND platform_private.b2b_internal_origin_valid(s))
+  OR (jsonb_typeof(s)='object' AND s->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' AND s->>'schema_version'='1'
+      AND nullif(s->>'organization_id','') IS NOT NULL AND s->>'organization_id'=s->>'creditor_organization_id'
+      AND nullif(s->>'actor_user_id','') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(s->>'partner_id','') IS NOT NULL
+      AND s->'accounting_validated'='false'::jsonb
+      AND NOT (s ? 'issuer_organization_id') AND NOT (s ? 'issuer_legal_name') AND NOT (s ? 'issuer_cnpj')
+      AND s->>'issuer_state' IS NOT NULL),false)
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_internal_order_target_reason(_uid uuid, _partner uuid)
+ RETURNS text
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE s record; org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  -- Mirrors LIVE guards; NULL means allowed. Never authorizes by itself: callers must RAISE.
+  IF _uid IS NULL OR auth.uid() IS DISTINCT FROM _uid THEN RETURN 'auth_required'; END IF;
+  IF NOT platform_private.b2b_internal_commercial_actor() THEN RETURN 'actor_not_allowed'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO s FROM platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(_uid);
+  IF s.profile_ok IS NOT TRUE THEN RETURN 'inactive_scope'; END IF;
+  IF NOT public._saas_user_has_feature(_uid,'pedidos_b2b') THEN RETURN 'feature_disabled'; END IF;
+  org := public.h15_actor_organization();
+  IF org IS NULL THEN RETURN 'actor_not_allowed'; END IF;
+  IF _partner IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts p
+       WHERE p.id=_partner AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.commercial_owner_organization_id=org
+         AND (p.client_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id=p.client_id AND c.organization_id=org))) THEN
+    RETURN 'target_outside_portfolio';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NULL;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_owner_order_create_allowed(_uid uuid, _partner uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE c jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  -- c2_ord_writer_v1: nunca confia em parâmetro de uid que não seja o JWT atual.
+  IF _uid IS NULL OR _partner IS NULL OR auth.uid() IS DISTINCT FROM _uid THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+  -- Gestor B2B vigente (user_roles canônico; revogação remove a linha). Técnico isolado nunca compra.
+  IF NOT public.has_role(_uid,'parceiro_b2b'::public.app_role) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+  c := platform_private.b2b_commercial_context();
+  IF c IS NULL OR c->>'contract' <> 'C2_MULTIPROFILE_V1' OR c->>'mode' <> 'commercial_owner'
+     OR (c->>'partner_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM _partner OR COALESCE((c->>'manager')::boolean,false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RETURN false;
+  END IF;
+  -- Cliente comercial = sem organização própria; tenant dono ativo e coerente com perfil/vínculo.
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations o WHERE o.partner_account_id = _partner) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+  IF NOT COALESCE(platform_private.b2b_phase1_partner_visible(_partner,true),false) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_users pu
+      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id
+      JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = pu.user_id
+      JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+     WHERE pu.user_id = _uid AND pu.partner_id = _partner
+       AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND (pu.valid_from IS NULL OR pu.valid_from <= now())
+       AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.ativo AND o.status = 'ativa'
+       AND (o.partner_account_id IS NULL OR o.partner_account_id = _partner)
+       AND p.ativo AND p.organization_id = pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id = o.id
+       AND (c->>'tenant_id')::uuid = o.id
+       AND public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(_uid, pa.id)) THEN
+    RETURN false;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e WHERE e.feature_key = 'pedidos_b2b')
+     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e WHERE e.feature_key = 'catalogo_precos');
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_producer_links(p_user uuid, p_org uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user)
+ AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
+ JOIN public.user_clientes uc ON uc.user_id=p.user_id JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=uc.cliente_id
+ JOIN public.fazendas f ON f.cliente_id=c.id
+ WHERE p.user_id=p_user AND p.organization_id=p_org AND p.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa'
+ AND uc.is_active AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL AND uc.valid_from<=now()
+ AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until>=now())
+ AND c.organization_id=p_org AND c.status_cliente='ativo' AND f.organization_id=p_org AND f.ativo);
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(p_scope text, p_partner uuid, p_customer uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT COALESCE(CASE
+ WHEN p_scope='partner' AND p_partner IS NOT NULL AND p_customer IS NULL THEN EXISTS(
+ SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
+ WHERE pa.id=p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL AND owner.ativo IS TRUE AND owner.status='ativa'
+ AND owner.id=platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor_comercial']::public.app_role[]))
+ WHEN p_scope='producer' AND p_partner IS NULL AND p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(
+ SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id
+ WHERE c.id=p_customer AND c.status_cliente='ativo' AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status='ativa'
+ AND o.id=platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor_comercial']::public.app_role[]))
+ ELSE false END,false);
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_assignment_children_fence()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$ BEGIN
+ IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i WHERE i.assignment_id=OLD.id
+ AND (i.plan_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.plan_id OR i.buyer_scope IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.buyer_scope OR i.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.partner_id OR i.customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.customer_id))
+ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_ASSIGNMENT_LINK_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_assignment_fence()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+ IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_ASSIGNMENT_DELETE_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() ORDER BY role FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.organizations WHERE id IN (public.h15_actor_organization(),
+ (SELECT commercial_owner_organization_id FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id=NEW.partner_id),
+ (SELECT organization_id FROM public.clientes WHERE id=NEW.customer_id)) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id IN (NEW.partner_id,CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN OLD.partner_id ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.clientes WHERE id IN (NEW.customer_id,CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN OLD.customer_id ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NOT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(OLD.buyer_scope,OLD.partner_id,OLD.customer_id)
+ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF NOT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(NEW.buyer_scope,NEW.partner_id,NEW.customer_id)
+ THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(p_roles app_role[])
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT public.h15_actor_organization() WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
+ AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
+ WHERE p.user_id=auth.uid() AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status='ativa'
+ AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id))
+ AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() AND role=ANY(p_roles))
+ AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=auth.uid()
+ AND role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(p_assignment uuid, p_plan uuid, p_scope text, p_partner uuid, p_customer uuid)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(p_scope,p_partner,p_customer) AND
+ (p_assignment IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_payment_plan_assignments a
+ WHERE a.id=p_assignment AND a.plan_id=p_plan AND a.buyer_scope=p_scope
+ AND a.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner AND a.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer
+ AND platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(a.buyer_scope,a.partner_id,a.customer_id)));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_item_fence()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE r public.commercial_condition_item_prices;
+BEGIN
+ IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN r=OLD; ELSE r=NEW; END IF;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() ORDER BY role FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.organizations WHERE id IN (public.h15_actor_organization(),(SELECT commercial_owner_organization_id FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id=r.partner_id),(SELECT organization_id FROM public.clientes WHERE id=r.customer_id)) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id IN(r.partner_id,CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN OLD.partner_id ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.clientes WHERE id IN(r.customer_id,CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN OLD.customer_id ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.commercial_payment_plan_assignments WHERE id IN(r.assignment_id,CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN OLD.assignment_id ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ IF NOT platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(r.assignment_id,r.plan_id,r.buyer_scope,r.partner_id,r.customer_id)
+ OR (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NOT platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(OLD.assignment_id,OLD.plan_id,OLD.buyer_scope,OLD.partner_id,OLD.customer_id)) THEN
+ RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF TG_OP<>'DELETE' AND r.published_rule_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_price_rules pr WHERE pr.id=r.published_rule_id AND pr.plan_id=r.plan_id AND pr.buyer_scope=r.buyer_scope
+ AND pr.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.partner_id AND pr.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.customer_id
+ AND pr.product_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.product_id AND pr.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.microrganismo_id
+ AND pr.unit_type=r.unit_type AND pr.volume_ml IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.volume_ml) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_RULE_LINK_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_rule_fence()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE r public.commercial_price_rules;
+BEGIN
+ IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN r=OLD; ELSE r=NEW; END IF;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() ORDER BY role FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.organizations WHERE id IN (public.h15_actor_organization(),(SELECT commercial_owner_organization_id FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id=r.partner_id),(SELECT organization_id FROM public.clientes WHERE id=r.customer_id)) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id IN(r.partner_id,CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN OLD.partner_id ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ PERFORM 1 FROM public.clientes WHERE id IN(r.customer_id,CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN OLD.customer_id ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
+ IF NOT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(r.buyer_scope,r.partner_id,r.customer_id)
+ OR (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NOT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(OLD.buyer_scope,OLD.partner_id,OLD.customer_id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i WHERE i.published_rule_id=OLD.id AND (NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR i.plan_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.plan_id OR i.buyer_scope IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.buyer_scope OR i.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.partner_id OR i.customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.customer_id OR i.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.product_id OR i.microrganismo_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.microrganismo_id OR i.unit_type IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.unit_type OR i.volume_ml IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.volume_ml)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_RULE_LINK_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+ IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_settings_allowed(p_partner uuid, p_write boolean DEFAULT false)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa JOIN public.organizations o
+ ON o.id=platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(CASE WHEN p_write THEN
+ ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor','gestor_comercial']::public.app_role[] ELSE
+ ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor','gestor_comercial','administrativo']::public.app_role[] END)
+ WHERE pa.id=p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
+ AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status='ativa' AND
+ (o.partner_account_id=pa.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations owner
+ WHERE owner.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id AND owner.id=o.id AND owner.ativo IS TRUE AND owner.status='ativa')));
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_composition_family_guard()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.familia_catalogo IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.familia_catalogo AND EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.produto_composicao_declaracoes d WHERE d.produto_id = NEW.id
+        AND NOT platform_private.catalog_composition_type_allowed(NEW.familia_catalogo, d.tipo_componente)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_family_conflict'; END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_composition_row_guard()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_fam text;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT p.familia_catalogo INTO v_fam FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = NEW.produto_id;
+  IF NOT platform_private.catalog_composition_type_allowed(v_fam, NEW.tipo_componente) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_family_conflict'; END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_composition_touch()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN NEW.updated_at := GREATEST(pg_catalog.clock_timestamp(), OLD.updated_at + interval '1 microsecond'); RETURN NEW; END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_composition_type_allowed(p_familia text, p_tipo text)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ IMMUTABLE
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+  SELECT COALESCE((p_familia='biologico' AND p_tipo IN ('microrganismo','outro'))
+    OR (p_familia='quimico' AND p_tipo IN ('ingrediente_ativo','outro'))
+    OR (p_familia='fertilizante_adubo' AND p_tipo IN ('nutriente','outro')), false)
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_culture_normalize(p jsonb, p_create boolean)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE k text; v_out jsonb:='{}'::jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF p IS NULL OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+  FOR k IN SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(p) LOOP
+    IF k = 'nome' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k)='string' AND pg_catalog.char_length(pg_catalog.btrim(p->>k)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 THEN
+      v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,pg_catalog.btrim(p->>k));
+    ELSIF k = 'descricao' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k)='null' THEN v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,NULL::text);
+    ELSIF k = 'descricao' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k)='string' AND pg_catalog.char_length(p->>k) <= 2000 THEN
+      v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,NULLIF(pg_catalog.btrim(p->>k),''));
+    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid';
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF (p_create AND NOT v_out ? 'nome') OR (NOT p_create AND v_out='{}'::jsonb) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+  RETURN v_out;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_entity_audit(p_actor uuid, p_operation text, p_reason text, p_key uuid, p_request jsonb, p_receipt jsonb, p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
+ RETURNS void
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+  INSERT INTO public.catalog_platform_admin_audit (id,operation,actor_id,reason,correlation_id,status,counts_before,counts_after,completed_at)
+  VALUES ((p_receipt->>'audit_id')::uuid,p_operation,p_actor,pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason),p_key,'completed',COALESCE(p_before,'{}'::jsonb),
+    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('request',p_request,'receipt',p_receipt,'after',p_after),pg_catalog.clock_timestamp());
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_entity_replay(p_actor uuid, p_operation text, p_request jsonb, p_reason text, p_key uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_existing public.catalog_platform_admin_audit%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_key IS NULL OR p_reason IS NULL OR pg_catalog.char_length(pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason)) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 500 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended('catalog-metadata:'||p_key::text,0));
+  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.catalog_platform_admin_audit WHERE correlation_id=p_key;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+  IF v_existing.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_actor OR v_existing.operation IS DISTINCT FROM p_operation
+    OR v_existing.counts_after->'request' IS DISTINCT FROM p_request THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_conflict'; END IF;
+  RETURN (v_existing.counts_after->'receipt')||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('idempotent',true);
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_family_label_check(p_familia text, p_rotulo text)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_ativo boolean;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT l.ativo INTO v_ativo
+    FROM public.catalog_family_labels l
+   WHERE l.familia = p_familia AND l.rotulo = p_rotulo
+   FOR KEY SHARE;
+  RETURN COALESCE(v_ativo, false);
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_family_label_validate()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.classe_catalogo IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
+  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
+     AND NEW.classe_catalogo IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.classe_catalogo
+     AND NEW.familia_catalogo IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.familia_catalogo THEN
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+  IF NEW.familia_catalogo IS NULL
+     OR NOT platform_private.catalog_family_label_check(NEW.familia_catalogo, NEW.classe_catalogo) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514', MESSAGE = 'catalog_label_not_active';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END $function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor()
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_actor uuid:=auth.uid(); v_jwt jsonb:=auth.jwt();
+BEGIN
+  IF v_actor IS NULL OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_jwt->'iat') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
+    OR COALESCE(v_jwt->>'iat','') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
+    OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_jwt->'exp') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
+    OR COALESCE(v_jwt->>'exp','') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_forbidden';
+  END IF;
+  IF (v_jwt->>'iat')::bigint <= 0 OR (v_jwt->>'exp')::bigint <= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pg_catalog.statement_timestamp())
+    OR (v_jwt->>'iat')::bigint > EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pg_catalog.statement_timestamp())
+    OR NOT COALESCE(public.has_role(v_actor,'superadmin'::public.app_role),false)
+    OR NOT COALESCE(public.is_platform_superadmin(v_actor),false)
+    OR NOT COALESCE(platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(v_actor),false) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_forbidden';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v_actor;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_micro_normalize(p jsonb, p_create boolean)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE k text; v_out jsonb:='{}'::jsonb; v_num numeric;
+  v_text constant jsonb:='{"nome_cientifico":300,"concentracao_label":120,"fornecedor":200,"meio_cultivo":5000,"funcao_agronomica":5000,"observacoes":5000,"descricao":5000}';
+BEGIN
+  IF p IS NULL OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+  FOR k IN SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(p) LOOP
+    IF k = 'nome' THEN
+      IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR pg_catalog.char_length(pg_catalog.btrim(p->>k)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+      v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,pg_catalog.btrim(p->>k));
+    ELSIF k = 'tipo' THEN
+      -- tipo define prefixo do código gerado no servidor: somente na criação.
+      IF NOT p_create OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+        OR NOT ((p->>k) = ANY(pg_catalog.enum_range(NULL::public.tipo_microrganismo)::text[])) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+      v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,p->>k);
+    ELSIF k = 'producao_on_farm' THEN
+      IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+      v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,p->k);
+    ELSIF k = 'concentracao_ufc_ml' THEN
+      IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k)='null' THEN v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,NULL::numeric);
+      ELSE
+        IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+        v_num:=(p->>k)::numeric;
+        -- Limite alinhado ao front: <= 9007199254740991 (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) e até 2 casas, sem notação exponencial.
+        IF v_num <= 0 OR v_num > 9007199254740991 OR pg_catalog.scale(v_num) > 2 OR (p->>k) ~* 'e' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+        v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,v_num);
+      END IF;
+    ELSIF v_text ? k THEN
+      IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k)='null' THEN v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,NULL::text);
+      ELSIF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR pg_catalog.char_length(p->>k) > (v_text->>k)::int THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid';
+      ELSE v_out:=v_out||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(k,NULLIF(pg_catalog.btrim(p->>k),''));
+      END IF;
+    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid';
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF p_create AND NOT (v_out ? 'nome' AND v_out ? 'tipo' AND v_out ? 'producao_on_farm') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+  IF NOT p_create AND v_out = '{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+  RETURN v_out;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor(p_mode text)
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
